2788bfda581e001b2a1f069ce417cc8775a3d20d.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: an unhandled ZodError on a malformed body yields 500 instead of 400.

7794e89965e26d3ac89198560f9c1549b31708c8.titleReason: The title correctly says that a failed Twilio cancellation prevents the scheduled SMS reminder row from being deleted, which is the defect.

86f0b8b59cb3ada1396484aff94c1b9521032304.titleReason: The title correctly says that join() leaks processes still running after the timeout deadline, which is the defect described.

44ce8d07255b9ce5aa3740aa393a804487dd2070.titleReason: The title names the actual defect: the embed URL is placed unescaped into stored HTML, which allows XSS.

dc7aa7a90bd44044a218a22537a38557cf0e7168.titleReason: The title correctly identifies that the light-theme lightness for the group member `.name` was changed from 30% to 50%, which is the defect.

83e4aae4273f7f59997f4e1c710b194e61c0bfd1.titleReason: The title correctly states that add_members raises RecordNotUnique when a username is already a member or appears more than once, which is the defect.

d515372c760fcb68b149c3f6579960c3c9aa0753.titleReason: The title says the date-override early return skips the busy-time conflict check, which is exactly the defect described.

8929c6882659c74c4441db74c76dd671cad9c09b.titleReason: The title correctly states that the slug condition is inverted, so the slug is set only when billing is enabled.
8929c6882659c74c4441db74c76dd671cad9c09b.fixReason: The fix negates the condition on line 151, leaves the requestedSlug condition on line 153 correct and unchanged, and keeps the metadata structure intact.

aab09560e0794b43df3f8a28f02129a5d3964090.fixReason: With a try/catch around each reminder, one failed SendGrid cancel no longer stops the loop; successful cancels have their deletes run through Promise.allSettled, which invokes the lazy Prisma promises' then, and errors are logged without escaping, so the code after the block still runs with the same request body and rows.

4f410fed00d04e4396756dc6c0ff58282ef57b57.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: a placeholder refresh_token overwrites the real stored token whenever the response omits one.
4f410fed00d04e4396756dc6c0ff58282ef57b57.fixReason: The fix limits the placeholder injection to the same condition as the sharing branch, so the non-sharing path no longer adds a fake token, real tokens pass through unchanged, and the throw and return behavior stays the same.

e170989fc734761cd2193f806dda40ef4849fe74.titleReason: The title names the defect: SMS-locked reminders are wrongly counted as failures and end up deleted after retries.
e170989fc734761cd2193f806dda40ef4849fe74.fixReason: Replacing lines 178-186 with `}` leaves line 187's `}` in place, which adds an extra closing brace, so the try/catch structure breaks and the file will not compile (an empty replacement was needed).

8e682165250cd9afcf27a28a542d70b880cc2481.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: Dayjs objects are compared with `===`, so the full-day unavailable override check never fires.
8e682165250cd9afcf27a28a542d70b880cc2481.fixReason: Replacing `===` with `.isSame(...)` compares the adjusted times by value, so the find callback returns true when start equals end, and the other checks are left unchanged.

8be447797d113f06b9bfe9902e4014b52cb2e8c4.titleReason: The title states the defect: when a day has several date overrides, slots that sit inside one of them are wrongly marked unavailable.
8be447797d113f06b9bfe9902e4014b52cb2e8c4.fixReason: The code keeps only same-day overrides, sets dateOverrideExist, and accepts the slot if some override contains it under the same offset and boundary rules, treats start==end as containing nothing, and leaves the following dateOverrideExist short-circuit and the no-override path unchanged.

265666a489c204ea2b0d0800932f55315c42dc6b.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the guest blacklist check can be bypassed by changing the email's case or using a plus-address alias.
265666a489c204ea2b0d0800932f55315c42dc6b.fixReason: The inline normalizer lowercases both sides and strips the '+tag' before comparing, so blacklisted addresses are caught in either form, while guests keep their original strings, the attendee filter stays in place, and an empty or unset env var still blocks nothing.

67afa1aff7abd042fe915bc4d0004f2f51709a64.titleReason: The title correctly says the check uses && and so denies admins who are not owners, which is the defect.
67afa1aff7abd042fe915bc4d0004f2f51709a64.fixReason: Replacing && with || authorizes both admins and owners, still denies everyone else, and keeps the truthy semantics the later check relies on.

9120980409783a9af9fec987b230c255809f1f15.titleReason: The title correctly states that video booking references lose their credentialId because it is hard-coded to undefined.
9120980409783a9af9fec987b230c255809f1f15.fixReason: Using `result.credentialId` unconditionally restores the credential id for video results, keeps the per-result value for calendar results, and leaves externalCalendarId unchanged, which meets all obligations.

ed469cc18bcd3f29f675cd44bca430a4d40bb4f8.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring cancellation path ignores the resolved per-reference credential, so collective (co-host) events are mishandled.

e6f32e0527fab0d02956681eaac73ca3602e1826.titleReason: The title states the defect: createEvent always targets the first host's calendar no matter which credential is calling it.

575526dafce8c70d8fd6660fd9519fa9b958b01d.titleReason: The title correctly says that join() leaks the remaining flusher processes once the timeout deadline elapses, which is the defect.
575526dafce8c70d8fd6660fd9519fa9b958b01d.fixReason: The fix removes the break, keeps waiting bounded by the while-condition, terminates every process in a second loop with the isinstance guard intact, and keeps the timeout=None behavior of waiting for each process before terminating.

874f02dc1e5e0db7a1544be437de77b4e3cba8b8.titleReason: The title says filtered messages "never" have their offsets tracked, which repeats the finding's overstatement; the reference shows BrokerValue-wrapped filtered messages are tracked in the except branch, so offsets are only lost for plain Value messages.

9c4f6d62bf8b56713610b644fbd4ebcbd6b6d0a3.titleReason: The title names the defect: the work queues are unbounded and give no backpressure when traffic bursts.

c8882823a594807dabcb3da51f7e2dc977850809.titleReason: The title says destination calendars are dropped when the organizer has none, which matches the defect of team calendars being lost when `evt.destinationCalendar` is null, though it is somewhat loose.
c8882823a594807dabcb3da51f7e2dc977850809.fixReason: The replacement adds its own closing brace, but the cited lines (1077-1078) exclude the existing `}` on line 1079, so the result has an extra brace and will not compile.

3538219c3124913b580ff07c67d9982f0ad4e0c2.titleReason: The title correctly says that reminders skipped because SMS sending is locked are wrongly counted as send failures, which is the stated defect.
3538219c3124913b580ff07c67d9982f0ad4e0c2.fixReason: Deleting lines 178-186 removes the retryCount increment on a falsy result, leaves the closing brace on line 187 to close the success branch, and keeps both the successful-scheduling update and the catch-block retry counting.

42058e679dc73d8951572e99424f9c72138f3cc0.titleReason: The title names the defect: an unconditional placeholder refresh_token that overwrites the valid stored token.
42058e679dc73d8951572e99424f9c72138f3cc0.fixReason: The improved code uses both branch conditions, so the placeholder is injected only in the sharing/sync branch, and it keeps any existing refresh_token, meeting all obligations.

f8cbb7a1a6e9f51c8e7f58557c613523f82a83c5.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: the slug condition in organization creation is inverted.
f8cbb7a1a6e9f51c8e7f58557c613523f82a83c5.fixReason: The improved code sets slug directly only when billing is disabled, keeps requestedSlug in metadata when billing is enabled, and leaves the remaining metadata intact, matching every obligation.

6eba1e41522163f16b50339b639f213c640d3350.titleReason: The title correctly says the guest blacklist can be bypassed through case variants or plus-address aliases, which is the defect described.
6eba1e41522163f16b50339b639f213c640d3350.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

d06f0f9d58465cd4a7f52d2f504f99f8d08a3f6c.titleReason: The title correctly says that the loop-wide try/catch stops all remaining cancellations at the first SendGrid error, which is the defect described.
d06f0f9d58465cd4a7f52d2f504f99f8d08a3f6c.fixReason: The replacement catches errors per reminder so the remaining cancellations are still attempted, queues deletes only for successful cancellations, awaits those deletes in a separate guarded block, retains reminders whose cancellation failed, and logs errors without blocking the scheduling phase, matching the example fix.

137231f84922c06ddbe9ceef41c0e10a79c9f456.titleReason: The title correctly says video references lose their credentialId, which is the defect.
137231f84922c06ddbe9ceef41c0e10a79c9f456.fixReason: The fix keeps result.credentialId for both calendar and video references, leaves externalCalendarId restricted to calendar references, and matches the reference.

49b2be04a7c484b2f9eec0221d753baee6315ff7.titleReason: The title names the defect: Dayjs override dates are compared with ===, which is reference equality.
49b2be04a7c484b2f9eec0221d753baee6315ff7.fixReason: Using isSame compares the endpoint timestamps by value, so an equal-endpoint override now returns true and triggers the unavailable result, while unequal-endpoint overrides still fall through to the existing bounds checks.

42efdfe303db8e0759f7fbea5d976335cfb1dcbb.titleReason: The title correctly identifies that the team authorization check uses AND where it should use OR, which is the defect.
42efdfe303db8e0759f7fbea5d976335cfb1dcbb.fixReason: Replacing && with || authorizes either a team admin or a team owner, leaves the organizer and attendee checks untouched, and still rejects users who hold none of the roles.

cc42e44970c91531cce6a1fc356ce28923e4d92b.titleReason: The title correctly says the date-override early return skips the busy-time overlap check, which is the defect.
cc42e44970c91531cce6a1fc356ce28923e4d92b.fixReason: Clearing the reassignable workingHours parameter when an override exists lets override slots skip the working-hours check and fall through to the existing busy check, which rejects overlaps and allows endpoint-touching slots, while the currentSeats and non-override paths stay unchanged.

46a08d01e3e80a8eddab9539839ccedbe5f5b270.titleReason: The title names both defects: the missing end-bound check and the wrongful rejection of slots when a day has several working-hour ranges.
46a08d01e3e80a8eddab9539839ccedbe5f5b270.fixReason: There is no `workingHours.length > 0` guard, so `!some` on the default empty array rejects every slot (breaking the busy-only reservation check), and `end` built from `slotEndTime.hour()*60+minute()` wraps overnight ends back to early clock minutes.

615f2c425090b12d96dfc9d1307e719905862518.titleReason: The title correctly says that Office365 createEvent targets the wrong destination calendar when a co-host's credential is used, which is the defect the finding describes.
615f2c425090b12d96dfc9d1307e719905862518.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

76e6218910a55cf8546946a976f6505819a6818e.titleReason: The title names the non-atomic retryCount increment in the catch block, which is the defect described.
76e6218910a55cf8546946a976f6505819a6818e.fixReason: The improved code replaces the stale value write with Prisma's atomic `{ increment: 1 }`, keeps targeting reminder.id with await, and leaves the closing `});` and the logging outside the range intact.

c99f06f325312efa047228d5cf6eb6a3210345ce.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: the recurring branch deletes the wrong calendar references when collective references exist.
c99f06f325312efa047228d5cf6eb6a3210345ce.fixReason: The improvedCode closes its own map callback with `});`, but the uncited lines 458-461 (`apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent); } } });`) remain after the replacement, leaving a duplicated, unbalanced block that would not compile.

f28e66782de3d10770f7c085c7162440079edfa9.titleReason: The title correctly says the working-hours check rejects valid slots on days with split ranges, which is the reported defect.
f28e66782de3d10770f7c085c7162440079edfa9.fixReason: With omitted or empty workingHours, `!workingHours.some(...)` is true, so every slot is rejected instead of falling through to the busy-only check; this violates the obligation to preserve empty working hours as busy-only.

476389932d2a81cb221e902c9badcfbbe8526445.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: valid slots are wrongly rejected when a day has multiple date overrides.
476389932d2a81cb221e902c9badcfbbe8526445.fixReason: The fix still detects zero-length overrides with a reference comparison of dayjs objects (`===`), which is always false, so such an override can count as available. It also accepts any slot that partially overlaps an override instead of requiring full containment, so slots straddling an override boundary are accepted.

1235b7335be786a39d20b1050e3b83719eaf6aae.titleReason: The title names the defect: the token is refreshed unconditionally and credential sync is bypassed, which matches the finding.
1235b7335be786a39d20b1050e3b83719eaf6aae.fixReason: fixStatus is not "local" (it is "insufficient-context"), so there is no improvedCode to grade.

e58cb6504fd63e9a5ae768202f8a028971c800fc.titleReason: The title names the defect: the retryCount update in the catch block is unprotected, and a failure there can abort the whole cron batch.
e58cb6504fd63e9a5ae768202f8a028971c800fc.fixReason: The update is now wrapped in its own try/catch so the retry increment is still attempted and its failures are contained, while the original error log on line 198 stays intact after the replaced lines.

fe26668ce769f8f7ad482f3b6a65f6e37f462220.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: an unhandled ZodError thrown during body validation.
fe26668ce769f8f7ad482f3b6a65f6e37f462220.fixReason: The fix handles schema failures with a 400 but leaves decryption and JSON-parse errors unhandled, so it misses the obligation to return 400 for invalid encrypted keys.

7458e34fe1150001c64b6129624e66ddaba181ea.titleReason: The title correctly says the dynamic imports in the appStore object run eagerly when the module is imported, which is the defect described.
7458e34fe1150001c64b6129624e66ddaba181ea.fixReason: Lazy getters keep all 28 keys and module paths, defer each import until its property is accessed, and still return promises, so existing `await appStore[key]` consumers keep working.

ed8c8f2e13b61a30b0c7e896ff3e203583423924.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: shifted override times wrap modulo 24 hours, losing their day displacement.
ed8c8f2e13b61a30b0c7e896ff3e203583423924.fixReason: It diffs the UTC-shaped wall-time endpoints against `startOfInviteeDay`, which is evidently not UTC-shaped (the reference re-anchors to `dayjs.utc(startOfInviteeDay.format('YYYY-MM-DD'))`), so the invitee offset is applied a second time, violating the no-double-offset obligation.

39515f537890ff348893768af17c40bbdbb042ba.titleReason: The title names the core defect: the recurring bulk delete runs repeatedly, once per calendar reference.
39515f537890ff348893768af17c40bbdbb042ba.fixReason: The replacement scopes the deletions to the current reference's credentialId, using the outer `calendar` and `credentialId` that are already in scope; it matches each occurrence's reference to that credential and uses its uid and externalCalendarId, while keeping the recurrence guard, the Promise.all error handling and the single-booking else branch.

b9aa410387efa9ebe41be0cbe8de43ecd48b3d1d.titleReason: The title correctly states that a Twilio failure causes the database delete to be skipped.
b9aa410387efa9ebe41be0cbe8de43ecd48b3d1d.fixReason: The replacement wraps the Twilio cancel in its own logged try/catch, so the prisma delete is still awaited when the cancel fails; it skips Twilio when referenceId is null and keeps the outer try/catch, matching every obligation.

93e671426253cab4574f8ae5981bbeefbee491c2.titleReason: The title correctly says the follow-up patch uses an undefined selectedCalendar, which is the defect described.
93e671426253cab4574f8ae5981bbeefbee491c2.fixReason: selectedCalendar now resolves to "primary" when no credential match exists, so the insert and the later patch use the same ID, while a matching destination's externalId is still preferred.

4893efccc1f624b28510ba2d0061549151849579.titleReason: The title states that the schema accepts duplicate guest emails, which leads to duplicate attendee rows, and this matches the defect.
4893efccc1f624b28510ba2d0061549151849579.fixReason: The refine rejects arrays containing repeated emails, keeps the email and numeric bookingId validation, and still accepts distinct valid emails, which the reference explicitly allows.

0bc32b8468cb446c00cc750d4ea17d27f344ce1a.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: the duplicate and blacklist email checks are case-sensitive.
0bc32b8468cb446c00cc750d4ea17d27f344ce1a.fixReason: The fix normalizes casing for the attendee and blacklist comparisons, but it does not deduplicate differently cased copies of the same new email within one request, so it misses that obligation.

7af4a5768d0bf1b4273fb803f96f197e93dccead.titleReason: The title states that the override bounds check only rejects disjoint slots instead of requiring containment, which is the defect the finding describes.
7af4a5768d0bf1b4273fb803f96f197e93dccead.fixReason: The single combined condition rejects slots that start before the converted override start or end after the converted override end, allows equality at both boundaries, keeps the return-true rejection semantics, and leaves the closing brace to existing line 125.

2de2892f2037c27ce3bd33bf1a2be10163f91a2d.titleReason: The title states the defect: Duplicate is wrongly enabled for data-source rules because of Grafana create permission.
2de2892f2037c27ce3bd33bf1a2be10163f91a2d.fixReason: Adding `!rule ||` to the MaybeSupported guard makes Duplicate unsupported when rule is undefined, keeps the loading and plugin-provided restrictions, and still requires create permission, matching the example fix.

164a55470ce0a71b1e0c3020556612be9e8792bf.titleReason: The title names the defect: the async forEach discards the promises from the calendar and video deletions.
164a55470ce0a71b1e0c3020556612be9e8792bf.fixReason: The improvedCode replaces the forEach with an awaited Promise.all over map, so deletions finish and rejections propagate before the emails and webhooks are sent, while the UID checks, type dispatch, optional calendar handling and deletion arguments stay unchanged.

0743cd02c001a5896f4006364275c67489056285.titleReason: The title states the defect: the global cleanup ticker now runs every minute, which raises DB/IO load.
0743cd02c001a5896f4006364275c67489056285.fixReason: The replacement restores the ten-minute ticker and keeps the startup tmp-file cleanup and the loop opening, so the existing select with context cancellation stays intact.

7c91f4aa8e74f1dbd75efb00a1dc5cb3bf1d066d.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: errors from asynchronous legacy writes are silently dropped, even though it mentions only Create.
7c91f4aa8e74f1dbd75efb00a1dc5cb3bf1d066d.fixReason: The replacement logs only the Create error, so the obligation to log legacy write errors for Delete, Update and DeleteCollection is unmet and the fix is partial.

f641a62d0f16ed5f6a94b3a3ca92cc1d4592b9d2.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the missing per-key synchronization that lets concurrent builds of the same index run in parallel, which is the defect described.
f641a62d0f16ed5f6a94b3a3ca92cc1d4592b9d2.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so no local fix is graded.

b3fd7057d5a876b2118099265fc264aed7c56bd2.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: per-strategy close/terminate shut down the queue pool that the factory shares across strategies.
b3fd7057d5a876b2118099265fc264aed7c56bd2.fixReason: The shutdown calls are removed, but both methods keep a timed join(timeout=5.0), so the retiring commit thread can outlive teardown and keep invoking its stale callback, missing the obligation to stop it before returning.

164122da1f487fa47557e9bfb84952457d92bfbf.titleReason: The title says join() breaks out of the loop and leaks the remaining hung processes, which is the defect the finding describes.
164122da1f487fa47557e9bfb84952457d92bfbf.fixReason: The fix removes the break but keeps the `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` guard, which SpawnProcess workers created by self.mp_context do not satisfy, so the remaining spawned processes are still never terminated.

53b395d07197c731b2699ee31aa50af68edefd1a.titleReason: The title names the defect: the commit callback is invoked from a background thread, which lets it race with the consumer's main thread.
53b395d07197c731b2699ee31aa50af68edefd1a.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

317e64a1232e951ce4ec5e192cfbba3ead6ee265.titleReason: The title claims FilteredPayload offsets skip tracking, which the reference says is incorrect; the real defect is that filtered payloads are routed through the decoder and its exception path.
317e64a1232e951ce4ec5e192cfbba3ead6ee265.fixReason: It checks message.value for FilteredPayload instead of message.payload, so a BrokerValue(FilteredPayload()) still goes to the decoder and fails into the exception handler, and the new branch would access partition/offset attributes FilteredPayload does not have.

00c4bf5b1c3ae9922fc5c043ff485b2562551e7a.titleReason: The title states the defect: error timestamps (seconds) are compared with rrweb timestamps (milliseconds) without unit conversion.
00c4bf5b1c3ae9922fc5c043ff485b2562551e7a.fixReason: Multiplying the error timestamp by 1000 puts both values in the same unit without losing precision, and it keeps the bounds check, the strict comparison, the stored values and the message formatting unchanged.

d14e5ce69bfa46ca02b7f50ea02c0e16c92eaa54.titleReason: The title names the defect: the worker queues are unbounded, so a traffic burst can exhaust memory.
d14e5ce69bfa46ca02b7f50ea02c0e16c92eaa54.fixReason: Setting maxsize=1000 bounds each queue, and the blocking put() applies backpressure without dropping messages; group hashing and FIFO order are preserved, and add_offset still runs before put().

9d4a213f00c564c08cdd73faf574fe3911082cad.titleReason: The title correctly says the redirect chain traversal depth is wrongly limited to 1000, which is the defect.
9d4a213f00c564c08cdd73faf574fe3911082cad.fixReason: The improved code restores the 10000 loop bound, keeps the break on missing or self redirects and the redirect_depth assignment, and leaves the separate 1000-member eviction cap untouched.

9e1184c885515fd731279efe6c236320c44cfe2d.titleReason: The title states the defect: the query cache key leaves out organization identity.
9e1184c885515fd731279efe6c236320c44cfe2d.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

811feadc921d41837ebca271bd85162d1d408cb8.titleReason: The title says the default SUM aggregation in ZUNIONSTORE corrupts the timestamp scores of duplicate spans used for eviction, which is the defect in the finding.
811feadc921d41837ebca271bd85162d1d408cb8.fixReason: The replacement adds AGGREGATE MAX to both zunionstore calls, keeps all other logic unchanged, and correctly leaves out the closing end, which lies outside the cited range.

ca6089827d6bd44987edf6831973a47b2cec84c3.titleReason: The title correctly says that remove_member leaves the user's primary_group_id pointing at the group they were removed from.
ca6089827d6bd44987edf6831973a47b2cec84c3.fixReason: The improvedCode keeps the membership deletion and clears primary_group_id only for that user and only when it equals this group's ID, matching all obligations.

218cfb5f0fa0b8185b855e47291e1ae08f89182e.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: fallback locale preloading happens only in the web-request set_locale path, so non-request paths are left uncovered.
218cfb5f0fa0b8185b855e47291e1ae08f89182e.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

a1f08c42bad444d7d1bc4a1f5cbbfcd95bc24915.titleReason: The title names the core defect, the missing `?` that keeps the inclusion hook from ever being called, but it leaves out the restricted-profile disclosure.
a1f08c42bad444d7d1bc4a1f5cbbfcd95bc24915.fixReason: The replacement defines the recognized `include_website_name?` hook, which omits website_name when the website is blank or when `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)` is true and includes it otherwise, so it meets every obligation.

d4bd9d7503ce14a20bcf8f9baf764350af94c86a.titleReason: The title names the NoMethodError raised for RSS items that lack content:encoded, which is the defect the finding describes.
d4bd9d7503ce14a20bcf8f9baf764350af94c86a.fixReason: The replacement falls back to description when content is nil, skips blank bodies with next so later items still import, and keeps scrub plus CGI.unescapeHTML, which meets every obligation.

47554a566123dc754f5e7a42f269864ab873e83d.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the zpopmin eviction can remove the segment's root span.
47554a566123dc754f5e7a42f269864ab873e83d.fixReason: If the root is among the popped members it is re-added, leaving 1001 members and breaking the 1000 cap; also `cmsgpack.unpack` on a JSON payload succeeds and returns a number (for '{', 123), so `decoded.span_id` raises an uncaught Lua error outside the pcall.

72d6fff99e3175779fbdd623856c7ac2e241859d.titleReason: The title names the defect: the error-handling test wrongly asserts that no commit happens after a processing failure.
72d6fff99e3175779fbdd623856c7ac2e241859d.fixReason: The improvedCode repeats the loop header and body lines 1913-1915, which sit outside the cited range, so substituting it leaves a redundant outer loop that spins 20 times with no sleep; the break condition also only checks that a commit exists, not that it equals 102, so an early 101 commit could make the test flaky.

2bd1bf5e22d7c03168d42f6b67ac41528e1a6feb.titleReason: The title names the SSRF caused by the unvalidated open-uri fetch in import_remote, which is the defect described.
2bd1bf5e22d7c03168d42f6b67ac41528e1a6feb.fixReason: The replacement disables redirects and checks scheme and port, but it never restricts the request to SiteSetting.embeddable_host (a required obligation), and it relies on URI.open and IPAddr#private?, which may not exist on this codebase's Ruby version.

548c26ece0a3d90c7563bda8b31115260c37c7f9.titleReason: The title correctly says the header flex layout breaks long-topic-title ellipsis and panel placement, which is the defect described.
548c26ece0a3d90c7563bda8b31115260c37c7f9.fixReason: The `> .ember-view` selector relies on a class not shown in the provided code, and it would likely also hit the `.title` logo component, letting the logo shrink and breaking the obligation to keep existing logo and panel sizing, which is why the reference excludes `.title` and `.panel`.

45dcbd510b4df1c1fa748870bc0cd05a52dba89f.titleReason: The title states that the unsubscribe action crashes when the user has no TopicUser record, which is the defect.
45dcbd510b4df1c1fa748870bc0cd05a52dba89f.fixReason: find_or_initialize_by returns a record tied to the current user and topic, and the nil level defaults to regular so the existing branch mutes it and save! persists it, while existing records keep their transitions.

0050f4d0024e47c05a254d913b2d82c35a88d869.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the migration crashes when the embed or uncategorized category settings are missing.
0050f4d0024e47c05a254d913b2d82c35a88d869.fixReason: The `cmd_tuples` guards do prevent the nil crash, but when the uncategorized setting is absent the code falls back to a hard-coded 0 rather than the application's default, missing that obligation.

e1b8528939b9aa7fa15864fa1693f55525704433.titleReason: The title correctly says the feature-flagged branch ignores the real table data and columns, which is the defect.
e1b8528939b9aa7fa15864fa1693f55525704433.fixReason: It passes raw field strings as columns (the reference notes this is invalid), uses unstripped fields without aliases, and passes result.meta directly with no safe defaults for missing fields or units.

140a3d9248566528a92e141f02e0ff40a2c961dd.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: offsets are marked complete even when processing fails.
140a3d9248566528a92e141f02e0ff40a2c961dd.fixReason: The replacement matches the example fix: it moves complete_offset into an else clause, so the offset completes only on success. It keeps logging and the ShutDown break, and the trailing finally still owns the metrics.gauge block, so metrics run on every attempt.

bd50fdd9ab85cbe1837528c8181f8464459e5f4b.titleReason: The title correctly says the shared login predicate wrongly filters out organization-linked brokers, which is the defect described.
bd50fdd9ab85cbe1837528c8181f8464459e5f4b.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

c14d991f97db631b0a6aaacd6e609854bcefb7a5.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: in-place downsizing leaves the Tempfile's descriptor stale.
c14d991f97db631b0a6aaacd6e609854bcefb7a5.fixReason: The new Tempfile is opened before ImageMagick writes to its path, so a rename-based write leaves the same stale (empty) descriptor that Upload.create_for and tempfile.size then use; a failed downsize swaps in an empty file, and the replaced tempfiles are closed without being unlinked, breaking cleanup.

47cb451f43ae78740c937e781d73e606e1f8b953.titleReason: The title correctly points at gaps blocking commits but says the commit stalls 'forever', which the reference says is wrong because committing the earlier prefix lets later scans move past the gap.
47cb451f43ae78740c937e781d73e606e1f8b953.fixReason: Walking the sorted delivered offsets (which mark_committed has already pruned to values above last_committed) skips absent offsets, stops at the first outstanding one, keeps the watermark check and the partition lock, and returns the same offset convention.

2f637f604371efb73501154760ba75fc98a1bbc6.titleReason: The title names the NPE in the hasPermission fallback path when the clients resource type resource is missing, which matches the finding.
2f637f604371efb73501154760ba75fc98a1bbc6.fixReason: The improved code adds a separate null guard that returns false before findByResource, keeps the empty-policies denial, and leaves the outer closing brace outside the cited lines, so the braces still balance.

cada16af8385d7f448cdf392002d344d553d35da.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: overlapping common prefix and suffix produce invalid substring bounds and throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
cada16af8385d7f448cdf392002d344d553d35da.fixReason: Clamping each substring on its own avoids the exception, but for overlapping cases like "aaa" vs "aa" both excerpts come out empty, so the diagnostic loses the differing content the reference requires.

c0c4f0ebd7f49b2d794fe16acf54d5e1a583c78d.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: Grafana rules lose the Pause/Resume action because only promRule is passed.
c0c4f0ebd7f49b2d794fe16acf54d5e1a583c78d.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

0ac057016b4874f111949fb76e7e9f4dd49795db.titleReason: The title names the defect: getSubGroups runs canView on every subgroup and skips the global fast path.
0ac057016b4874f111949fb76e7e9f4dd49795db.fixReason: The improved code matches the reference fix and meets every obligation: it computes global visibility once, short-circuits the per-subgroup check, keeps per-group filtering otherwise, and leaves parent authorization, search, pagination and mapping unchanged.

8b201c48fce4ae07d1313b65031563a7046be88f.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: the transformer only recognizes the literal `count()`, so equivalent forms are missed.
8b201c48fce4ae07d1313b65031563a7046be88f.fixReason: The hand-written parser accepts case-insensitive `count ( )` with internal and surrounding whitespace and an optional `as <alias>`, preserving the alias's original case or defaulting to `count`, while leaving other columns unchanged and in order; its only quirks are minor edge cases such as accepting malformed `count() asx`.

39e8d96e4656ab175097c1d74eff4adb51f9bad7.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: MetricAlertDetectorHandler leaves abstract methods unimplemented, which makes it non-instantiable.

80d0b0f6ee201de1060b8d1e242b5f68d4c242ee.titleReason: The title names the defect: outside the sharing flow, the placeholder refresh token overwrites valid stored tokens.

74e669923578b5de8178aafa482723a19eb699c3.titleReason: The title states the defect: date overrides skip the busy-time conflict check.

3e9b5b22ce86230c3fdbc2e8a7a523863afbe78f.titleReason: The title says that removing a member bypasses the counter-cache callbacks, which is the defect the finding describes.

1d3f3a96f317f46ec89f6814d95e296bd73abf91.fixReason: Replacing the statusText comparison with `!response.ok` accepts every 2xx response whatever its statusText, and still throws an HttpError on unsuccessful responses.

da86a00a5af49da38f02683a0cfec1fb4177d694.titleReason: The title names the defect: the automatic downsizing step corrupts SVG uploads.
da86a00a5af49da38f02683a0cfec1fb4177d694.fixReason: Adding `&& filename !~ /\.svg$/i` skips downsizing for SVG files regardless of case, keeps the same eligibility check and loop for other image formats, and leaves SVG bytes untouched for Upload.create_for.

fd5063180793c6fac25f83494d0ae215e6d737ac.titleReason: The title names the defect: passing the raw guest input causes existing attendees to be misclassified as newly added guests.
fd5063180793c6fac25f83494d0ae215e6d737ac.fixReason: Passing uniqueGuests, which the finding and reference both describe as the filtered list computed in the handler, means only actually-added guests are treated as new, while evt keeps the full attendee list.

e65a7b836161c7c0b04a03b2eaf3e2487dfedae3.titleReason: The title correctly says the refresh token schema strips the expiry fields and the provider-specific fields, which is the defect described.
e65a7b836161c7c0b04a03b2eaf3e2487dfedae3.fixReason: It requires a string access_token, keeps optional numeric expires_in and expiry_date, uses passthrough to preserve other fields such as refresh_token, and still allows responses with no expiry fields.

c324cf3362d3752bdf5d2f85bdf29e3fc9c7736a.titleReason: The title states the defect: a missing or unowned credential produces an internal server error instead of a client error.
c324cf3362d3752bdf5d2f85bdf29e3fc9c7736a.fixReason: The replacement throws a TRPCError with code NOT_FOUND, loaded by a dynamic import inside the async handler, so the cited lines alone fix the defect; the throw still stops cache deletion, and owned credentials still get deleted.

5be2f9fd733ba18604af305c098504e547f654f3.titleReason: The title names the defect: slots that start before the override hours are wrongly treated as available.
5be2f9fd733ba18604af305c098504e547f654f3.fixReason: Adding `slotStartTime.isBefore(...)` rejects slots that start before the offset-adjusted override start, still lets a slot starting exactly at the override start pass, and keeps the offset adjustment and `return true` semantics; the old end-time conditions it retains are redundant but harmless for positive event lengths.

8ae0d39f4470719bb62b52649ca00b3afe478736.titleReason: The title names the defect: because the returned base conditions have no enclosing parentheses, OR branches escape a predicate appended with AND.
8ae0d39f4470719bb62b52649ca00b3afe478736.fixReason: Every branch now returns a parenthesized Prisma.sql fragment, so an appended AND applies to all OR branches; the auth-and-filter intersection, parameterization and the deny-all 1=0 behavior are all kept.

ba7a2ccf190bd4c1536ada5ab826399e9c380cfd.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the connection is built with the stale access token instead of the refreshed one.

fdcbb4df977ff091d1f72dc8230714bd3f30df94.titleReason: The title names the defect: domain matching is unanchored, so emails from unapproved domains get past the allow-list.

9589d716a8bca749420683622aafa707f27600b1.titleReason: The title states the defect: gauges from different workers write to the same series and overwrite each other.

0197927e371ee2ac22cfeaf247eb6619122fb06e.titleReason: The title names the defect: dark-theme notification badges have insufficient text contrast, which matches the finding's dark-on-dark text problem.

46360b90e1cebcbc7a97f35c774838638206745a.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: when a day has several date overrides, slots get wrongly marked unavailable.
46360b90e1cebcbc7a97f35c774838638206745a.fixReason: The `some` check keeps the original overlap-only logic instead of requiring full containment, so it still accepts slots that run past an override's end into a gap, including a slot starting exactly at the override end, which misses the obligations to require a containing interval and to reject slots in gaps.

20f7dd332aa8faa31775be92d752924c0eacc9c2.titleReason: The title names the defect: the blacklist check can be bypassed using case variants or plus-address aliases.
20f7dd332aa8faa31775be92d752924c0eacc9c2.fixReason: Guests are normalized to a lowercase base address before the blacklist comparison, which closes both bypasses, and existing-attendee exclusion, the original guest strings, empty-blacklist behavior and the downstream error all stay intact.

fc0d613d660316315330606dd503b5f3174abead.titleReason: The title states the defect: a date override marks the slot available without checking busy times.
fc0d613d660316315330606dd503b5f3174abead.fixReason: Clearing the reassignable `workingHours` parameter skips the recurring-hours check for override days and falls through to the existing busy check, which rejects overlaps and allows endpoint-touching slots, while the `currentSeats` and non-override paths stay unchanged.

df68d4a5ebae656f3990ad77632388797694e222.titleReason: The title states the defect: split working-hours ranges on one day cause every slot to be rejected.
df68d4a5ebae656f3990ad77632388797694e222.fixReason: The fix still computes `end` from the slot start instead of the actual slot end, and it accepts slots on days that have no working-hours entry even when working hours are supplied, so it misses two obligations.

c272b69e89c52a8a00425219de987c4b46eaff36.titleReason: The title states the defect as the finding describes it: the token refresh runs on every client creation and bypasses credential sync.
c272b69e89c52a8a00425219de987c4b46eaff36.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

ff27943ec2381100a439a2e1aa13cbbeb7bdb63e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the catch block runs a retryCount update with no protection, and a failure there can abort the whole cron batch.
ff27943ec2381100a439a2e1aa13cbbeb7bdb63e.fixReason: The fix wraps the retryCount update in its own try/catch, so it is still attempted and its failures are contained, and the original error log on line 198 stays in place after the replacement.

18132917dd57cd0edbf2abc0e6328a3738a89b9a.titleReason: The title names both defects: the end bound is never checked and days with several working-hour ranges are wrongly rejected.
18132917dd57cd0edbf2abc0e6328a3738a89b9a.fixReason: The end computation and the `some` containment are correct, but when working hours are supplied and none apply to the slot's day, `dayWorkingHours` is empty and the check is skipped, so the slot is accepted instead of rejected as the obligation requires.

d29c4513cf25b84919ce5d2366159ca1ecb4ee4a.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring bulk delete runs again for every calendar reference, which causes the duplicate deletions.
d29c4513cf25b84919ce5d2366159ca1ecb4ee4a.fixReason: The fix scopes each iteration's recurring deletions to the current reference's resolved credential, using the outer `credentialId` and `calendar`, and matches each occurrence's reference by `credentialId`. It uses that reference's `uid` and `externalCalendarId`, keeps the recurrence guard, the `Promise.all` error handling and the single-booking path, and is syntactically valid.

642f60d6011759d63443413b80b1f017cff5363d.titleReason: The title states the defect: a Twilio cancel failure causes the reminder row deletion to be skipped.
642f60d6011759d63443413b80b1f017cff5363d.fixReason: The improved code wraps cancelSMS in its own try/catch with logging, so the delete is always attempted and awaited; a null referenceId skips Twilio, and the outer catch still contains DB errors.

04e66d0395bb6f97bbec03748597543ecf427903.titleReason: The title names the actual defect: the recurring cancellation ignores the reference's credential, so co-host calendar events are not deleted.
04e66d0395bb6f97bbec03748597543ecf427903.fixReason: It deletes through the already-resolved `calendar` from `calendarCredential` (which covers DB-loaded credentials) and matches each occurrence's reference by `credentialId`, using that reference's uid and externalCalendarId; braces stay balanced and the existing push and awaited Promise.all are kept.

86eb8dcf8d6784e271de6f981dbf8bae10bfd8d2.titleReason: The title names the defect: cache deletion does not invalidate connectedCalendars, so a stale cache date stays on screen.
86eb8dcf8d6784e271de6f981dbf8bae10bfd8d2.fixReason: The improvedCode adds an onSettled callback that invalidates connectedCalendars without depending on the parent callback, keeps both toasts and the optional onSuccess call, and can use utils because the callback runs after line 52 declares it.

87840e54410b63194b8ebac94656cd25defe3de0.titleReason: The title names the defect: the app store imports run eagerly when the module loads, which defeats the intended lazy loading.
87840e54410b63194b8ebac94656cd25defe3de0.fixReason: The answer's fixStatus is "needs-wider-change", not "local", so no fix is graded.

3b2dd6a777d1996e82e6c7801d90f8b7ff0d8d85.titleReason: The title names the defect: override times that cross midnight wrap around after the timezone shift, which is what the finding describes.
3b2dd6a777d1996e82e6c7801d90f8b7ff0d8d85.fixReason: The fix diffs the UTC-shaped shifted endpoints (which already hold invitee wall time) directly against `startOfInviteeDay`, a real invitee-zone instant, so the invitee offset is applied a second time, violating that obligation; the reference avoids this by rebuilding a UTC midnight from the invitee calendar date.

ec4a59dbd076d9b108e6c57a38b08791fe212bf0.titleReason: The title describes the defect: slots that only partly fit inside the override window are accepted because the check only rejects disjoint slots.
ec4a59dbd076d9b108e6c57a38b08791fe212bf0.fixReason: The replacement rejects a slot that starts before the override start or ends after the override end, allows equality at both boundaries, keeps the return-true rejection semantics, and leaves the closing brace on line 125 outside the replaced range.

caba24cf437668cf4959977352482490384a1ed7.titleReason: The title states that case-sensitive guest checks let duplicates and blacklisted addresses through, which is the defect the finding describes.
caba24cf437668cf4959977352482490384a1ed7.fixReason: The fix makes the attendee and blacklist comparisons case-insensitive but does not dedupe differently cased copies of the same new email within one request, so it misses the at-most-one-occurrence obligation.

8807eba17d136e631054443a07415a7a7b5e78ae.titleReason: The title says Duplicate is wrongly enabled for an undefined rule (skipToken) because AlwaysSupported is used, which is the defect the finding describes.
8807eba17d136e631054443a07415a7a7b5e78ae.fixReason: Adding `!rule ||` to the MaybeSupported guard makes Duplicate unsupported when the rule is undefined, keeps the loading and plugin-provided restrictions, and still requires Grafana create permission for eligible rules.

122c10bfc4798f0cc209ffb8045660ccbd7d2c32.titleReason: The title names the defect: the async forEach throws away the calendar and video deletion promises during reschedule.
122c10bfc4798f0cc209ffb8045660ccbd7d2c32.fixReason: Wrapping the logic in `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(async ...))` waits for every deletion before the emails and webhooks run, lets failures reach the enclosing async handler, and keeps the UID checks, type dispatch, optional calendar handling and deletion arguments unchanged.

f227c6f84af3c3eb916d40acda91d31eec404604.titleReason: The title names the defect: a malformed body throws an unhandled ZodError and returns 500 instead of 400.
f227c6f84af3c3eb916d40acda91d31eec404604.fixReason: The safeParse replacement returns 400 for schema failures but does not cover the reference obligation to return 400 for undecryptable keys or invalid JSON after decryption, so those requests still throw at lines 57-59.

1e6cfbeec02e2013405908fa0502b7994862a25b.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: once the deadline passes, join() no longer terminates the remaining flusher processes.
1e6cfbeec02e2013405908fa0502b7994862a25b.fixReason: The fix removes the break but keeps the isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) guard, which does not match the SpawnProcess workers created by mp_context, so the spawned processes are still never terminated.

78d8210c016242d1f687b753c211650b7a0fcdf4.titleReason: The title names the defect: the schema accepts duplicate guest emails, which leads to duplicate attendee records.
78d8210c016242d1f687b753c211650b7a0fcdf4.fixReason: The refine rejects any request with repeated emails while keeping email-format and numeric bookingId validation, and its only extra strictness (rejecting case-only variants) matches the separately tracked case-insensitive concern rather than breaking distinct-email requests.

c5d0b6025015d5bd837069b0d7b6b4754abbb53e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the shared cleanup ticker was cut to one minute, so every cleanup job runs ten times as often.
c5d0b6025015d5bd837069b0d7b6b4754abbb53e.fixReason: The replacement puts the ticker back at ten minutes, keeps the immediate cleanUpTmpFiles call, and leaves the loop structure intact, so periodic cleanup and context cancellation in the following lines still work.

cbb40b98e4f7884b5a674909377e6ed4823f74dc.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: FilteredPayload messages are sent to the decoder rather than being handled as filtered, which is the problem the reference describes.
cbb40b98e4f7884b5a674909377e6ed4823f74dc.fixReason: The fix checks message.payload for FilteredPayload before decoding and records and completes the BrokerValue offset with no enqueue or failure log, while leaving the decoding, grouping, submission and None-result paths unchanged.

cb41deefcbd7fd2ed1512354bc8e20d876765515.titleReason: The title states the defect: the test asserts that no commit happens after a failure, yet the offsets do get committed, so the assertion contradicts real behavior.
cb41deefcbd7fd2ed1512354bc8e20d876765515.fixReason: The loop now waits until the committed offset reaches 102, the assertions fail on timeout if that commit is never observed, and the check that the processor was called twice is kept, so all obligations are met with valid names and indentation.

f9464f2f01cec7f080d83cf247665c31f359c432.titleReason: The title names the defect: error timestamps in seconds are compared against replay event timestamps in milliseconds.
f9464f2f01cec7f080d83cf247665c31f359c432.fixReason: Multiplying the error timestamp by 1000 puts both values in the same unit without losing fractional precision, and it keeps the bounds check, the strict comparison, the stored values and the message formatting unchanged.

fa6f17880af00e0b56e394773a7f049d2e70fe2e.titleReason: The title states the defect, that span eviction can drop the segment root span from the buffer, and it does not describe a fix.

deb1b9ed09383c5b574817c24a8302ad6f7396f0.titleReason: The title names the actual defect: work queues are unbounded, there is no backpressure, and memory can run out.
deb1b9ed09383c5b574817c24a8302ad6f7396f0.fixReason: Every queue gets a finite maxsize, and a blocking put() supplies backpressure without dropping anything; group hashing, FIFO order, and registering the offset before put() all stay the same, matching the reference.

fe255492dd431ba9781b18aa886e032e6ea15c98.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: Arroyo's commit callback is invoked from a background thread and races the consumer's main loop.

241b6d3d2bc134b77a3cd7cade105d031742c9a2.titleReason: The title says that plain RSS items lacking content:encoded crash the feed import, which is the nil `content` NoMethodError defect.

96f4735850791a26ec8656d74b13c04851be77ad.titleReason: The title names the SSRF defect: open-uri fetches an attacker-controllable embed URL and follows redirects, which matches the finding.

f7ef34514d9e8ae0b0816463fab45798ba859c9d.titleReason: The title names the defect: unsubscribe crashes when no TopicUser record exists for the user and topic.
f7ef34514d9e8ae0b0816463fab45798ba859c9d.fixReason: find_or_initialize_by returns a record tied to the current user and topic, `.to_i` treats a nil level as below regular so the existing branch mutes it, and existing records follow the same transitions before the existing save! persists them.

bb8f1da01145812e2e6e6b132af6667d20d1e42e.titleReason: The title names the defect: committing stops at Kafka offset gaps in a partition. 'Permanently' overstates it, since the reference says the blockage clears after a later commit, but the core problem is correctly identified.
bb8f1da01145812e2e6e6b132af6667d20d1e42e.fixReason: Iterating over the sorted delivered offsets skips absent offsets and stops at the first outstanding one, while keeping last_committed, the lock context and the existing return convention, which meets all obligations.

40bda82334b37a89659197468ab36be40b40ca23.titleReason: The title names the defect: after downsizing, the open Tempfile handle can be stale and miss the downsized image.
40bda82334b37a89659197468ab36be40b40ca23.fixReason: The loop checks `File.size(tempfile.path)` against the current file, and after downsizing it reopens and rewinds the Tempfile, so `Upload.create_for` gets the current content from the start and `tempfile.size` returns the current size; the five-attempt bound, eligibility checks, 80% reduction, animation option and cleanup are all kept.

ec803dd6fecb93494820dccc5ada17099346a432.titleReason: The title states the defect: upsampling skips `count()` columns that are aliased or have whitespace variants.
ec803dd6fecb93494820dccc5ada17099346a432.fixReason: The case-insensitive anchored regex on the stripped column rewrites zero-argument counts with inner whitespace or an explicit alias, keeps the alias and its case, defaults to `count`, and leaves other columns unchanged and in order.

1eb09fff29ae0b9f97f9e2419aa39d922f282854.titleReason: The title names the defect: the migration crashes when the category site-setting queries return no rows.
1eb09fff29ae0b9f97f9e2419aa39d922f282854.fixReason: It still calls `[0]` on the PG::Result, which raises IndexError on an empty result (the file guards `[0]` with `cmd_tuples > 0` elsewhere), so the crash remains, and the absent-setting fallback is a hardcoded 0 rather than the application's default.

c4623ca386fd018d917004ef7048386dd68b60c8.titleReason: The title says the org broker-visibility clause in the shared login predicate hides linked IDPs, which is the defect described.
c4623ca386fd018d917004ef7048386dd68b60c8.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so no improvedCode needs grading.

e0dea6fc0721d42ed9e82c5f851e5714c6698341.titleReason: The title names the defect: a common prefix and suffix that overlap make substring throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
e0dea6fc0721d42ed9e82c5f851e5714c6698341.fixReason: Limiting end to each length minus start keeps start <= length-end for both strings, including empty and overlapping cases, while keeping the differing content and the full diagnostic message, matching the reference fix.

457166a9c102a1ae051fee2e70eef2bf0c75b211.titleReason: The title names the NPE that occurs in the fallback path when the Clients resource-type resource is missing, which matches the finding.
457166a9c102a1ae051fee2e70eef2bf0c75b211.fixReason: The added null guard returns false before findByResource is called, the existing policy-empty check and the later evaluation are kept, and the outer closing brace stays outside the replaced lines.

e6e004a2ad587538ae23f05b447dacfce6e3beed.titleReason: The title states that getSubGroups runs canView for every subgroup and has lost the global-view fast path, which is the defect the finding describes.

1613fbec03104290dc1895c3d70a80e9e85e3209.titleReason: The title names the defect, which is that the Pause/Resume action is missing for Grafana rules in the new list view, and it does not describe a fix.

169ef36aced916118a2f1c44b214eaa2cc83fd5b.titleReason: The title says the legacy update recomputes the patch from objInfo rather than using the stored object, which is the defect the finding describes.
169ef36aced916118a2f1c44b214eaa2cc83fd5b.fixReason: The answer wraps objInfo and res in the existing updateWrapper, so legacy gets the committed object while preconditions still come from upstream, and the other arguments and errObjectSt are unchanged.

3d4c2e1d2cf411a8362cffe10ba497da5b799f3f.titleReason: The title names the defect: a device over the limit stays cached and is let in on the next request, which matches the finding.
3d4c2e1d2cf411a8362cffe10ba497da5b799f3f.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so no fix is graded.

730196b300efdda03e3e8aa60a595357235499b5.fixReason: On NotFound the code falls through to the unchanged line 106, which records `recordStorageDuration(false, ...)`, so a NotFound is logged as a successful deletion and the metrics obligation is missed.

98b450ff011cfe59c36d2e05c397b4636cacf3c5.titleReason: The title says the refresh flow persists the Zod SafeParse wrapper instead of the parsed credential key, which is the defect the finding describes.
98b450ff011cfe59c36d2e05c397b4636cacf3c5.fixReason: Taking `.data` from the parse result stores the parsed credentials, keeps validation in place before the write, and leaves the same update call and refresh flow unchanged, with the closing delimiter still outside the cited lines.

e511819dcff5bfd1d7df359d7ce07202405f5652.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: TotalDocs reads b.cache without holding cacheMu, which races with BuildIndex's writes.
e511819dcff5bfd1d7df359d7ce07202405f5652.fixReason: TotalDocs now takes the exclusive cacheMu lock and releases it with defer, so its map access is synchronized with BuildIndex; the summing, the error-skipping, and BuildIndex's locked insertion are all unchanged.

512dec700c25945bfbc3773d45f95de97f5928a8.titleReason: The title names the defect accurately: a backup-code login skips the password check when a dummy totpCode is sent.
512dec700c25945bfbc3773d45f95de97f5928a8.fixReason: The fix rejects requests that carry both backupCode and totpCode before any backup code is consumed, which matches the example fix and keeps the password-authenticated backup-code path and the TOTP-only path unchanged.

8079a8a4874270baf66037a28548e77d88c6cb81.titleReason: The title names the defect: the cleanup targets the literal alias "alias" rather than the IDPs the test created.
8079a8a4874270baf66037a28548e77d88c6cb81.fixReason: The improvedCode registers cleanup for "idp-alias-" + i inside the loop and for "idp-alias-20" for the extra provider, and leaves the setup, organization associations, and cache assertions unchanged, which is the same as the example fix.

1e40c06e538fb67cab439a8a96bd08cd04569d9f.titleReason: The title says the all-clients grant is ignored whenever a per-client resource exists, which is the defect described.
1e40c06e538fb67cab439a8a96bd08cd04569d9f.fixReason: The replacement accepts a per-client grant through hasGrantedPermission, then falls through to the all-clients resource with a null and empty-policy guard, so the existing evaluation below handles the global grant and denies when neither grants it, while the same-realm and server checks above stay untouched.

5cad2d0a7bc55c65e0ecc2a4b6bdcbed271ff927.titleReason: The title says the enabled-flag test passes even without the enabled check, which is the defect: the test is vacuous.
5cad2d0a7bc55c65e0ecc2a4b6bdcbed271ff927.fixReason: The replacement keeps feed_polling_enabled? false, stubs the URL and username to the existing let values, and keeps the never-poll assertion, so it meets every obligation.

80fd8aea8e516d3e2ccefdc647b994a34e1461b2.titleReason: The title says the forbidden assertion can be satisfied by getDefaultClientScopes rather than by the removal call, which is the defect the finding describes.
80fd8aea8e516d3e2ccefdc647b994a34e1461b2.fixReason: The replacement fetches the scope through the privileged realm.admin() client outside the try, calls only removeDefaultClientScope through the restricted client, and keeps fail plus the ForbiddenException assertion; it uses a distinct variable name that does not clash with the later clientScopeRep and leaves the authorized removal test intact.

4b4bf9e042c76ae2075e79b8498b4b0c65cc3fc1.titleReason: The title says group creation ignores alias_level and loses the selected level, which is exactly the defect.
4b4bf9e042c76ae2075e79b8498b4b0c65cc3fc1.fixReason: The improvedCode assigns alias_level with the same to_i/present? conversion used in update, keeps the default when the value is absent, and leaves name trimming, visibility, and save behavior unchanged.

0dc7075403987d64ec162daf8f632e3a9d1e587c.titleReason: The title names the defect: canExchangeTo throws UnsupportedOperationException, which breaks token exchange instead of returning a decision.
0dc7075403987d64ec162daf8f632e3a9d1e587c.fixReason: Returning false keeps the method signature, gives a fail-closed boolean decision instead of throwing, and meets every listed obligation.

50106bba32e7d34e0049f931dffc8d2475d95f21.titleReason: The title names the defect from the finding: a stale member-fetch response that arrives late can overwrite a newer page or a refresh.

9671cb41215e3a2648c3cbad9163399df853bdc0.titleReason: The title names the defect: a plain Error is thrown for a missing credential, so the caller gets a 500 instead of a client error.

dbba99228f098fc830331ad38145f3957f1ddf09.titleReason: The title names the defect: unparenthesized OR conditions break operator precedence when the fragment is embedded in a larger expression.
dbba99228f098fc830331ad38145f3957f1ddf09.fixReason: Every non-deny branch is now wrapped in parentheses, so an appended AND applies to all OR branches; the auth/filter intersection, parameterized Prisma.sql, and the deny-all 1=0 (an atomic predicate needing no parentheses) are all preserved.

d8263d85e74ba25203e5caa0b42510e4acaa0026.titleReason: The title says the connection is built with a stale access token after the refresh, which is the defect the finding describes.

461b76f21d58aea5a756912e8db7296074f9c9a9.titleReason: The title names the defect: slots that start before the override window get marked available, which matches the finding.
461b76f21d58aea5a756912e8db7296074f9c9a9.fixReason: Replacing the end-time check with slotStartTime.isBefore(offset-adjusted start) rejects early-starting slots and still lets an exact-start slot through; the offset adjustment and the return-true rejection behave as before, and slots that end at or before the override start are still rejected because they also start before it.

663219c5f6728bc4f83513d46c1bb479435410f5.fixReason: The `some` check (`slotEndTime.isAfter(range.start) && !slotStartTime.isAfter(range.end)`) only tests overlap, not full containment, so it accepts slots that extend past an override's start or end or straddle a gap, which misses the containment obligation.

f42feec3d14c30aa6670eabe5409208a95b5d66d.fixReason: It iterates only the resolved `calendarCredential` (including one loaded from the DB) and matches each occurrence's reference by `credentialId`, which equals that credential's id; it deletes using that reference's `uid` and `externalCalendarId` and leaves the push and the `Promise.all` error handling intact.

41b923a8c48a60dfc9282cda35c4bb8b0d7f2aa7.titleReason: The title names the defect: unauthenticated embed requests can enqueue an unbounded number of RetrieveTopic jobs.
41b923a8c48a60dfc9282cda35c4bb8b0d7f2aa7.fixReason: Discourse's Redis-backed RateLimiter, keyed on the client IP, caps enqueueing across workers independent of the URL while still letting anonymous retrieval through within the limit and leaving existing-topic rendering untouched; this depends on that existing Discourse class, which is not shown in the provided code.

253e038b8b9b386cfec7b65e2385e37cd80f506d.titleReason: The title names the defect: a date override returns early and skips the busy-time overlap check.
253e038b8b9b386cfec7b65e2385e37cd80f506d.fixReason: Clearing the reassignable `workingHours` parameter lets override slots skip the recurring working-hours check and fall through to the existing busy check, which rejects overlaps and allows endpoint-touching slots, while the currentSeats and non-override paths are unchanged.

d25ad6737fe662ab9c5e72a4e31c8ef41555adc1.titleReason: The title names both defects: the end bound is ignored, and slots on days with several working-hour ranges are wrongly rejected.
d25ad6737fe662ab9c5e72a4e31c8ef41555adc1.fixReason: The fix gates on `workingHoursForDay.length > 0`, so when working hours are supplied but none cover the slot's day, the slot is accepted instead of rejected, which misses the obligation to reject slots outside every applicable interval.

aede8eacfef9b86c1061b7e10d7f76f5e6a45ad5.titleReason: The title names the defect: the deleteCache mutation does not invalidate the connectedCalendars query, so a stale cacheUpdatedAt stays visible.
aede8eacfef9b86c1061b7e10d7f76f5e6a45ad5.fixReason: The code adds an onSettled that invalidates connectedCalendars and keeps the success toast, the optional onSuccess call and the error toast; utils is declared later but is only read inside the deferred callback, so it is defined when that callback runs.

7a3fca6685313c7d0498f48d5806116bec67f2c2.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: the app store's dynamic imports run eagerly when the module loads instead of lazily.
7a3fca6685313c7d0498f48d5806116bec67f2c2.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

4f4b4a2f958b85a0916de860f728b20033b99835.titleReason: The title names the defect: override endpoints wrap past midnight after the timezone shift, which produces slots on the wrong day or no slots.
4f4b4a2f958b85a0916de860f728b20033b99835.fixReason: It drops the organizer-to-invitee offset conversion and uses a direct .tz(timeZone).diff, which the reference says is not equivalent because override dates encode organizer wall time in UTC-shaped values, so it breaks the 'preserve existing offset conversion' obligation.

b7aa7647fb846dea90be4f47d2974fd48eef8307.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring bulk delete runs once for every calendar reference.
b7aa7647fb846dea90be4f47d2974fd48eef8307.fixReason: Gating the block on the first reference does not scope deletions to that reference's credential. It still matches only the first calendar reference of each occurrence and deletes it through every organizer credential, so co-host events are still not deleted with their own credentials.

ed1157c165f25f5367600cc2910c99f954f9024a.titleReason: The title names the defect: an unprotected retryCount update in the catch block whose failure can abort the whole cron batch.
ed1157c165f25f5367600cc2910c99f954f9024a.fixReason: The update still runs and is wrapped in its own try/catch so remaining reminders keep processing, and the original error is still logged; the only side effect is that line 198 stays outside the replacement, so the error is logged twice, which is harmless redundancy rather than broken behavior.

42ce9277c4d2f6c0344a08076d2d7620fdddfad0.titleReason: The title states the defect: slots are wrongly rejected on days that have multiple working-hours ranges.
42ce9277c4d2f6c0344a08076d2d7620fdddfad0.fixReason: The `some`-based containment and the real slot end fix the split-day case, but the check is skipped entirely when no interval matches the slot's weekday, so slots on non-working days pass even when working hours are supplied, missing the obligation to reject slots outside all applicable intervals.

a3a835a189751488a1c9b7b4da730a254f4fc35d.titleReason: The title names the defect: a failed Twilio cancel skips deleting the reminder row.
a3a835a189751488a1c9b7b4da730a254f4fc35d.fixReason: The try/finally always attempts and awaits the prisma delete, whether or not Twilio rejects, and still calls Twilio only when referenceId is set; any error then reaches the existing outer catch, which logs and contains it, and the syntax fits that catch.

8f59ece0e8ab0ee65b47a00ab38ac1da7a7d65e7.titleReason: The title names the defect: the containment check is too loose and accepts slots that only partially overlap the override.
8f59ece0e8ab0ee65b47a00ab38ac1da7a7d65e7.fixReason: The replacement rejects slots that start before the override start or end after the override end, allows equality at both boundaries, keeps the return-true rejection semantics, and leaves the closing brace on line 125.

086f24cda852e6b19a9d120367a57783b258f113.titleReason: The title states that the addGuests schema accepts duplicate guest emails, which is the defect described.
086f24cda852e6b19a9d120367a57783b258f113.fixReason: The refine rejects requests that repeat an email, even with different case or spacing, so repeated emails can no longer create duplicate attendee rows; email and numeric bookingId validation are unchanged, and distinct valid emails are still accepted.

ba6627a7ebbb83f9e6eee05edc30bd985385624f.titleReason: The title says Duplicate is wrongly enabled when the rule is undefined (skipToken) in the Grafana prom ability hook, which is the defect described.
ba6627a7ebbb83f9e6eee05edc30bd985385624f.fixReason: Adding a `!rule` guard to MaybeSupported makes Duplicate unsupported for an undefined rule, keeps the loading and plugin-provided restrictions and the create-permission requirement, and uses only names that already exist.

6e7c7becb08fd5993be16fb11785a05a7497a1ba.titleReason: The title names the defect: the shared cleanup ticker interval was cut from 10 minutes to 1 minute.
6e7c7becb08fd5993be16fb11785a05a7497a1ba.fixReason: The replacement restores the 10-minute ticker, keeps the immediate cleanUpTmpFiles call and the loop opening, and leaves the select/ctx.Done handling intact.

beced5b417b39708655891ff3d89f3fa00e4f776.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: close/terminate shut down the factory-shared queue pool that new strategies still use.
beced5b417b39708655891ff3d89f3fa00e4f776.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so no local fix was provided to grade.

eb182b21f2b40da27402eada11141122d48f17d7.titleReason: The title states the defect: the calendar and video deletions in the reschedule request are not awaited because of the async forEach.
eb182b21f2b40da27402eada11141122d48f17d7.fixReason: Wrapping the map in an awaited Promise.all makes the handler wait for every calendar load and deletion and propagate rejections, while keeping the UID check, the type dispatch, the optional calendar handling and the deletion arguments unchanged.

e5d3cc18717b79d2b78900942b4a2445d7e70e34.titleReason: The title names the defect: join() breaks out of the loop when the deadline passes, so the remaining flusher processes are never terminated.
e5d3cc18717b79d2b78900942b4a2445d7e70e34.fixReason: It still guards termination with isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process), which does not match the SpawnProcess workers created by self.mp_context, so remaining spawned processes are still not terminated.

fa124ea8963745f9af01429b44c2e75905dbc6a4.titleReason: The title names the defect: the commit callback is invoked from a background thread rather than the processor's main thread.
fa124ea8963745f9af01429b44c2e75905dbc6a4.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so no local fix is graded.

2b29a2ddac24ca089dd48e4e6615bde575173882.titleReason: The title correctly says the query key leaves out the organization, so cached attribute keys leak across orgs, which matches the finding's defect.
2b29a2ddac24ca089dd48e4e6615bde575173882.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

d5e890a34f38d43b361aabcc35c7170c1c14d4ff.titleReason: The title says the work queues are unbounded, which leaves no backpressure and risks running out of memory, and that is exactly the defect described.
d5e890a34f38d43b361aabcc35c7170c1c14d4ff.fixReason: The fix sets a finite maxsize so put() blocks when a queue is full, which applies backpressure without dropping messages, keeps the same hashing and FIFO order, and still calls add_offset before put.

d06ed92cc4fa1aa88a30761e67200c9ad3e982d2.titleReason: The title says the zpopmin eviction can drop the segment root span, which is the defect described.
d06ed92cc4fa1aa88a30761e67200c9ad3e982d2.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so the fix is not graded.

d4be850e3a40c9628a7d127689999b6352b20879.titleReason: The title names the defect: the default SUM aggregation corrupts the scores of duplicate spans, which matches the finding.
d4be850e3a40c9628a7d127689999b6352b20879.fixReason: The improved code adds AGGREGATE MAX to both zunionstore calls and keeps the membership, span_count assignment, conditions, and unlink cleanup exactly as they were, with the closing end correctly left outside the cited range.

7ed5b1578f9b208286c5a88db6663274341c0678.titleReason: The title says the redirect-chase limit was cut from 10000 to 1000 and that this breaks deep segment trees, which is the defect.
7ed5b1578f9b208286c5a88db6663274341c0678.fixReason: The fix restores the loop bound to 10000, keeps the early break and the redirect_depth assignment, and leaves the 1000 eviction cap separate; the added Lua comment is valid syntax.

d9617fc804a3acedad611d27040bf84b88128c18.titleReason: The title repeats the finding's blanket claim that filtered offsets are never tracked, but the reference says BrokerValue-wrapped filtered messages do get their offsets completed through the exception handler; the real defect is that filtered payloads are sent to the decoder and handled as errors.
d9617fc804a3acedad611d27040bf84b88128c18.fixReason: It checks message.payload for FilteredPayload before calling the decoder, then adds and completes the offset and returns without logging or enqueueing, while leaving decoding, grouping, submission and None-result handling unchanged.

8e56b17937c4391213e016bb71a8f3003f9c3956.titleReason: The title names the defect: making .contents a flex container lets the header-extra-info item overflow, which breaks the title ellipsis.
8e56b17937c4391213e016bb71a8f3003f9c3956.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no fix to grade.

d21ebed77878159c5a9b5206a8d330adceb3b0b4.titleReason: The title names the defect: website_name is not hidden for restricted users, and it ties this to the missing `?` on the include method.
d21ebed77878159c5a9b5206a8d330adceb3b0b4.fixReason: The replacement defines the recognized `include_website_name?` hook, omits website_name when the website is blank or when `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)` is true, and allows it otherwise, which meets every obligation.

d287fbba33db3867aa8bf2d9b599bed60dbf6901.titleReason: The title states the defect: the public members page shows only the first 50 members and has no pagination.
d287fbba33db3867aa8bf2d9b599bed60dbf6901.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so no improvedCode is graded.

0e4ae030a5d5aa75c235632f1210bc1c0f1c132f.titleReason: The title names the defect: the unsubscribe action raises NoMethodError when the user has no TopicUser record.
0e4ae030a5d5aa75c235632f1210bc1c0f1c132f.fixReason: find_or_initialize_by returns a record tied to the current user and requested topic, a new record defaults to regular so the existing branch mutes it, existing records keep their transitions, and the existing save! persists the change.

82fb35205f43f6c557eb8c53411a7a0118478e36.titleReason: The title names the defect: the test asserts that no commit happens, while the real behavior commits offset 102.
82fb35205f43f6c557eb8c53411a7a0118478e36.fixReason: The replacement waits up to 3 seconds for a commit, fails if none is observed, asserts the committed offset is 102 and keeps the two-call check, which meets every obligation (there is a small remaining race if a commit of 101 lands first).

e04bbfa6b11973c2dc87bad81f64c2d5086200f3.titleReason: The title names the defect: after in-place downsizing, the open Tempfile can keep reading the stale original inode.
e04bbfa6b11973c2dc87bad81f64c2d5086200f3.fixReason: Calling tempfile.open after each downsize reopens the handle at position zero, so the later tempfile.size and Upload.create_for see the current content; the loop check via File.size is equivalent, and the five-attempt bound, eligibility checks, 80% reduction, animation option and cleanup are all kept.

d9d0b884c018784a8225a1eb6cf8da7e32d72885.titleReason: The title states that the feature-flagged TableWidgetVisualization renders empty columns and data, which matches the defect.
d9d0b884c018784a8225a1eb6cf8da7e32d72885.fixReason: The fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

02934dc3d444ce2f27eca7ff16fb8b0107a0789d.titleReason: The title names the SSRF from fetching an attacker-influenced URL with open(url) in import_remote, which is the defect described.
02934dc3d444ce2f27eca7ff16fb8b0107a0789d.fixReason: It blocks redirects, restricts scheme and port, and makes non-success responses raise, but it never checks that uri.host matches SiteSetting.embeddable_host, so it misses the obligation to restrict the initial request to the configured host.

e15a991bca63c926f16fbd44e7df145e1dac8fa4.titleReason: The title states the defect: failed messages are marked complete and their offsets committed, so they are dropped.
e15a991bca63c926f16fbd44e7df145e1dac8fa4.fixReason: When result_processor raises queue.ShutDown, the flag is never set, so the finally block still completes the offset, leaving interrupted work committable against the obligation; the `__dict__` flag also assumes WorkItem has an instance dict, which the shown code does not establish.

ad7b47b8ec9cecdb4a2aa33f31d00f163e49a70e.titleReason: The title states the defect: the cleanup listener ignores the V2 feature flag and can throw, which matches the finding.
ad7b47b8ec9cecdb4a2aa33f31d00f163e49a70e.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no fix to grade.

2d021359ee7fffdb52a61a996d270435da2f4826.titleReason: The title names the defect: offset commits stall at a gap in Kafka offsets, which matches the finding, though the reference notes the stall is not actually permanent.
2d021359ee7fffdb52a61a996d270435da2f4826.fixReason: Walking the sorted delivered offsets above last_committed and stopping at the first outstanding one skips absent offsets, stops at earlier pending work, keeps the watermark and lock, and returns the processed offset by the existing convention.

6ec0ab3aadca855ad115a1e6bb9ba7cc7a920b51.titleReason: The title names the defect: the org/BROKER_PUBLIC clause added to the shared getLoginPredicate wrongly filters the already-linked IDP listing.
6ec0ab3aadca855ad115a1e6bb9ba7cc7a920b51.fixReason: The new getLoginCachePredicate has no callers, so the Infinispan invalidation code still uses getLoginPredicate without the BROKER_PUBLIC clause, which breaks cache invalidation for BROKER_PUBLIC changes; updating those callers is a wider change outside the cited lines.

fbc45bf8a2c5a62cff94808d878fc2b98780e929.titleReason: The title states the defect: the transform misses equivalent count() forms such as aliased counts and counts with whitespace inside the parentheses.
fbc45bf8a2c5a62cff94808d878fc2b98780e929.fixReason: The case-insensitive anchored regex matches stripped zero-argument count() with optional inner whitespace and an optional alias, keeps the alias text as written (defaulting to count), and leaves all other columns unchanged and in order.

e5899b5233db2181ff7a0d709a4973dea5fe5050.titleReason: The title states the defect: getSubGroups lost its canViewGlobal fast path and now evaluates permission once per subgroup.
e5899b5233db2181ff7a0d709a4973dea5fe5050.fixReason: The code computes canViewGlobal once before filtering and short-circuits the per-subgroup canView check, while keeping per-group filtering when global visibility is denied and leaving parent authorization, search, filter-before-pagination and mapping unchanged.

e2778ae9f0da4bef01141038ebbb4fe3bd9a8b9d.titleReason: The title names the defect: the prefix and suffix stripping can overlap and throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
e2778ae9f0da4bef01141038ebbb4fe3bd9a8b9d.fixReason: Limiting end to the remaining length after start in both strings keeps start <= length-end for each substring, covering empty and overlapping cases, while keeping the differing content and the unchanged diagnostic message.

df02a3d14d326365fe73e292153a304069b7d69d.titleReason: The title names the defect: the Clients type resource is not null-checked, which causes an NPE in hasPermission.
df02a3d14d326365fe73e292153a304069b7d69d.fixReason: The added null guard returns false before findByResource runs, and the existing policy check and evaluation are unchanged, with the outer closing brace left outside the anchor as required.

672aa6d475d5365fafa4e87c34511a155953e7f7.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: Grafana rules in the new rule list no longer show the Pause/Resume action.
