ef5ee62ff4e9e88d31ad1e9a84e4b1395df83529.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context, not local, so no fix is graded.

51b78594853713119ca9abee1ae39a532f26438e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the mode-3 legacy update gets the original objInfo instead of the object committed to unified storage.
51b78594853713119ca9abee1ae39a532f26438e.fixReason: Wrapping objInfo and res in an updateWrapper passes the committed object to legacy, keeps the upstream preconditions, and leaves the other arguments and the errObjectSt variable unchanged.

ea64e4180a0ef9d721f8018729ab17bb4317e3ab.titleReason: The title names the defect: the cache entry is left behind after the device-limit rejection, so the next request gets through.
ea64e4180a0ef9d721f8018729ab17bb4317e3ab.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

8c2fb356e02ccfc91e032c90d263755e589e8585.titleReason: The title names the defect: a NotFound from storage makes Delete skip the legacy delete.
8c2fb356e02ccfc91e032c90d263755e589e8585.fixReason: On NotFound the code falls through to the unconditional `recordStorageDuration(false, ...)` at line 106, so a NotFound is recorded as a successful storage deletion, which breaks the metrics obligation.

6cc9b9afa1dda032eb6fadb6a6b339dad441975b.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the migration crashes with a NoMethodError when the queried settings rows are missing.
6cc9b9afa1dda032eb6fadb6a6b339dad441975b.fixReason: The empty-result guards work, but when the uncategorized setting is absent the code assigns hosts to an arbitrary lowest-id category rather than the application's uncategorized default, missing the fallback obligation and possibly binding hosts to an unrelated category.

d1dee7c070d1f58a2c107cefb0005e8dc429e2b1.titleReason: The title states that the refresh update persists the SafeParse result object instead of the credential key, which is the defect.
d1dee7c070d1f58a2c107cefb0005e8dc429e2b1.fixReason: Taking `.data` from the parse result persists the parsed credentials, keeps validation, and leaves the same update call with its closing delimiter outside the anchor, matching the reference.

168129f4bad5d29239580a879253f672543043e2.titleReason: The title names the defect: sending a dummy totpCode with a backup code skips the password check.
168129f4bad5d29239580a879253f672543043e2.fixReason: Rejecting requests that carry a totpCode in the backup-code branch, before any backup code is consumed, closes the bypass while keeping password-verified backup-code login, code consumption, and the TOTP-only path unchanged, matching the reference fix.

0d321fad08778cf4595ddb100171c8c5a6459738.titleReason: The title names the defect: the URL goes into the href attribute and the link text without escaping, which allows stored XSS.
0d321fad08778cf4595ddb100171c8c5a6459738.fixReason: The URL is now escaped correctly (html_escape escapes apostrophes), but the fix still appends with `<<`, so it misses the obligation to handle nil contents without raising.

d241d0c25564a10b0c5420188b92fb50c14d39b0.titleReason: The title states the defect: the cleanup targets the literal alias "alias" instead of the aliases of the providers the test created.
d241d0c25564a10b0c5420188b92fb50c14d39b0.fixReason: The improved code registers cleanup for each "idp-alias-" + i in the loop and for "idp-alias-20", leaves all setup and assertions unchanged, and compiles because a bound method reference evaluates its receiver immediately, so it does not capture the non-final loop variable.

db909a12690abf57545a52b11e1a90ace9700402.titleReason: The title names the defect: an existing per-client resource causes the global all-clients grant to be ignored.
db909a12690abf57545a52b11e1a90ace9700402.fixReason: It returns true on a per-client grant, otherwise falls through to the existing evaluation of the all-clients resource, denies when that resource is null or has no policies, keeps the same-realm and server checks, and uses the existing hasGrantedPermission helper, matching the reference.

1ebc069865ae7419d8ca4d57efbd021d652dada1.titleReason: The title names the defect: stale member-fetch responses that arrive late overwrite newer pagination state, which matches the finding.
1ebc069865ae7419d8ca4d57efbd021d652dada1.fixReason: The answer's fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

1cbbab93574710022119c3c1b93a6c6c485f452c.titleReason: The title says the expected Forbidden error may come from the scope read rather than the removal, which is exactly the defect the finding describes.
1cbbab93574710022119c3c1b93a6c6c485f452c.fixReason: It fetches the scope through the privileged realm.admin() client outside the try block and calls only removeDefaultClientScope through the restricted client, using a new variable name that doesn't clash with the later clientScopeRep and leaving the authorized removal test intact.

a23f37f0a27a176de66948442e983bfbdead89f8.titleReason: The title names the defect: canExchangeTo throws UnsupportedOperationException in V2 when it should return a boolean decision.
a23f37f0a27a176de66948442e983bfbdead89f8.fixReason: The replacement keeps the same signature and returns false, so unsupported V2 exchanges are denied instead of throwing, which meets every obligation.

b5683c279c39cf7a433ebcc6d9329cf601f37c90.titleReason: The title states the defect: the URL and username tests never reach the guards they are named after.
b5683c279c39cf7a433ebcc6d9329cf601f37c90.fixReason: Each test now enables polling, sets the other prerequisite to a nonblank value using the existing let helpers, and still asserts poll_feed is never called, so each test fails if its own guard is removed.

acce71943f8ba72fc9f925a87eb5eadbceaded84.titleReason: The title names the defect: the auto-downsize branch rewrites SVG uploads and corrupts the vectors.
acce71943f8ba72fc9f925a87eb5eadbceaded84.fixReason: Adding `filename !~ /\.svg$/i` to the guard skips SVGs case-insensitively, leaves the downsizing eligibility and loop unchanged for other formats, and leaves the SVG bytes intact for Upload.create_for.

b268c3701f4f549ca079aaafbea4a3d034c4a64e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the light-theme topic-map h3 color changed from 20% to 50% lightness, which is what the reference describes.
b268c3701f4f549ca079aaafbea4a3d034c4a64e.fixReason: The replacement line restores primary at 20% lightness for the light theme and uses secondary at 80% for the dark theme, and it changes only the cited color line, so the other h3 styles are preserved.

ec1555625563a6c0f65db9bb7bab670cd8c366a7.titleReason: The title names the defect: stale rejectedEmails entries keep blocking an address after the server-side rule changes.
ec1555625563a6c0f65db9bb7bab670cd8c366a7.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

c636ede73e982281f6dd106cf2d8e83af5a5deb3.titleReason: The title states that group create ignores the alias_level param, which is the defect the finding describes.
c636ede73e982281f6dd106cf2d8e83af5a5deb3.fixReason: The answer assigns alias_level with the same to_i/present? guard that update uses, so a blank value keeps the default, and name trimming, visibility and save behavior are unchanged.

8052536828dd2a963418345eb09bfd79788c1f35.titleReason: The title names the defect: the confirmation overstates that all topic notifications stop.
8052536828dd2a963418345eb09bfd79788c1f35.fixReason: Narrowing the promise to 'every new post' holds for both regular and muted outcomes, no longer claims that all notifications stop, and keeps the key and the {{title}} interpolation.

c7343cfbbd297855332bfdd4215ec65e2b1902ed.titleReason: The title states the defect: remove_member skips the GroupUser callbacks, so the user_count counter cache becomes stale.
c7343cfbbd297855332bfdd4215ec65e2b1902ed.fixReason: The fix destroys only this group's matching GroupUser record with callbacks via destroy_all, and it keeps the automatic-group guard and the response handling.

845283b000b404681af2eff9cc89e0c96a5f7c3b.titleReason: The title names the defect: the token refresh success check uses statusText instead of real HTTP success, which matches the finding.
845283b000b404681af2eff9cc89e0c96a5f7c3b.fixReason: Switching to `!response.ok` accepts any 2xx response whatever its statusText and still throws an HttpError on failure; the status code and fallback message changes are valid and introduce no new defect.

56f0ac6a061058699b773b588e1b1bdabd95a434.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the date override check lets slots through even when they start before the override start.
56f0ac6a061058699b773b588e1b1bdabd95a434.fixReason: Adding slotStartTime.isBefore(offset-adjusted start) rejects slots that start early, still allows a slot starting exactly at the override start, keeps the utcOffset adjustment and the return-true semantics, and leaves the old end-time conditions as harmless redundancy.

050d6dbafafa22ef40af3fb5563a695ef3ad3bd9.titleReason: The title names the defect from the finding: in the dark theme the notification badge shows dark text on a dark background.
050d6dbafafa22ef40af3fb5563a695ef3ad3bd9.fixReason: Using scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) in both themes keeps the light-theme background unchanged and gives the dark theme a light background behind the $secondary text on linked and unlinked badges, while the specialized variants still apply their own overrides.

cece4b9d96686cc05faa366581ede53797a25f0d.titleReason: The title states the defect: sendAddGuestsEmails receives the unfiltered request guests instead of the filtered uniqueGuests.
cece4b9d96686cc05faa366581ede53797a25f0d.fixReason: Passing uniqueGuests, which the finding and reference describe as computed earlier in the handler, means only the filtered newly added guests are treated as new while evt.attendees stays intact, matching the reference fix.

be174456b91726a5c52922ba09fe21940f7f4b88.titleReason: The title names the defect: the toString() computed keys cause the schema to strip the expiry fields.
be174456b91726a5c52922ba09fe21940f7f4b88.fixReason: The fix requires a string access_token, makes expires_in and expiry_date optional numbers, and uses passthrough to keep refresh_token and other provider fields; the extra optional ext_expires_in is harmless.

1ce8cf51070b02a92d633fdc6c896bee419f9cb6.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: a plain Error for a missing credential produces a 500 instead of a NOT_FOUND client error.
1ce8cf51070b02a92d633fdc6c896bee419f9cb6.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so no improvedCode is graded.

d90506f350508271d20f09ab18a1501a1644acb6.titleReason: The title names the defect: getBaseConditions returns fragments without parentheses, so an appended AND binds with the wrong precedence.
d90506f350508271d20f09ab18a1501a1644acb6.fixReason: Each single-operand branch is now wrapped in parentheses through Prisma.sql, and the both-present branch was already correctly grouped for an appended AND, so authorization, filter intersection, parameterization and deny-all behavior are all preserved.

c15e8c9dbada1206fc15cee3018b56bd1318437e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the connection is built with the stale pre-refresh access token instead of the refreshed one.
c15e8c9dbada1206fc15cee3018b56bd1318437e.fixReason: The connection is now built with the refreshed access_token and the refreshed instance_url (required non-empty string, so the fallback is harmless), and the awaited persistence, refresh_token, client config and redirect URI are all kept.

b9c353627d6142049dd59f7589abc04cd0ba62f8.titleReason: The title names the defect: the unanchored domain regex lets suffixed domains bypass the allow-list.
b9c353627d6142049dd59f7589abc04cd0ba62f8.fixReason: Escaping each domain and anchoring at \z is correct, but the extra `\A[^@\s]+` local-part requirement changes blacklist matching, so blacklisted-domain emails whose local part contains whitespace or '@' (e.g. quoted local parts) no longer match and get through, a new bypass.

7d7f7a45293278ce922d099d6d130beaea993f93.titleReason: The title names the missing join of the commit thread in terminate(), which is the synchronization defect, though it overstates this as commits continuing to run.
7d7f7a45293278ce922d099d6d130beaea993f93.fixReason: An unchecked join with timeout=5.0 can return while the commit thread is still alive, so it does not guarantee the thread has exited before terminate returns.

349da11594cbce1b5b7e0f4c8043c48b32f0fddb.titleReason: The title says the queue-depth gauge has no per-worker distinction, so the per-queue series overwrite each other, which is the defect described.
349da11594cbce1b5b7e0f4c8043c48b32f0fddb.fixReason: The replacement keeps the metric name, the qsize() value, and the identifier tag, and adds a worker_id tag from the stable self.worker_id defined in __init__, so each worker gets its own series.

2ad99d8b2870e0f7ff6f16d64f9dcf460e32452b.titleReason: The title names the defect: every page request fetches all of the replay's error IDs from nodestore with no bound.
2ad99d8b2870e0f7ff6f16d64f9dcf460e32452b.fixReason: Slicing error_ids to 100 before the opt-out check bounds the nodestore fetch before any payloads load, keeps the empty-response and opt-out paths unchanged, and still includes error context when enabled.

4b0e81f69b3ca17e18cf1e9ce2cf01bfe0ac6661.titleReason: The title names the defect: the metadata lookup treats the database slug as the map key, so valid apps such as Google Calendar get a 404.
4b0e81f69b3ca17e18cf1e9ce2cf01bfe0ac6661.fixReason: The replacement finds the metadata entry whose slug matches app.slug, keeps the 404 guard without duplicating the closing brace, and casts the result back to the metadata entry type so the downstream uses of appMetadata.slug and appMetadata.type still work.

6b243a7a346412b4e7a61f11712717c9dce15c12.titleReason: The title names the defect: the wrong isinstance check means the restart path never kills the old flusher process.
6b243a7a346412b4e7a61f11712717c9dce15c12.fixReason: The improvedCode replaces all of lines 253-259 but leaves out line 259's `self._create_process_for_shards(process_index, shards)`, so replacement processes are never created, which breaks the obligation to preserve replacement creation.

2107d0c328ecd39b2d0805e72efbbe20d4993a9d.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the cache timestamp is formatted with a hard-coded en-US locale rather than the user's active locale.

07eb69e99b3d51e394055e29d468fa2ec27f9951.titleReason: The title names the defect: the validation-failure warning logs the full attacker-controlled raw report.
07eb69e99b3d51e394055e29d468fa2ec27f9951.fixReason: It removes raw_report but still logs serializer.errors, which can echo invalid inputs, and adds report_type, an arbitrary caller-supplied value, so it misses the obligation not to log input values through replacement metadata or validation-error messages.

23ebf6dd04452ac85be865919794fef9fe90944c.titleReason: The title names the defect: the async legacy create runs on a request context that is cancelled when the handler returns.

d8bf28654bfbb9edf2462f126055d3a61eae842a.titleReason: The title states the defect: a failed Storage.Create is recorded with the legacy duration metric instead of the storage one.

334399e1804bf76f102bb01e296bbfb4e48211c5.titleReason: The title names the defect: downsizing a tempfile that lacks an image extension flattens animated GIFs.
334399e1804bf76f102bb01e296bbfb4e48211c5.fixReason: Preserving the extension does route the GIF to animated processing, but the fix still passes "80%", which the reference says the gifsicle path cannot use, so the animation is not reliably reduced in size and that obligation is missed.

6fb02a9a2da0dabd993cb1db013e8d19ea755ff1.titleReason: The title says the light-theme lightness for .group-member-info .name was regressed to 50%, which is the defect the finding describes.

06bfbf7b18a88209ce9586d4170a5a3256edfd73.titleReason: The title names the off-by-one defect: totalPages overcounts when user_count is an exact multiple of limit.
06bfbf7b18a88209ce9586d4170a5a3256edfd73.fixReason: Using Math.ceil returns the correct page count for positive counts, keeps 0 for an empty group, and keeps the limit/user_count dependencies, which meets every obligation.

ee2c72f11c5dce3e6848d607917c50e8bcba1bdb.titleReason: The title names the defect: a single embed request makes the PollFeed job import the entire feed.

1da9a7c752b36d7cf1adb6b7b1e8f673d7820423.titleReason: The title states that the client size check hardcodes 10 MB instead of using the configured max size setting, which is the defect the finding describes.
1da9a7c752b36d7cf1adb6b7b1e8f673d7820423.fixReason: The improved code picks max_image_size_kb or max_attachment_size_kb from the type, rejects files strictly larger than that limit in KB, and shows the configured limit in the existing error message, so it meets every obligation without adding a new problem.

3d6b80d72d53f2e7241584a256bb097d1d5c5cc1.titleReason: The title says the email comparison is case-sensitive and that this allows bypassing the block list, which is the defect.
3d6b80d72d53f2e7241584a256bb097d1d5c5cc1.fixReason: Lowercasing both the stored column and the input gives an exact case-insensitive match with no wildcards, and the match-count update and block/do_nothing logic on the following lines stay unchanged.

f62325e1854dd287249741e90a7264aea5ee04e5.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the unsubscribe GET action changes the user's notification state without CSRF protection.

62d527fb0517b0cf26c495e9d9aa68d044b14f74.fixReason: The repository has no PublicSuffix dependency, so `defined?(PublicSuffix)` is nil and same_domain is always false, which breaks valid sibling matches like www.example.com and forum.example.com; the reference notes say merely referencing PublicSuffix fails.

c85062fece04d8af94d0702c3a4095c0f2d7ff83.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: the save callback clears or empties the host's category when no category was selected.
c85062fece04d8af94d0702c3a4095c0f2d7ff83.fixReason: Skipping the assignment when categoryId is null does not resolve the category from the persisted category_id, so a new host still shows no uncategorized category, because the server returns only category_id and not a category object.

524d54085e269067d80bcff2277c94c10d88406e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the light and dark lightness arguments in the mobile modal color are inverted.
524d54085e269067d80bcff2277c94c10d88406e.fixReason: The replacement keeps dark-light-choose and uses $primary at 70% for the light theme and $secondary at 30% for the dark theme, so it meets both obligations and adds no new problem.

3359edb14739c730836593cd42ebd3d402e64a1f.titleReason: The title states the defect: the client-side unsubscribe route does not change the notification level.
3359edb14739c730836593cd42ebd3d402e64a1f.fixReason: The fix relies on topic.toggleNotifications(0), which does not appear in the shown code or reference, sets the level to 0 instead of invoking the unsubscribe action, applies the change even on a full-page load where the server already unsubscribed (a second downgrade), and does not reuse the preloaded results.

201d74320615850561fbb682861885f3889b15e5.titleReason: The title names both defects from the finding: duplicate memberships are added, and there is no transaction around the additions.

f8d542855bbd840fb7d7250381a694d5584a3a66.titleReason: The title says that absolutize_urls wrongly rewrites protocol-relative URLs, which is the defect the finding describes.

47e45b4532f75ea8240d76e93f0f80ab00f4ce8e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the same-domain check fails when the website host is a subdomain of the instance host.
47e45b4532f75ea8240d76e93f0f80ab00f4ce8e.fixReason: The replacement keeps the parent-direction check and adds a dot-bounded reverse check (website_host.ends_with?("." << discourse_host)), which covers nested subdomains and returns the bare host for unrelated domains; it reuses the original's `"." << host` idiom, which creates a fresh literal each time and does not mutate the host variables.

907e6a02ffa4aa0e7b1247b88fcbf5b0c31b8bff.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the light-theme name color moved from 30% to 50% lightness, though it leaves out the wrong dark-theme value.

b718f815fc2943c75b94ef67c0885762089932ba.titleReason: The title says the method fails to match per-client resources, which is the defect the finding describes.
b718f815fc2943c75b94ef67c0885762089932ba.fixReason: The fix adds client.getClientId() where the caller expects internal client IDs (client.getId(), used with getClientById), so the method still returns the wrong identifiers.

45bc8478e82cec9affd10e02274beb5227001d80.titleReason: The title states the defect: an undefined return from scheduleSMS when sending is locked is miscounted as a send failure.
45bc8478e82cec9affd10e02274beb5227001d80.fixReason: The replacement keeps `} else {` with only comments, so the existing brace on line 187 closes an empty else block; this stops locked skips from incrementing retryCount and keeps the successful update and the catch-block retry counting.

ed3e7941684cb8593517085caefb19a2f3500e4c.fixReason: Using isSame compares the override endpoints by timestamp value and returns true when they are equal, which triggers the unavailable result, and the following bounds checks are left unchanged.

64e3f651c18ac975d7f17daf2da07880ce9e985e.titleReason: The title names the defect: case variants or plus-address aliases can get past the guest blacklist check.

34f2ddefef5d824e065e69876766e37d1c671642.titleReason: The title names the defect: in the non-sharing flow, the placeholder refresh token replaces the valid stored token.

a382e74ec3bdccc6bf324b55473519f63798122f.titleReason: The title states the defect: the team check uses && where it should use ||, so admins who are not owners are denied.
a382e74ec3bdccc6bf324b55473519f63798122f.fixReason: Swapping && for || authorizes either an admin or an owner, and the organizer/attendee checks and the FORBIDDEN rejection for everyone else stay as they were.

96b09692074c83d52ce5d5c8efb9a75ae65d59cc.titleReason: The title states the defect: video (non-calendar) booking references no longer persist credentialId.
96b09692074c83d52ce5d5c8efb9a75ae65d59cc.fixReason: Using result.credentialId unconditionally keeps the credential id for both video and calendar references, leaves externalCalendarId limited to calendar results, and compiles because updateLocation already reads result.credentialId without narrowing.

4f90eedc85ee266da67c65a27c041675d370c67d.titleReason: The title states that createEvent picks the first destination calendar without regard to the invoking credential, which is the defect the finding describes.

3dea870de36c7c3477d2058c95a2d1fbb5351aa0.titleReason: The title states the defect: the slot is rejected when any working-hours range for that day does not contain it.
3dea870de36c7c3477d2058c95a2d1fbb5351aa0.fixReason: With empty workingHours, `some` returns false, so every slot is rejected and the busy-only behavior is lost; the end is also still computed from the slot start, not the actual slot end.

f9b7287185692fbe63d2019a5b76438e8ee5dbe0.titleReason: The title names both defects: the end bound is computed from the start time, and valid slots are rejected when a day has several working-hour entries.
f9b7287185692fbe63d2019a5b76438e8ee5dbe0.fixReason: It computes `end` as `slotEndTime.hour()*60 + slotEndTime.minute()`, so a slot running past midnight wraps to a small minute value and passes the closing check, violating the obligation not to wrap overnight ends.

0c06c53528008fe39411e6be7956be634a7bbc65.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring-series cancellation ignores the resolved credential of the current reference.
0c06c53528008fe39411e6be7956be634a7bbc65.fixReason: The replacement keeps braces balanced with the remaining lines, deletes through the outer `calendar` built from the resolved credential (including one loaded from the database), selects each occurrence's calendar references by matching `credentialId`, deletes with that reference's uid and externalCalendarId, and keeps the awaited Promise.all with its error handling.

70e104d50819001c940a37cc5b2ac11e7a91c574.titleReason: The title names the defect: the catch-block increment reads a stale retryCount, so concurrent updates can be lost.

58d70fc3df9ee80ce2978857869b8ffc2e71d8a3.titleReason: The title names the defect: the token is refreshed on every client creation and the refresh skips refreshOAuthTokens, which matches the core of the finding.
58d70fc3df9ee80ce2978857869b8ffc2e71d8a3.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so there is no local fix to grade.

1a0965cdff701a5e962548f1538c63b62f9349de.titleReason: The title names the defect: multiple overrides on the same day cause valid slots to be rejected.
1a0965cdff701a5e962548f1538c63b62f9349de.fixReason: It keeps the old exclusion tests, which only reject non-overlapping slots, so a slot that partly overlaps an interval and spills into a gap is accepted instead of requiring full containment. The `===` comparison of dayjs objects is never true, so a zero-length override can still accept a slot starting exactly at its time, breaking the zero-length obligation.

e1709d3dc0063aec63d1df1e0df7595e9d95cd21.titleReason: The title names the defect: an unprotected prisma update inside the catch block that can abort the whole SMS cron batch.

8fbff5703da800adb44630bb77207b8dc45bf65d.titleReason: The title names the defect: the Meet hangout patch uses an undefined calendarId when no destination calendar matches, which is what the finding describes.

27329a3d98cfe8327ccad0da40eecdd6560642cf.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring bulk delete repeats once for every calendar reference.
27329a3d98cfe8327ccad0da40eecdd6560642cf.fixReason: Gating on the first reference still deletes through every organizer credential using each occurrence's first calendar ref, so co-host events are never deleted through their own credentials; later references fall into the single-delete else branch; and the bulk delete is skipped if the first reference lacks a credentialId or a resolvable credential.

6ea3cc7569cc2621f2abd4ec09926a8493aaab1c.titleReason: The title states the defect: the delete cache mutation does not invalidate the connectedCalendars query.
6ea3cc7569cc2621f2abd4ec09926a8493aaab1c.fixReason: The fix adds onSettled invalidation of connectedCalendars through utils, which is declared later in the component but only read inside the deferred callback; it keeps both toasts and the optional onSuccess callback.

d55f63302b32af8eb141aa37dc35541c81a3e9dd.titleReason: The title names the defect: a Twilio cancel failure skips the DB delete, which leaves the reminder in place.
d55f63302b32af8eb141aa37dc35541c81a3e9dd.fixReason: The inner try/catch logs and contains the Twilio error, so the awaited prisma delete still runs; Twilio is called only when referenceId is present, and the outer catch from the remaining lines still contains DB errors.

125498d601d3f90a718a06d65eea2da1ac9533a5.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: an unhandled ZodError on a malformed webhook body produces a 500 response.
125498d601d3f90a718a06d65eea2da1ac9533a5.fixReason: The safeParse replacement returns 400 for schema failures but misses the obligation to return 400 for undecryptable keys or invalid decrypted JSON, which still throw later in the handler.

de57af57e890d7adf5b3cddaa0922cbabc7ede85.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: evaluating the module triggers eager imports of every app module.
de57af57e890d7adf5b3cddaa0922cbabc7ede85.fixReason: Each entry is now a lazy getter that returns the import promise only when accessed, so no imports start at module evaluation; all keys and paths are preserved, and the promise-valued contract for existing `await appStore[key]` consumers is kept.

d87cd801f62047e07324665a72fd6e18a9045342.titleReason: The title says the bounds check lets through slots that extend outside the override, which is the containment defect the finding describes.

a1230b82767dd6ea62f3f609f72cf515e1073a74.titleReason: The title names the defect: the schema accepts duplicate guest emails, which matches the finding.
a1230b82767dd6ea62f3f609f72cf515e1073a74.fixReason: The refine rejects arrays with repeated exact email strings, keeps the email and numeric bookingId validation, and still accepts distinct valid emails, which the reference explicitly allows.

2d20fa3e1babe4cbc78bf77f610acf6de952aad2.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: guest dedupe and blacklist checks are case-sensitive.
2d20fa3e1babe4cbc78bf77f610acf6de952aad2.fixReason: The fix compares lowercased emails against attendees and the blacklist, keeps only the first case-insensitive occurrence of each guest via findIndex, and leaves the accepted guest strings unchanged, so it meets every obligation.

6edd334a4d21f2a7ec6b576b0a5db5c50f46a542.titleReason: The title names the defect: the async forEach discards the deletion promises during booking reschedule.
6edd334a4d21f2a7ec6b576b0a5db5c50f46a542.fixReason: Awaiting Promise.all over the mapped async callbacks makes the deletions finish before the emails and webhooks are sent and lets failures reach the handler, while the UID checks, the type dispatch, optional calendar handling, and the deletion arguments stay unchanged.

c8a5b2e233b6dfaf37b2752fa1da4f1647d5dbbb.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the successful Delete metric uses the object name as its kind label.

e9d617c99a3d1b5b34caf4cef10b12a4d638f3d4.titleReason: The title states the defect: the query key omits organization identity, which causes cached attribute keys to be reused across organizations.

6976d208b94f23b04f8bb0ce622819fbec20dced.titleReason: The title names the defect: the migration reads query results without checking whether any rows came back.

d168a06d7c3d344be508d11d4763425272f34605.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

519273cea62d56d913095f488dc8434b130d4253.titleReason: The title names the defect: protocol-relative URLs are wrongly treated as relative paths and rewritten onto the article host.
519273cea62d56d913095f488dc8434b130d4253.fixReason: The change only fixes anchor hrefs and leaves the img src branch (lines 70-72) broken, and it does not resolve path-relative references, so it misses the reference obligations.

415e69ec106d4427fd6019a17c7eb4a2a58ff268.titleReason: The title says the method looks up client resources by a type that V2 never sets, which is the defect.
415e69ec106d4427fd6019a17c7eb4a2a58ff268.fixReason: The fix adds client.getClientId() where the caller needs internal IDs (client.getId()), and it does not apply the all-clients fallback guard.

80cb5410deeb15b8a98cff51e8b27d465e0d68e7.titleReason: The title states the defect: the no-arg canManage() accepts the VIEW scope, so viewers can manage groups.
80cb5410deeb15b8a98cff51e8b27d465e0d68e7.fixReason: The replacement removes VIEW and keeps the all-groups MANAGE check and the MANAGE_USERS role bypass, so it meets every obligation and still compiles.

b0479901f89928e572bb42c073e2af87617222f5.titleReason: The title names the defect, an unintended change of the light-theme `.name` color to 50% lightness, though it leaves out the dark-theme 70% half.
b0479901f89928e572bb42c073e2af87617222f5.fixReason: The replacement restores primary at 30% and uses secondary at 70%, and keeps the indentation and the single declaration, so the surrounding layout is unchanged.

11e5d87cbbec6cfebda6790fdb5b683c4fad7821.titleReason: The title correctly says the lookup ignores the port, which is why port-qualified entries never match.
11e5d87cbbec6cfebda6790fdb5b683c4fad7821.fixReason: For a URL with a non-default port it queries only `host:port` with no fallback, so existing hostname-only entries (e.g. `example.com` with a referer on port 8080) stop matching, which breaks the obligation to preserve hostname-only matching.

744edeaf49288869eb02dab3cc5d4c03ee751027.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: a global canView() grant overriding a per-client VIEW denial.
744edeaf49288869eb02dab3cc5d4c03ee751027.fixReason: Swapping in canViewClientDefault() only repairs the direct per-client check, while the reference requires a wider change, and the ClientsResource.getClients() listing shortcut still bypasses client-specific denials, which misses an obligation.

73f0c49fa5e4246d80778547578963a269b998b3.titleReason: The title says the JPA group filter still requires the legacy group.resource.<id> name and so fails for V2 permissions, which is the defect the finding describes.
73f0c49fa5e4246d80778547578963a269b998b3.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

1a2a6d73f885a130accf1330d503ec629392412e.titleReason: The title names the defect: collective team destination calendars are dropped when evt.destinationCalendar is null.
1a2a6d73f885a130accf1330d503ec629392412e.fixReason: The assignment logic is correct, but improvedCode adds a closing brace while the original closing brace on line 1079 lies outside the cited range, so the replacement leaves an extra `}` that breaks the code.

eb3c27db132b5ef827a0492b1daca8fcf698153f.titleReason: The title states that mainHostDestinationCalendar is accessed for .integration without a null check, which is the defect described.
eb3c27db132b5ef827a0492b1daca8fcf698153f.fixReason: Optional chaining keeps null, undefined and empty destination calendars from throwing, sends absent or non-Google destinations to Cal Video, and leaves Google Calendar destinations and other locations unchanged.

eecd38af2a6dec6dc5eb48409c224a9635b3030e.titleReason: The title names the defect: an unconditional placeholder refresh_token overwrites and corrupts the stored credentials.
eecd38af2a6dec6dc5eb48409c224a9635b3030e.fixReason: The placeholder is now injected only under both conditions that select the minimum-schema sharing/sync branch, so the non-sharing branch no longer synthesizes a token and keeps any parsed refresh_token, and the sharing branch keeps its placeholder behavior.

bfb49b2d736dc765f8adac754ee4cff4bef7b1f3.titleReason: The title says the slug condition is inverted during organization creation, which is the defect the finding describes.
bfb49b2d736dc765f8adac754ee4cff4bef7b1f3.fixReason: The improved code negates the slug condition so slug is set only when billing is disabled, keeps requestedSlug when billing is enabled, and leaves the rest of the metadata unchanged.

0b348535c598a13ba6d657cdf77f64f5395a52d6.titleReason: The title names the defect: the SMS lock state is wrongly counted toward retryCount, which leads to reminders being deleted.
0b348535c598a13ba6d657cdf77f64f5395a52d6.fixReason: Deleting lines 178-186 leaves the closing brace on line 187 to close the success branch, so locked skips no longer touch retryCount while successful updates and the catch-block retry counting stay intact, matching the reference fix exactly.

f71d8af0ff7be5e9ff5ae82a0b8492083ab06970.titleReason: The title states the defect: one SendGrid cancel error aborts the reminder cancellation loop.
f71d8af0ff7be5e9ff5ae82a0b8492083ab06970.fixReason: The per-reminder try/catch fixes the loop abort, but the final `await Promise.all(workflowRemindersToDelete)` is no longer inside any try/catch, so a Prisma delete failure now throws out of the handler and stops the email-scheduling phase, which the original code had guarded against.

f1ce88fdcef5e58db11db593fc12b6b108b283f6.titleReason: The title names the defect: blocked guest addresses can get past the blacklist through case variants or plus-address aliases.
f1ce88fdcef5e58db11db593fc12b6b108b283f6.fixReason: The normalization logic is correct, but improvedCode ends with the filter's closing `);` while line 78 (outside the cited 70-77 range) already holds `);`, so the result has a duplicate `);` and will not compile.

b1ba28390b1abb0dd03b18771b9d8be6c82ff692.titleReason: The title names the defect: Dayjs objects are compared with strict (reference) equality, so the full-day override is never detected.
b1ba28390b1abb0dd03b18771b9d8be6c82ff692.fixReason: The fix uses isSame to compare the timestamps by value and returns true when the endpoints are equal, so the outer unavailable result is triggered, and unequal endpoints still fall through to the existing bounds checks.

3c83ec345163920c893b5dfd95cc79463addaaad.titleReason: The title states the defect: the date-override early return skips the busy-time check.
3c83ec345163920c893b5dfd95cc79463addaaad.fixReason: Reassigning the `workingHours` parameter to an empty array skips only the working-hours check for override days and falls through to the existing busy check, which rejects overlaps and allows endpoint-touching slots, while the `currentSeats` and non-override paths stay unchanged.

99ff35439f488cabbd606de47cd9085348372207.titleReason: The title says the authorization check wrongly combines the admin and owner checks with && where || is needed, which is the defect described.
99ff35439f488cabbd606de47cd9085348372207.fixReason: Swapping && for || lets either an admin or an owner through, and it leaves the organizer/attendee checks and the FORBIDDEN rejection on line 54 unchanged.

8615a5f46775ccb1e0559eccac4be2d9939be195.titleReason: The title names the defect: non-calendar (video) references drop the credentialId needed to manage those meetings later.
8615a5f46775ccb1e0559eccac4be2d9939be195.fixReason: The fix uses result.credentialId for both calendar and video references and keeps externalCalendarId calendar-only; the field is valid on the general result type, as updateLocation's own use shows.

64246056dc4f6ebfdaaf9392a3dc411bf003274e.titleReason: The title names both defects: the wrong end time in the working-hours check and the rejection of valid slots on split-day schedules.
64246056dc4f6ebfdaaf9392a3dc411bf003274e.fixReason: The `some` containment logic and the empty-array guard are correct, but the end is computed as `slotEndTime.hour()*60+minute()`, which wraps slots that cross midnight back to early clock minutes and wrongly accepts them, violating the first obligation.

c24efe2a1e902e4ea564dd48150b3237136d3ef5.titleReason: The title names the defect: recurring cancellation deletes through the organizer's credentials instead of the current reference's resolved credential.
c24efe2a1e902e4ea564dd48150b3237136d3ef5.fixReason: The improvedCode adds its own `apiDeletes.push`, closing braces and `});`, but the original lines 458-461 that follow the cited range stay in place, so the result has a duplicate push and extra closing braces and will not compile.

18323b32f2b3864f95f0238080bf02d17cbba2d7.titleReason: The title says slots in split working-day ranges are wrongly rejected, which is the defect the finding describes.
18323b32f2b3864f95f0238080bf02d17cbba2d7.fixReason: There is no `workingHours.length > 0` guard, so when workingHours is omitted or empty (the default `[]`), `!workingHours.some(...)` is true and every slot is rejected, which breaks the busy-only obligation.

0107a19cf91445846df0d3ad19a9397c96e14cec.titleReason: The title names the defect: the catch block uses a stale retryCount, which can undercount concurrent retries.
0107a19cf91445846df0d3ad19a9397c96e14cec.fixReason: It swaps the stale value for Prisma's atomic `{ increment: 1 }`, keeps targeting reminder.id with an awaited update, preserves the catch block, and does not duplicate the closing `});` outside the range.

ebc3ac66146edf86b56fa0e90b9cb447b3ab9cbd.titleReason: The title names the defect: the find callback mixes same-day overrides, so a valid slot inside one override is rejected because of another.
ebc3ac66146edf86b56fa0e90b9cb447b3ab9cbd.fixReason: It reuses the original partial-overlap test (slotEnd > start and slotStart <= end), so slots that only partly overlap an override are accepted, and the `===` zero-length check is always false, so a zero-length override can count as available; this misses the full-containment and zero-length obligations.

e5c48db96ef255472f9ad6623d8981e494c7cdce.titleReason: The title names the defect: override times wrap around when the timezone shift crosses midnight.
e5c48db96ef255472f9ad6623d8981e494c7cdce.fixReason: The fix drops the organizer-to-invitee offset conversion and uses direct .tz(timeZone).diff(...), which the reference says is not an equivalent conversion because override dates encode organizer wall time in UTC-shaped values, so it breaks the offset-preservation obligation.

858223d8c23b7eec09f9b4c414bf9aa9f9bcacf3.titleReason: The title names the defect: the Salesforce token refresh runs unconditionally and bypasses refreshOAuthTokens, which is what the finding describes.
858223d8c23b7eec09f9b4c414bf9aa9f9bcacf3.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no fix to grade.

334d84ef2e55fbd7853c9b9a81204431a2468920.titleReason: The title names the defect: the follow-up patch call uses an undefined calendarId when no matching destination calendar is found.
334d84ef2e55fbd7853c9b9a81204431a2468920.fixReason: The fix resolves selectedCalendar to "primary" when there is no match and keeps the credential-specific match otherwise, so both the insert and the later patch (which references selectedCalendar) use the same resolved ID.

8cdc7fa0c358652c53e0cbb679120da8a149ffaf.titleReason: The title names the defect: the unprotected retryCount update in the catch block can throw and crash the batch.
8cdc7fa0c358652c53e0cbb679120da8a149ffaf.fixReason: The replacement wraps the retryCount update in its own try/catch, so update failures stay contained, the increment is still attempted, and the original error log on line 198 is preserved after the replaced lines.

79dbf944ea6cd98de46a7a3921215bfc7b42e98f.titleReason: The title names the defect: deleteCacheMutation does not invalidate connectedCalendars after the cache is deleted.
79dbf944ea6cd98de46a7a3921215bfc7b42e98f.fixReason: It adds an onSettled invalidation of connectedCalendars that does not depend on the parent callback, keeps both toasts and the optional onSuccess call, and refers to utils from the deferred callback, which works because utils is declared before the callback can run.

d00cc9f5ed2ac084621342fdfbfcd57735bbd67d.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: evaluating the appStore object eagerly loads every app module when it is imported.
d00cc9f5ed2ac084621342fdfbfcd57735bbd67d.fixReason: Lazy getters keep all keys and paths and still return promises for existing await appStore[key] consumers, while only importing a module when its property is accessed, which meets every obligation.

5702c0bb2d12c96260195df62fbc43390b432af6.titleReason: The title says the schema allows duplicate guest emails, which is the defect described.
5702c0bb2d12c96260195df62fbc43390b432af6.fixReason: The refine rejects requests with repeated emails and keeps email-format and numeric bookingId validation, so distinct valid emails are still accepted, and the reference notes explicitly allow a refinement.

280bee6495ac25e363a55cfd7a94907670e3cd16.titleReason: The title correctly identifies that BuildIndex lacks per-key concurrency control, so same-key builds can run at the same time, which is the defect described.
280bee6495ac25e363a55cfd7a94907670e3cd16.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so no local fix is graded.

0e641a69be2e6abc8e6639af7ca44cc9a8c86072.titleReason: The title names the defect: the override bounds check accepts slots that only partly overlap the override instead of requiring full containment.
0e641a69be2e6abc8e6639af7ca44cc9a8c86072.fixReason: The single combined condition rejects a slot that starts before the converted override start or ends after the converted override end, allows equality at both boundaries, keeps the `return true` rejection semantics, and leaves the opening brace for existing line 125 to close.

ad81cff5ddf9d48ed82bf36828b342b482757d3f.titleReason: The title states the defect: the hook reports abilities as supported when the rule is undefined, which is the root cause of Duplicate being enabled.
ad81cff5ddf9d48ed82bf36828b342b482757d3f.fixReason: The added `!rule` guard makes MaybeSupported, and so duplicateSupported, NotSupported when rule is undefined, while the loading and plugin-provided restrictions and the Grafana create permission for eligible rules all stay in place.

ace6dda9f698459c9cdf38a018931e5f95c492d5.titleReason: The title states the defect accurately: the DB delete is skipped when Twilio cancelSMS fails.
ace6dda9f698459c9cdf38a018931e5f95c492d5.fixReason: Running the delete before the cancel in the same try block means a failing database delete now skips the Twilio cancellation, so the obligation to attempt cancellation whenever referenceId is present is not met.

c2784cc85b23af3ef13bb8a6f00522a07252b353.titleReason: The title names the defect: an unhandled ZodError on a malformed body crashes the webhook.
c2784cc85b23af3ef13bb8a6f00522a07252b353.fixReason: The safeParse change returns 400 for schema failures but does nothing about undecryptable keys or invalid decrypted JSON, so the obligation to return 400 in those cases is not met.

cee16203316075b3181ece318b1175a8200eacdc.titleReason: The title names the defect: the strategy shuts down a pool that the factory shares across strategies.
cee16203316075b3181ece318b1175a8200eacdc.fixReason: Removing the shutdown calls keeps the shared pool usable, but both methods still use a timed join(timeout=5.0), so the retiring commit thread can outlive teardown and keep calling its stale commit callback, which misses the obligation to stop the thread before teardown returns.

65c8ea162f3afbaea9702548a814eb60d3ea9cdd.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: the shared cleanup ticker now fires every minute, which multiplies DB/IO load across all cleanup jobs.
65c8ea162f3afbaea9702548a814eb60d3ea9cdd.fixReason: The replacement puts the ticker back to ten minutes and keeps the startup cleanUpTmpFiles call and the loop opening, so periodic execution and context-cancellation handling are preserved and the code compiles.

8fbe0a39177136876b74b38c69af39dc2177ca60.titleReason: The title says the remaining processes are not terminated once the join deadline expires, which is the defect.
8fbe0a39177136876b74b38c69af39dc2177ca60.fixReason: Changing break to continue still skips termination for every worker past the deadline, and the isinstance(multiprocessing.Process) guard does not match the SpawnProcess workers, so remaining processes are still never terminated.

17c4b5ccf15215dfd757f7e6a429a8d10c58b23e.titleReason: The title says the commit callback is invoked from a background thread and races with Arroyo's main thread, which is the defect described.
17c4b5ccf15215dfd757f7e6a429a8d10c58b23e.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

085644eea6a7931d08d2b4c7ff8ebc5d0b88b4ce.titleReason: The title states the defect: the queue is unbounded and can exhaust memory, which matches the finding.
085644eea6a7931d08d2b4c7ff8ebc5d0b88b4ce.fixReason: Adding maxsize=1000 bounds each queue, and the existing blocking put() applies backpressure without dropping work, while group hashing, FIFO order and registering the offset before put are all kept as before.

3a9230315dce599ec871921cad08e1c1153f9026.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the zpopmin eviction can drop the segment root span from the buffer.
3a9230315dce599ec871921cad08e1c1153f9026.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so no improvedCode is graded.

e9520d84674067722ee379fe2be7a2fd6e0489c4.titleReason: The title states the defect: the query key has no organization identifier, so the cache is reused across organizations.
e9520d84674067722ee379fe2be7a2fd6e0489c4.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

d28039d027287ec489212cbc0eed2b9d3cdaa8da.titleReason: The title names the defect: error timestamps in seconds are compared against recording timestamps in milliseconds.
d28039d027287ec489212cbc0eed2b9d3cdaa8da.fixReason: Multiplying the error timestamp by 1000 puts both values in milliseconds and keeps fractional precision, the bounds check and the strict comparison, without mutating stored values or changing message formatting.

459011addde96bb193ec536dbdea6e765cdb8cec.titleReason: The title says the redirect traversal limit is too low for deep segment trees, which is the defect: a reduced bound truncates deep redirect chains.
459011addde96bb193ec536dbdea6e765cdb8cec.fixReason: The improvedCode puts the 10000 bound back, keeps the early break on missing or self redirects and the redirect_depth assignment, and leaves the separate 1000-member eviction cap untouched.

1bfc5df0b98c8ccf31d4acc977adef08002ba1c9.titleReason: The title names the defect: the extra-info flex item cannot shrink, so long topic titles overflow the header.
1bfc5df0b98c8ccf31d4acc977adef08002ba1c9.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

053993dd22ad3dd3804ca0416d0c7203b8bc467a.titleReason: The title names the defect: ZUNIONSTORE's default SUM aggregation corrupts the timestamp scores of duplicated spans.
053993dd22ad3dd3804ca0416d0c7203b8bc467a.fixReason: The replacement adds MAX aggregation correctly but ends with an extra closing `end`, and line 55's `end` stays in the file outside the cited range, so the result has an unmatched `end` and the Lua script fails to compile.

bc26baf006c95f83b02629d89a470d3d61e53d89.titleReason: The title states the defect: after remove_member runs, the removed user's primary_group_id still points to the group.
bc26baf006c95f83b02629d89a470d3d61e53d89.fixReason: The code still deletes the membership and then clears primary_group_id only for that user and only when it equals this group's id, so every obligation is met with existing names.

3e7593c165888733571a7b944b5b9b3c5782105d.titleReason: The title says fallback locales are preloaded only for web requests, which is the defect: background jobs and mailers miss fallback catalogs.
3e7593c165888733571a7b944b5b9b3c5782105d.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so there is no local fix to grade.

2934655a910916bd60cc7c1167c0023a8d37e7d4.titleReason: The title names the defect: the test asserts no commit after a failure, while the offsets actually get committed.
2934655a910916bd60cc7c1167c0023a8d37e7d4.fixReason: The loop now waits for a real commit and then asserts that offset 102 was committed, so it fails if no commit arrives before the timeout, and it still checks both processing attempts; it breaks on any commit rather than requiring call_count>=2, which is a minor, unlikely race given the 1s commit tick.

df839e72baa91a8b78e08a3c65aa0108d1f5a4f1.titleReason: The title repeats the finding's incorrect claim that filtered offsets bypass tracking, but the reference says BrokerValue-wrapped filtered offsets are still completed in the exception handler; the real defect is that intentional filtering is routed through the decoder's assertion and error handling.
df839e72baa91a8b78e08a3c65aa0108d1f5a4f1.fixReason: It detects FilteredPayload via message.payload before calling the decoder, then adds and completes the broker offset and returns without enqueueing or logging a failure, while leaving ordinary decoding, grouping, submission and the None-result handling unchanged.

ef2ad40106f12df49eb185e6c4c28b1a89ab0187.titleReason: The title names both problems: the missing `?` on the hook and the resulting bypass of user field restrictions.
ef2ad40106f12df49eb185e6c4c28b1a89ab0187.fixReason: The replacement defines the recognized `include_website_name?` hook and hides website_name when the website is blank or the profile is restricted, matching all four obligations with the existing `scope.restrict_user_fields?` API.

1e92a956929a6252ead49b2b1c00a8ba5da55b41.titleReason: The title names the crash that occurs when an RSS item has a description but no content, which is the defect described.
1e92a956929a6252ead49b2b1c00a8ba5da55b41.fixReason: The fix falls back to description when content is nil, uses `next` to skip only items with no body, and keeps scrub plus CGI.unescapeHTML, so every obligation is met.

1d690bf61b544aa550af0b1140af3bc6a2e18a38.titleReason: The title correctly says that the members route fetches only the first page of members, which is the defect.
1d690bf61b544aa550af0b1140af3bc6a2e18a38.fixReason: According to the reference, findMembers reads limit and offset from the model rather than taking an options argument, so passing {limit: 'all'} is ignored and still loads only the first 50 without resetting the offset.

74eefb427213a111449c526eaa2e99a3fc67e71e.titleReason: The title names the defect: SSRF through open-uri fetching an attacker-controlled URL in import_remote.
74eefb427213a111449c526eaa2e99a3fc67e71e.fixReason: It checks scheme, port and literal private IPs and disables redirects, but never restricts the request to SiteSetting.embeddable_host, which misses the obligation to limit the initial request to the configured host (and IPAddr#private? may not exist on older Rubies).

1ed2388995787cde6288e2e4b6861af26d4c9bca.titleReason: The title correctly identifies that TopicUser.find_by can return nil before notification_level is dereferenced.
1ed2388995787cde6288e2e4b6861af26d4c9bca.fixReason: The reference notes say TopicUser.get also delegates to find_by and can return nil, so swapping only the helper name still leaves the NoMethodError for users without a record.

f00e50a31c5f8f043412472f65ddbe16862cdc7c.titleReason: The title names the defect: the migration crashes when the embed_category or uncategorized_category_id setting query returns no rows.
f00e50a31c5f8f043412472f65ddbe16862cdc7c.fixReason: It guards both empty results correctly, but when the uncategorized setting is absent it hardcodes 0 instead of the application's default uncategorized category id, missing that obligation.

f460763aa4f5b884093af38078a0f8793df7445a.titleReason: The title says the feature-flagged branch renders empty table data, which is the defect.
f460763aa4f5b884093af38078a0f8793df7445a.fixReason: Passing `fields` (strings) directly as columns is invalid per the reference, aliases are ignored, and `result.meta` is passed without safe defaults or the required fields/units shape.

ee61ed8fe83b6286a50d4cb59c32e61172d707f5.titleReason: The title says the offset is marked complete even when the result processor raises, which is the defect described.
ee61ed8fe83b6286a50d4cb59c32e61172d707f5.fixReason: Completion moves into an else clause, so it runs only on success; ShutDown still breaks without completing, the exception logging is unchanged, and the retained finally keeps the queue-depth gauge running on every path.

7e279b50a80466216f50555eb63c7fc79846881c.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: the removal cleanup listener is gated on the V1 feature and fails to handle ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2.
7e279b50a80466216f50555eb63c7fc79846881c.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

ff31f966b38b92bcb02a8678119f401601550bee.titleReason: The title names the defect, offset commits stalling on Kafka offset gaps, though 'permanently' overstates it, since the reference notes the blockage is not permanent.
ff31f966b38b92bcb02a8678119f401601550bee.fixReason: Iterating sorted submitted offsets from start and breaking only on an outstanding offset skips absent offsets, stops at earlier pending ones, and keeps the watermark, locking and return convention, matching the example fix.

9dd2adb2b896e87835aee9a4634ca35e80af776a.titleReason: The title states the defect: the Grafana list item passes only promRule, so the Pause/Resume action is hidden.
9dd2adb2b896e87835aee9a4634ca35e80af776a.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

23220ae3f5a05a82694047a070ae87e63b2ed823.titleReason: The title says Delete returns early when storage reports NotFound and skips the legacy delete, which is the described defect.
23220ae3f5a05a82694047a070ae87e63b2ed823.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

66b0d182bdf7e350c3991846b6b35e7c10ad1b78.titleReason: The title describes the fix (restoring the short-circuit) rather than naming the defect of redundant per-subgroup permission evaluations.
66b0d182bdf7e350c3991846b6b35e7c10ad1b78.fixReason: It computes canViewGlobal once, short-circuits per-subgroup checks when it is granted, keeps per-group filtering otherwise, and preserves parent auth, search, pre-pagination filtering and mapping.

8b0e487c1a9b5a567a6b8a57ded09011a4e57b99.titleReason: The title states the defect: MetricAlertDetectorHandler leaves StatefulDetectorHandler's abstract methods unimplemented, which is what makes instantiation fail.
8b0e487c1a9b5a567a6b8a57ded09011a4e57b99.fixReason: The stubs would let the class instantiate, but whether the inherited StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate then returns an empty mapping without touching detector state depends on base-class code and signatures that are not shown.

7180cb674fc0501c6f2adc6bdf97c5d70cbd2cde.titleReason: The title states the defect: the transform recognizes only the literal `count()` form, so equivalent forms are missed.
7180cb674fc0501c6f2adc6bdf97c5d70cbd2cde.fixReason: The replacement rewrites zero-argument counts with inner whitespace or an explicit `as` alias, keeps the alias's original case, defaults to `count` when unaliased, matches case-insensitively after stripping, and leaves other aggregates unchanged and in order.

01bfc137c51aafecd37e444b1861511c2a056d85.titleReason: The title names the defect: overlapping common prefix and suffix lengths make the substring bounds invalid and throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
01bfc137c51aafecd37e444b1861511c2a056d85.fixReason: Clamping `end` to at most `min(value.length()-start, sanitized.length()-start)` keeps both substring ranges valid, including empty strings, and keeps the difference visible (e.g. 'a' vs '' for "aaa"/"aa") while still adding the same diagnostic.

9347e49d62ad73b574b8274c5a205b090505632a.titleReason: The title names the defect: after in-place downsizing, the open Tempfile can still refer to the stale original inode.
9347e49d62ad73b574b8274c5a205b090505632a.fixReason: After each downsize, `tempfile.reopen(tempfile.path, "rb")` re-binds the delegated File handle to the current file and `rewind` resets its position, so both the loop's size check and `Upload.create_for` see the current content and size, while the attempt bound, eligibility checks, 80% reduction, animation option and cleanup are unchanged.

a3f5feff9f1acbd7aee8bcf6cf60fe46a4795446.titleReason: The title says the shared getLoginPredicate() wrongly filters out organization-linked providers, which is the defect, though it does not mention the affected IdentityProviderBean caller.
a3f5feff9f1acbd7aee8bcf6cf60fe46a4795446.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so there is no local improvedCode to grade.

90a4c525677cfc18af72333f50daba091b1c1997.titleReason: The title names the defect: the device cache entry stays in place after CreateOrUpdateDevice fails, which matches the finding.
90a4c525677cfc18af72333f50daba091b1c1997.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

8fe4b7c18e6f110e4564780b63f370fb9e0194ad.titleReason: The title names the defect: the legacy update gets the original objInfo instead of the object already committed to unified storage.
8fe4b7c18e6f110e4564780b63f370fb9e0194ad.fixReason: The replacement wraps objInfo and res in the existing updateWrapper, so legacy receives the committed object and preconditions still delegate upstream, while all other arguments and the errObjectSt variable stay unchanged.

6c9de5783e1c3c32edd4fd205f54d2559cf48bad.titleReason: The title names the defect: the refreshed Google credential gets saved as the Zod safe-parse wrapper instead of the parsed credential data.
6c9de5783e1c3c32edd4fd205f54d2559cf48bad.fixReason: Adding `.data` persists the parsed credential object, keeps the validation call before the write, and leaves the same update call and refresh flow intact, with the closing delimiter still outside the anchor.

bc567757da85a86c507b7175150c405da7b6d698.titleReason: The title names the defect: the silence drawer is not shown for Grafana alerting rules that have no ruler rule.
bc567757da85a86c507b7175150c405da7b6d698.fixReason: The fix passes a `promRule` prop that SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer does not accept, and it still passes `rulerRule={rule}`, which is undefined, to a drawer that requires a RulerGrafanaRuleDTO and reads grafana_alert.uid. It also relies on `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule`, which is not shown to exist, so the code would not compile or would crash and does not reliably target the rule UID.

9b57dc500f76825a234c2b8aa5be143280fea1ec.titleReason: The title names the defect: the URL is interpolated into raw HTML without being escaped.
9b57dc500f76825a234c2b8aa5be143280fea1ec.fixReason: The URL is now escaped in both places, but the code still appends with << on contents, so a nil contents still raises and the nil-handling obligation is not met.

0a36413972da87c69040a00431fee5568da5f6fb.titleReason: The title names the defect: TotalDocs iterates b.cache without holding cacheMu.
0a36413972da87c69040a00431fee5568da5f6fb.fixReason: The RLock/RUnlock logic is correct, but improvedCode ends with a closing brace while line 154's brace is outside the cited range, so the result has an extra `}` and will not compile.

d6e8b4e54dd187c9015f92484e03b0425edb0209.titleReason: The title names the defect: the cleanup targets the literal 'alias' instead of the real IDP alias.
d6e8b4e54dd187c9015f92484e03b0425edb0209.fixReason: Inside the loop, `idpRep.getAlias()` refers to the loop-scoped `idpRep`, so each cleanup targets idp-alias-i, and the second registration targets idp-alias-20, with all setup, organization associations and assertions kept unchanged.

d5af5c09810e0a90072e5696f7238331db68e79b.titleReason: The title names the defect: a dummy TOTP code lets a backup-code login bypass the password check.
d5af5c09810e0a90072e5696f7238331db68e79b.fixReason: The added check runs only `if (user.password)`, so an account with no stored password can still log in with a dummy totpCode and a valid backup code, and the reference explicitly requires rejecting missing stored passwords in this path.

1a8f1ba47f9ad443932ce2f17cb677cc06c9f1bb.titleReason: The title says the negative test does not isolate the forbidden removal call, which is the defect: the exception may come from the earlier read instead of from removal.
1a8f1ba47f9ad443932ce2f17cb677cc06c9f1bb.fixReason: It gets the scope ID through the privileged realm client before the try, calls only removeDefaultClientScope through the restricted client, keeps the fail and the ForbiddenException assertion, and uses a new variable name that does not clash with the later clientScopeRep, so the authorized removal test still works.

c1914e0082ad4b7af07f68a2956fcb1915c5a4a5.titleReason: The title states the defect: canExchangeTo throws UnsupportedOperationException instead of returning a boolean decision.
c1914e0082ad4b7af07f68a2956fcb1915c5a4a5.fixReason: Replacing the throw with a fail-closed `return false` keeps the method signature, returns a boolean, and denies unsupported V2 exchanges, which meets every obligation.

15d045fa217454450c58b025fe19b5055602f9ce.titleReason: The title says the enabled-flag test does not isolate the flag, which is the defect: the other blank settings hide whether the guard works.
15d045fa217454450c58b025fe19b5055602f9ce.fixReason: It keeps feed_polling_enabled? false, stubs the URL and username to the existing nonblank `url` and `embed_by_username` lets, and keeps the never-poll assertion, so the example fails if the enabled-flag guard is removed.

ce87a652009603d503e45af1d993fc8a53b45c16.titleReason: The title names the defect: stale member-fetch responses overwriting newer model state.
ce87a652009603d503e45af1d993fc8a53b45c16.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

fdac9cd324303873b5105f69c468fd87a6155f2c.titleReason: The title states the defect: the unsubscribe confirmation overstates which notifications are removed.
fdac9cd324303873b5105f69c468fd87a6155f2c.fixReason: The new wording only promises that notifications for every new post stop, which holds for both the regular and muted outcomes, and it keeps the key and the {{title}} interpolation.

2f623cc9a7577a2e25c10b72ae22c1c92e97d230.titleReason: The title says the URL and username tests never reach their guarded condition, which is the defect.
2f623cc9a7577a2e25c10b72ae22c1c92e97d230.fixReason: It enables polling but does not stub a nonblank username in the URL test or a nonblank URL in the username test, so the default blank values still short-circuit the guard and each test would pass even if its own check were removed.

f31e7c075ccd723eb554d849b4a58bd06a6cb34c.titleReason: The title states the defect: the automatic downsizing step corrupts SVG uploads.
f31e7c075ccd723eb554d849b4a58bd06a6cb34c.fixReason: Adding `&& filename !~ /\.svg$/i` to the condition skips downsizing for SVG names regardless of case, keeps the same eligibility and loop for other image formats, and leaves SVG bytes untouched for Upload.create_for.

8a14c20ef141bc8b16396cda367afee978a30a48.titleReason: The title names the defect accurately: the light-theme lightness of the topic-map h3 color was changed from 20% to 50%, and it points to the correct selector.
8a14c20ef141bc8b16396cda367afee978a30a48.fixReason: The replacement line sets the light theme back to primary at 20% lightness and the dark theme to secondary at 80%, and it keeps the indentation and the surrounding h3 styles.

b030f47c2f3a18a8066ce77aeece1b3944cb8a71.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: an existing per-client resource causes the global all-clients grant to be ignored.

1b53f8b18759479c250e149de87d8b7bdc6b263b.titleReason: The title names the defect: the dark-theme notification badge text has poor contrast against its background.

5b3a889090d0c9b603f7c4258575a40ede8d7fc8.titleReason: The title names the defect: the domain restriction regex is unanchored and escapes only dots, which is what allows suffix-appended domains and stray metacharacters through.
5b3a889090d0c9b603f7c4258575a40ede8d7fc8.fixReason: Each pipe-separated domain is escaped on its own and the match is anchored with an absolute \z, case-insensitively, inside the unchanged method, so all obligations are met (the added \A[^@\s]+ prefix is stricter but does not break the whitelist or blacklist flow).

aca94a7dce99b68e7480cc6caf2af635a21ac101.titleReason: The title states the defect: sendAddGuestsEmails is passed the unfiltered guest list rather than the filtered uniqueGuests.
aca94a7dce99b68e7480cc6caf2af635a21ac101.fixReason: Passing uniqueGuests (which the finding says is computed earlier in the handler) limits the 'new guest' classification to guests actually added, and evt.attendees is left unchanged, so both obligations are met.

3f63fdf46e7d9b6155744010caed57c96e2adacb.titleReason: The title describes the fix (replacing a plain Error with TRPCError) rather than the defect, which is that a client error is returned as a 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.
3f63fdf46e7d9b6155744010caed57c96e2adacb.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so no improvedCode is graded.

a150df08e867919dbb248a2be65fcf7716addaec.titleReason: The title says the minimum token schema's invalid computed keys strip the expiry fields, which is the defect the finding describes.
a150df08e867919dbb248a2be65fcf7716addaec.fixReason: The replacement requires a string access_token, keeps optional numeric expires_in and expiry_date, and preserves extra fields such as refresh_token through passthrough, so every obligation is met without breaking anything.

3c8bc96e9d0570e8ec74a716e5fcc38a29c93406.titleReason: The title says the override start-bound check ignores the slot's start time, which is the defect: slots starting before the override are not rejected.
3c8bc96e9d0570e8ec74a716e5fcc38a29c93406.fixReason: Adding slotStartTime.isBefore(offset-adjusted start) rejects slots that start before the override, lets a slot starting exactly at the override start pass (isBefore is strict), and keeps the existing offset adjustment and return-true semantics; the extra end-time checks are redundant but harmless.

6d15c018176d626bf43809b6441df502592b5575.titleReason: The title states the defect: remove_member bypasses the GroupUser callbacks when it deletes the join record, which is the cause of the stale counter cache.
6d15c018176d626bf43809b6441df502592b5575.fixReason: The improved code destroys only this group's matching group_users rows through destroy_all, so the callbacks fire and the counter cache is decremented, and it keeps the automatic-group guard and the existing response handling.

e3ed17c89a0f6177061dbe5e02a78b26eb0a40b5.titleReason: The title names the defect: success is judged by response.statusText, which can be empty on HTTP/2, so valid responses are rejected.
e3ed17c89a0f6177061dbe5e02a78b26eb0a40b5.fixReason: Replacing the statusText check with !response.ok accepts every successful HTTP response whatever its reason phrase and still throws the same HttpError on failure, and response.ok is a standard fetch Response property.

ec276a631ce889ca0adb1fd34821b475fd96451c.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: after the refresh, the connection is still built with the stale access token.
ec276a631ce889ca0adb1fd34821b475fd96451c.fixReason: The fix uses the refreshed access_token but keeps credentialKey.instance_url instead of accessTokenParsed.data.instance_url, so it misses the obligation to use the instance_url returned by the refresh.

6325418f9c731700bd394c6308333d6a7c9f22ff.titleReason: The title names the defect: base conditions are returned without enclosing parentheses, so SQL operator precedence misbehaves when callers compose them.
6325418f9c731700bd394c6308333d6a7c9f22ff.fixReason: Every single-operand branch is now wrapped with parameterized Prisma.sql, so an appended AND applies to every OR branch, and the both-present branch `(A) AND (B)` already composes safely while keeping the intersection and the deny-all behavior.

46a344c70ecd075075ce8fbf94ade7f4139e6281.titleReason: The title identifies the defect: terminate does not join the commit thread after signaling shutdown.
46a344c70ecd075075ce8fbf94ade7f4139e6281.fixReason: It uses an unchecked join(timeout=5.0), so terminate can still return while the commit thread is alive, which misses the obligation that the thread has exited before terminate returns normally.

29a4fe88e5c65e5cc9cccfcd8f5fe5a1f04c9829.titleReason: The title names the defect: error_ids are fetched from nodestore with no bound and before pagination.
29a4fe88e5c65e5cc9cccfcd8f5fe5a1f04c9829.fixReason: The fix caps error_ids at 100 before calling fetch_error_details, and it keeps the opt-out path, the empty-response handling, and error context for enabled requests unchanged.

2fe2a0f3c4f19bf3e4aaab09f62441504bc1fe5b.titleReason: The title names the defect: stale `rejectedEmails` entries keep email validation failing permanently.
2fe2a0f3c4f19bf3e4aaab09f62441504bc1fe5b.fixReason: The cached veto is kept, so a previously rejected address stays blocked until the user types a different email (which clears the list as a side effect inside a computed getter), so the address cannot simply be resubmitted for fresh server validation.

d91f4b3d81b6de1603fde337c28d0bacbdb4672a.titleReason: The title names the defect: the Mode 3 Create test uses one shared mock and never asserts the legacy call, so it cannot catch a missing legacy write.
d91f4b3d81b6de1603fde337c28d0bacbdb4672a.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

391b71935cacd631465e01d84e5bd05b81850bd2.titleReason: The title states the defect: the wrong isinstance guard means spawned worker processes are never killed.
391b71935cacd631465e01d84e5bd05b81850bd2.fixReason: `hasattr(process, "kill")` is true for SpawnProcess and false for threading.Thread, so unhealthy spawn workers are killed while threads are skipped, and the replacement call with the same index and shards plus the closed-process handling stay intact.

64328750adec91d08c45f9e4f44cbf546aecb1cb.titleReason: The title names the defect: the queue-depth gauge has no per-worker tag, so different workers' series overwrite each other.
64328750adec91d08c45f9e4f44cbf546aecb1cb.fixReason: Adding a `worker_id` tag from the stable `self.worker_id` index gives each worker its own series and keeps the metric name, `qsize()` value and identifier tag; Sentry metric tags accept int values, so not converting to str is fine.

102eeae30f865fd4cd279bab42b7df30e3d42ffe.titleReason: The title names the defect: the validation-failure warning logs the raw report payload, which the attacker controls.
102eeae30f865fd4cd279bab42b7df30e3d42ffe.fixReason: It removes raw_report but still logs serializer.errors, which can echo invalid input, and adds the unvalidated attacker-supplied report 'type', so it breaks the obligation not to log arbitrary input through metadata or validation-error messages.

4262078862c12b49af02ba550035e9a022b789f5.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the cache timestamp is formatted with a hard-coded en-US locale instead of the user's locale.
4262078862c12b49af02ba550035e9a022b789f5.fixReason: It calls the useLocale hook inside conditional JSX after the early return, which breaks the rules of hooks and the obligation to keep locale hooks unconditional and before the early return.

8445b6d313dfdbb9b48e79231e3e1ddf65b50c3e.titleReason: The title says the metadata lookup depends on the map's directory-name keys rather than the app slug, which is the mismatch that causes the 404.
8445b6d313dfdbb9b48e79231e3e1ddf65b50c3e.fixReason: The replacement matches the database slug against each metadata entry's `slug`, which handles apps whose directory name differs, keeps the 404 guard without duplicating the closing brace, and still returns an element with `slug` and `type` for the later credential operations.

be57dc3efb58e195a481ecc452228b41be11c05c.titleReason: The title states the defect: a Create storage failure is recorded in the legacy metric rather than the storage metric.
be57dc3efb58e195a481ecc452228b41be11c05c.fixReason: Switching to recordStorageDuration is the right change, but improvedCode ends with an extra closing brace that the cited lines 43-46 do not include, so the original brace on line 47 is duplicated and the function closes early, which breaks compilation (and the Update failure path at line 129 is also left unfixed).

3b1c0db3aab032ad60d00deb418a3702b9fe6ab6.titleReason: The title correctly says that successful cleanup batches are logged at error level with a nil err, which is the defect.
3b1c0db3aab032ad60d00deb418a3702b9fe6ab6.fixReason: The replacement fixes only the age-based flow at lines 534-537, but the obligations require the count-based (554/557) and orphaned-tag (576/579) flows to be fixed too, and those still emit error-level logs.

300d5d280b9c4d4e9c5e2b26f40b3d8670bacbfe.titleReason: The title names the defect: slots are wrongly treated as available on weekdays that have no working-hours entry.

fdf4e6b8cb741ba1a8fda74263dfdcf851fbfa6a.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect, which is that the host comparison is case-sensitive.
