7445a2f1e4e95df863d1e102f015f030c8708d58.titleReason: The title names the defect: the tempfile path has no original extension, so animated GIFs get flattened when downsized.
7445a2f1e4e95df863d1e102f015f030c8708d58.fixReason: The fix copies the upload into a temporary file that keeps the original extension, downsizes it with animation enabled, copies the result back into the original tempfile, and the block form of Tempfile.create removes the extra file on both success and failure.

c1acfc4f5fd6967d67fb97fd63e7063eeb708b28.titleReason: The title names the defect: saving without a selected category clears the category the server assigned.
c1acfc4f5fd6967d67fb97fd63e7063eeb708b28.fixReason: Deleting the assignment does not reliably fix the display, because the serializer returns category_id rather than a category object (per the reference notes), so the displayed category is not resolved from the persisted ID as required.

48070cea42a9460533aba7b554c9c792f7b17cc2.titleReason: The title states the defect: the client-side unsubscribe route shows success while the notification preference stays unchanged.
48070cea42a9460533aba7b554c9c792f7b17cc2.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

4ab123bca646b45d990b4d2e674c1370c199267f.titleReason: The title names the defect: each embed retrieval synchronously imports the whole feed, which matches the finding.
4ab123bca646b45d990b4d2e674c1370c199267f.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so no fix is graded.

b7df8cdf3ff8e3d34a05925578e71d8b7f6fa366.titleReason: The title states the defect: an all-clients VIEW grant bypasses explicit denials on individual clients.
b7df8cdf3ff8e3d34a05925578e71d8b7f6fa366.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so there is no local fix to grade.

1cdbe41ff1f7139a48cc22d6e378df46dafc5bce.titleReason: The title says the mobile message-length colors are inverted between light and dark themes, which is the defect.
1cdbe41ff1f7139a48cc22d6e378df46dafc5bce.fixReason: The replacement uses $primary at 70% for the light theme and $secondary at 30% for the dark theme, keeps the theme-aware dark-light-choose call, and is valid SCSS.

8a25419ae152e7fed1c19b0ce8be2ce992a168e0.titleReason: The title says the no-arg canManage() grants group management to view-only subjects, which is the defect described.
8a25419ae152e7fed1c19b0ce8be2ce992a168e0.fixReason: The replacement drops VIEW so only all-groups MANAGE passes, and it keeps the MANAGE_USERS role bypass, meeting every obligation with no new issues.

b248d8598bcb2ea3fb0ede8b0f589e0ce617e344.titleReason: The title states the defect: duplicate member additions raise errors, and partial membership state can be left behind.
b248d8598bcb2ea3fb0ede8b0f589e0ce617e344.fixReason: The improved code skips existing members and repeated users by resolved user id, runs inside a transaction that explicitly rolls back when save fails, keeps the automatic-group rejection and the skipping of unknown usernames, and keeps both responses.

58147b861bb776de0949b286fdd49b5b5c0c561f.titleReason: The title states the defect: a website on a subdomain of the instance host loses its path in the displayed website name.
58147b861bb776de0949b286fdd49b5b5c0c561f.fixReason: The replacement checks dot-bounded suffix matches in both directions, so subdomains (nested ones included) and parent hosts keep their path and unrelated domains return only the host, and it uses ends_with? and the existing local variables, which are valid here.

8d01e7f7115b089ae638b756b549c8fb2fcb6131.titleReason: The title states the defect: when no calendar ID is given, updateEvent fails to fall back to the main destination calendar, which matches the finding.
8d01e7f7115b089ae638b756b549c8fb2fcb6131.fixReason: The replacement keeps a supplied externalCalendarId and otherwise uses mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId, a variable already defined in scope that safely handles an empty or null destinationCalendar, so every obligation is met.

282ef5f7b343785eae3865b1f5a1cdfedf3f8266.titleReason: The title names the defect: collective hosts' calendars are dropped when the destination calendar is null.
282ef5f7b343785eae3865b1f5a1cdfedf3f8266.fixReason: The fix starts the array as empty when it is null and then pushes the team calendars, so existing entries keep their place, the change stays inside the collective guard, and the brace structure stays intact.

a69672b51353d1fb5c55c9f277bab277b17983d8.titleReason: The title names the defect: a single SendGrid cancellation failure aborts the loop, so the remaining reminders are skipped.
a69672b51353d1fb5c55c9f277bab277b17983d8.fixReason: It wraps each cancellation in its own try/catch so the loop keeps going, queues deletes only after a successful cancellation, awaits the deletes in a separate try/catch so the scheduling phase still runs, and keeps reminders whose cancellation failed, which meets every obligation.

a0524a1c384a275caeded09b53ab045e859fca08.titleReason: The title names the defect: in non-sharing flows a missing refresh token gets replaced with a placeholder, which matches the finding.
a0524a1c384a275caeded09b53ab045e859fca08.fixReason: The placeholder is now injected only when both conditions that select the minimum-schema branch hold, so the non-sharing branch no longer synthesizes a token, existing refresh tokens are kept, and sharing/sync behavior is unchanged.

a1d6e1d85699aef6975ab789d23c4f49382e6efe.titleReason: The title names the inverted billing condition that causes slugs to be assigned in the wrong case, which matches the defect.
a1d6e1d85699aef6975ab789d23c4f49382e6efe.fixReason: The improved code restores the `!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` slug condition and leaves the requestedSlug and other metadata unchanged, which meets every obligation.

613c5b9b04fddc0c82f5d9613fc4f503e86e3568.titleReason: The title names the defect: temporarily locked SMS reminders are counted as failures and end up deleted, which matches the finding.
613c5b9b04fddc0c82f5d9613fc4f503e86e3568.fixReason: Deleting lines 178-186 leaves line 187's brace closing the `if (scheduledSMS)` block, so a locked skip no longer increments retryCount, while successful updates and the catch-block retry counting stay intact.

cbc24f678f2d20294f8f4f8a2519b37e239b07b2.titleReason: The title states the defect: video booking references lose the credential ID that updates and deletion depend on.
cbc24f678f2d20294f8f4f8a2519b37e239b07b2.fixReason: Using result.credentialId unconditionally keeps the credential for both video and calendar references, and externalCalendarId stays limited to calendar results, so every obligation is met.

39f40385ade2301d69077162fe0c8d8e9ccc3da8.titleReason: The title states the defect: with multiple overrides on the same day, slots that are actually available get rejected.
39f40385ade2301d69077162fe0c8d8e9ccc3da8.fixReason: The new check accepts any slot that only partially overlaps an override (for example override 10:00-12:00 with slot 9:30-10:30, or a slot starting exactly at the override end), so it misses the obligation that a matching interval must contain the entire slot.

2286a55bcfe13d12ebc5f9793cf11ef3fb0e0d23.titleReason: The title says the team role check wrongly denies users who hold only the admin or only the owner role, which is the defect caused by the `&&` combination.
2286a55bcfe13d12ebc5f9793cf11ef3fb0e0d23.fixReason: Changing `&&` to `||` authorizes either an admin or an owner, uses only the names already imported, and leaves the organizer/attendee checks and the FORBIDDEN rejection on lines 50-56 unchanged.

bb29d0ce22675b989b50c268a25fe25a259878c8.titleReason: The title says that schedules with split working-hour ranges wrongly reject available slots, which is the defect described.
bb29d0ce22675b989b50c268a25fe25a259878c8.fixReason: It rejects a slot only when working hours exist and no interval for that weekday contains it, measuring the end from the real slot end; empty working hours skip the check and the busy-time validation still runs afterward.

4d72930e770e7a90229344e199b52be9f4ac0524.titleReason: The title names both defects: the slot end is ignored in the working-hours check, and valid slots are wrongly rejected for split working hours.
4d72930e770e7a90229344e199b52be9f4ac0524.fixReason: The code computes the end from slotEndTime as unwrapped minutes since the start of the day, accepts a slot when some same-day interval contains all of it, guards the empty workingHours case, and still falls through to the busy check, so every obligation is met (the float diff only adds harmless fractional precision).

8de94e12b6b6f0a640969b331dc9e4171cf0523c.titleReason: The title names the lost-update race in the catch-block retry increment, which is the defect the finding describes.
8de94e12b6b6f0a640969b331dc9e4171cf0523c.fixReason: The replacement uses Prisma's atomic `{ increment: 1 }` on the same reminder.id update, keeps the await, and leaves the catch block and logging intact without duplicating the closing `});`.

ee6da882ab2bfbced2343cf53ca86ab28f59dca7.titleReason: The title names the defect: override times wrap at midnight and lose their calendar-day displacement.
ee6da882ab2bfbced2343cf53ca86ab28f59dca7.fixReason: It drops the organizer-to-invitee offset conversion (`void offset`) and uses a direct `.tz(timeZone).diff(...)`, which the reference says is not equivalent because override dates hold organizer wall time in UTC-shaped values, so it breaks the conversion obligation.

58a72e624fdd47fcca1e37818de252750e72832f.titleReason: The title says the defect: a failed retry-count update aborts the whole SMS reminder batch.
58a72e624fdd47fcca1e37818de252750e72832f.fixReason: It wraps the retryCount update in its own try/catch, so update failures are contained while the increment still runs, and the original error log on line 198 stays in place after the replacement.

4cf347680e1e1e22892dc8a6e8cf94f76330c18c.titleReason: The title names the defect: recurring cancellation deletes events through the organizer's credentials instead of each co-host's own credential.
4cf347680e1e1e22892dc8a6e8cf94f76330c18c.fixReason: It maps over only the resolved `calendarCredential` (including one loaded from the DB), matches each occurrence's reference by `credentialId`, and deletes it by that reference's `uid` and `externalCalendarId` through the outer `calendar` built from that same credential, while keeping the braces, push, and `Promise.all` error handling intact.

d1b296235b5c8671a1ee3387aa475279642b3047.titleReason: The title names the defect: the app-store imports load every app and its dependencies eagerly instead of on demand.
d1b296235b5c8671a1ee3387aa475279642b3047.fixReason: The answer's fixStatus is "needs-wider-change", not "local", so there is no improvedCode to grade.

2a572ae7e9e189270059b47f07bc71993c981b20.titleReason: The title names the defect: invalid webhook bodies raise validation errors that are not handled, so the handler returns 500.
2a572ae7e9e189270059b47f07bc71993c981b20.fixReason: The safeParse change returns 400 for schema failures, but it misses the obligation to return 400 for keys that cannot be decrypted or that decrypt to invalid JSON, which still throw unhandled at lines 57-59.

4f41632ac9a902fc23da7de4ec5d30cd2f67ab2c.titleReason: The title names the defect: the global cleanup ticker was set to one minute, which multiplies database and I/O load.
4f41632ac9a902fc23da7de4ec5d30cd2f67ab2c.fixReason: The improved code puts the ticker back to ten minutes and keeps the startup temp-file cleanup and the loop structure, so it meets every obligation.

a01c2847179426c92e40b4052cf44d4c33a5a545.titleReason: The title names the defect: duplicate guest emails are accepted and produce duplicate attendee records.
a01c2847179426c92e40b4052cf44d4c33a5a545.fixReason: The refine rejects requests with repeated email strings, keeps the email and numeric bookingId validation, and still accepts distinct valid emails; the reference notes explicitly allow rejecting duplicates.

0b9cf715db7776045eb6c8c928f4db5cfad9b319.titleReason: The title says that an undefined Grafana rule wrongly enables Duplicate for data-source rules, which is the defect the finding describes.
0b9cf715db7776045eb6c8c928f4db5cfad9b319.fixReason: Adding `!rule ||` to MaybeSupported makes Duplicate unsupported when the rule is undefined, while keeping the loading and plugin-provided restrictions and the Grafana create permission requirement for eligible rules.

35b251b8a5615eddeb6ad6a424896bcad63c01e4.titleReason: The title names the defect: once the shutdown deadline expires, the remaining flusher processes are not terminated.
35b251b8a5615eddeb6ad6a424896bcad63c01e4.fixReason: Removing the break makes the loop visit every worker, but the guard still checks isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process), which does not match the SpawnProcess workers created by self.mp_context, so those processes are still never terminated.

4e4610ee01a3b9360ceb90e62165f4fcd63f238a.titleReason: The title says span eviction can remove the segment root and break reconstruction, which is the defect the finding describes.
4e4610ee01a3b9360ceb90e62165f4fcd63f238a.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

fad4bc5631801052fe6d6455c40955dd28f7f2ed.titleReason: The title names both parts of the defect: the strategy lifecycle shuts down the shared queues, and stale commit threads can keep running.
fad4bc5631801052fe6d6455c40955dd28f7f2ed.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

8e6adba5b2ad9af11e296f096b50608020cf888d.titleReason: The title names the defect as stated: the work queues are unbounded, so nothing applies backpressure when traffic bursts.
8e6adba5b2ad9af11e296f096b50608020cf888d.fixReason: The queues get a finite maxsize, put() blocks when a queue is full so no message is dropped, the offset is still registered before the put, and the hashing and FIFO order are unchanged.

9b15b1eb4477375b0d1f8fe6bbcf219e24b65f01.titleReason: The title names the defect: the default SUM aggregation corrupts the timestamp scores of duplicate spans when sets are merged.
9b15b1eb4477375b0d1f8fe6bbcf219e24b65f01.fixReason: Both zunionstore calls now use AGGREGATE MAX, and the merge conditions, span_count assignment, unlink cleanup and cited-range structure (closing end left out) are unchanged.

59a17b71bd37b359935c21c52a0cf6b4bd1835c5.titleReason: The title names the defect: the redirect traversal limit was reduced, so segments with deep redirect chains get split.
59a17b71bd37b359935c21c52a0cf6b4bd1835c5.fixReason: The improved code restores the 10000 loop bound, keeps the break on missing or self redirects and the redirect_depth assignment, and leaves the traversal limit independent of the 1000-span eviction cap.

25250ece516eaba02e7b37c9b480aaea5c5302c7.titleReason: The title says website_name exposes restricted user website information, which is the disclosure defect, though it leaves out the missing '?' detail.
25250ece516eaba02e7b37c9b480aaea5c5302c7.fixReason: The code defines the recognized include_website_name? hook and omits website_name when the website is blank or scope.restrict_user_fields?(object) is true, so all obligations are met.

d849e6a763ac692f7f567f1063106a3043906bc1.titleReason: The title states the defect, that fallback translations are not loaded for background jobs and mailers, which matches the finding.
d849e6a763ac692f7f567f1063106a3043906bc1.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

c22e776cec5b95e58df7e5a98b13eb2c77530f5d.titleReason: The title says that variant count expressions (aliases, whitespace) slip past the upsampling transform, which is the defect described.
c22e776cec5b95e58df7e5a98b13eb2c77530f5d.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context, not local, so there is no fix to grade.

979c4d0b6f51f20662374321de50130ba4173a10.titleReason: The title says that failed processing still marks offsets complete, which allows data loss, and that is the defect.
979c4d0b6f51f20662374321de50130ba4173a10.fixReason: Moving complete_offset into an else clause means it runs only when processing succeeds. Failed and ShutDown paths stay outstanding, logging and the break are preserved, and the remaining finally still runs the metrics gauge on every attempt.

1e02013d4e278e4c285de08c61cfc59960aa1acc.titleReason: The title names the defect: description-only RSS items leave content nil, and the resulting error aborts the feed import.
1e02013d4e278e4c285de08c61cfc59960aa1acc.fixReason: The fix falls back to description when content is nil, skips items with no body using `next` so later items still import, and keeps scrub plus CGI.unescapeHTML, which meets every obligation.

dd71bfe1bebb4ab28f33aab7c34f91c7b0db910a.titleReason: The title names both failure modes from the finding: V2-only setups skip cleanup, and having both features enabled can throw.
dd71bfe1bebb4ab28f33aab7c34f91c7b0db910a.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context, not local, so there is no fix to grade.

1b29c0f2adaf990987904c2461ba7b2c759f468a.titleReason: The title names the defect: the unrestricted remote embed fetch allows SSRF through arbitrary ports and redirects.
1b29c0f2adaf990987904c2461ba7b2c759f468a.fixReason: It stops redirects, limits schemes and ports, and blocks private IPs, but it never checks `uri.host` against `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, so it misses the obligation to restrict the initial request to the configured host.

25c643b385ae266a275e00eadee4869ff7b7b879.titleReason: The title names the defect: missing category settings make the migration crash.
25c643b385ae266a275e00eadee4869ff7b7b879.fixReason: The nil guards stop the crash, but when the uncategorized_category_id setting is absent the code falls back to 0 instead of the application's default uncategorized category id (e.g. SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id), which misses that obligation.

ff00b3dec3803c03a36994b9094237096bfb7fe0.titleReason: The title names the defect: the header component cannot shrink, so the long-title ellipsis is lost.
ff00b3dec3803c03a36994b9094237096bfb7fe0.fixReason: The `.ember-view` class appears nowhere in the shown code, and the selector would also match other Ember-rendered direct children such as the `.title` logo component, which the reference deliberately excludes, so the logo could shrink and break its sizing constraints.

837a3cb83b913cabff39eb43133c9cb07c124f51.titleReason: The title names the defect: TotalDocs reads the cache map without synchronization and so races with BuildIndex's write.
837a3cb83b913cabff39eb43133c9cb07c124f51.fixReason: The improved code takes cacheMu.RLock with a deferred RUnlock in TotalDocs, keeps the summing and error-skipping logic, and leaves BuildIndex's locked insertion intact, so every obligation is met.

3ff8d4f437e22154e1a86118643634a25b5e5f79.titleReason: The title names the defect: offset gaps block partition commits, though the reference shows the blockage is temporary rather than permanent.
3ff8d4f437e22154e1a86118643634a25b5e5f79.fixReason: Iterating sorted delivered offsets above last_committed and stopping only at an outstanding offset advances across gaps, keeps the watermark and lock untouched, and returns offsets in the existing convention; the removed `start` variable is not used anywhere else.

6f195e7cade787841994e176475e484f9f28be25.titleReason: The title says the problem: once per-client resources exist, the global (all-clients) grants are ignored, which matches the defect.
6f195e7cade787841994e176475e484f9f28be25.fixReason: The improvedCode is the same as the example fix: it accepts a per-client grant through hasGrantedPermission, otherwise falls through to the all-clients resource evaluated by the existing code below, denies when there is no resource or policy, and leaves the same-realm and resource-server checks untouched.

2a4e61acaaee43615801abfc499910779616d8de.titleReason: The title says the forbidden scope read hides missing permission checks on removal, which is the defect described.
2a4e61acaaee43615801abfc499910779616d8de.fixReason: The fix gets the scope ID through the privileged realm client outside the try block, calls only removeDefaultClientScope through the restricted client before permissions are granted, keeps the fail and Forbidden assertion, avoids the later clientScopeRep name clash, and leaves the authorized removal test unchanged.

a423dfd99490cb9e6961767ab89e0fbfc8d30a8f.titleReason: The title states the defect: the token refresh persists the parse-result wrapper instead of the Google credential data.
a423dfd99490cb9e6961767ab89e0fbfc8d30a8f.fixReason: The fix persists the parsed `parsed.data` and checks `success` before persisting, which keeps validation; the same credential update and refresh flow are unchanged, and the closing delimiter stays outside the anchor.

9280e2f6657dde35176c01471921f0f11e9c1536.titleReason: The title states the defect: supplying a TOTP code lets backup-code login skip password verification.
9280e2f6657dde35176c01471921f0f11e9c1536.fixReason: The added guard rejects any request with both backupCode and totpCode before a backup code is consumed, which closes the bypass while leaving password-verified backup-code login and the TOTP-only path unchanged.

8c1bf95ccfe1d3023a97f0f84e7fd437cb047b01.titleReason: The title states the defect: the enabled-flag test passes only because the other polling prerequisites are blank, so it does not actually exercise the flag.
8c1bf95ccfe1d3023a97f0f84e7fd437cb047b01.fixReason: The replacement keeps feed_polling_enabled? false, stubs the URL and username to the existing let values, and keeps the never-poll assertion, so removing the enabled-flag guard would make the example fail.

1cf707a4125a921a3045cc108f7dc91ce73fdeec.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: stale member-fetch responses overwrite newer navigation and refresh results.
1cf707a4125a921a3045cc108f7dc91ce73fdeec.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so no improvedCode is graded.

4027a50116c8dc2d900d0fbd4db4ead9150554be.titleReason: The title says that canExchangeTo throws instead of denying token exchange in V2, which is the defect described in the finding.
4027a50116c8dc2d900d0fbd4db4ead9150554be.fixReason: Returning false keeps the method signature, gives a fail-closed boolean decision instead of throwing, and meets every obligation without adding new problems.

bf53961d488cd1c554f96ea4f8d8f84dc4b70ac5.titleReason: The title says the URL and username requirement tests short-circuit on disabled polling, which is the defect: the tests never reach the condition they claim to check.
bf53961d488cd1c554f96ea4f8d8f84dc4b70ac5.fixReason: Each example now enables polling, sets the other required setting to a nonblank value using the existing `url` and `embed_by_username` lets, and keeps the `never` assertion, so each test fails if its own guard is removed.

b67b28ed3a1dffe0cfb4bbe7fcacff45bd1ebd81.titleReason: The title states the defect: topic-map headings now render lighter in the light theme, which is the regression from 20% to 50%.
b67b28ed3a1dffe0cfb4bbe7fcacff45bd1ebd81.fixReason: The replacement uses primary at 20% for the light theme and secondary at 80% for the dark theme, and it changes only the color line, so the surrounding heading styles are kept.

ff5c9e9bc644eeccee9827c7a5587a1e0ea1238d.titleReason: The title says stale rejected-email entries permanently block submission, which matches the defect.
ff5c9e9bc644eeccee9827c7a5587a1e0ea1238d.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

a987cc6fb980c9276d2f3206b008169f8d43a9d2.titleReason: The title names the defect: removing a member leaves the cached member count stale, which matches the finding's counter-cache problem.
a987cc6fb980c9276d2f3206b008169f8d43a9d2.fixReason: Destroying the scoped group_users records with destroy_all runs the GroupUser callbacks so the counter cache decrements, removes only this group's membership, and keeps the automatic-group guard and response handling unchanged.

be5643ac5696849dce81421172b042fc7081e5bd.titleReason: The title names the defect: successful token responses get rejected because the check relies on statusText, which can be empty.
be5643ac5696849dce81421172b042fc7081e5bd.fixReason: Checking `!response.ok` accepts every 2xx response whatever its statusText and still throws an HttpError for unsuccessful responses, which meets both obligations.

1a4a52f75ac80d7694834e9f28658056d844fdab.titleReason: The title names the defect: slots that start before the override window are wrongly treated as available.
1a4a52f75ac80d7694834e9f28658056d844fdab.fixReason: Adding slotStartTime.isBefore(offset-adjusted start) rejects early-starting slots, a slot starting exactly at the override start still passes, and the original end checks, offset adjustment and return-true rejection behavior are kept.

43b82cfaa5f484132de1282d47fb2d6f3cf78500.titleReason: The title says that passing the raw guest input misclassifies existing attendees in the notification emails, which is the defect the finding describes.
43b82cfaa5f484132de1282d47fb2d6f3cf78500.fixReason: Passing uniqueGuests means only the filtered, newly added guests count as new, and evt keeps the full attendee list; this matches the reference fix, assuming uniqueGuests is in scope as the finding and reference both indicate.

5199b4c71364cc527ca5120557b7e3904a6741a3.titleReason: The title states that refresh token parsing strips expiry and provider-specific fields, which is the defect the finding describes.
5199b4c71364cc527ca5120557b7e3904a6741a3.fixReason: The replacement requires a string access_token, validates optional numeric expires_in and expiry_date, and uses passthrough to keep other fields such as refresh_token, so it meets every obligation and adds no new problem.

4c26f16564de3a22fe48ebdc9b63b099b732e63c.titleReason: The title names the defect: dark-theme notification badges have too little contrast between text and background.
4c26f16564de3a22fe48ebdc9b63b099b732e63c.fixReason: In light themes the background is the same as before, and in dark themes $primary is light, so scaling it gives a light background behind the dark $secondary text on both linked and unlinked badges, while the specialized variants keep their own overrides.

1d0d2ccee4bb42703f3bfc98d0c01b0b0b9b7617.titleReason: The title names the unbounded fetching of error payloads on every paginated request, which is the defect, and it does not describe the fix.
1d0d2ccee4bb42703f3bfc98d0c01b0b0b9b7617.fixReason: Slicing error_ids[:100] before calling fetch_error_details caps the nodestore load ahead of retrieval, keeps the opt-out and empty-response handling unchanged, and still supplies error context when it is enabled.

276cc5a059e195e5685b8984b83f8da3cbe77a91.titleReason: The title says the validation-failure warning logs sensitive, attacker-controlled report contents, which is the defect the finding describes.

5a9f9c5d96524b7cb64115ad44ff2e968ec7568f.titleReason: The title states the defect: mocking delete_matched_rows keeps the max_segment_id=None path from ever running, so the test cannot exercise the guard.
5a9f9c5d96524b7cb64115ad44ff2e968ec7568f.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

3cd9efdc1e8caf7c8230d10e60e1460e1650e51f.titleReason: The title says the buttons' right float no longer aligns them to the right under the new flex layout, which is the symptom the finding describes, though the reference puts the cause in the content-sized description box.
3cd9efdc1e8caf7c8230d10e60e1460e1650e51f.fixReason: The buttons are nested inside .small-action-desc, so the `> button { margin-left: auto; }` selector matches nothing, and the description is never made to fill the row width as the reference requires.

b92ad9ac7e11fa941244fca411d1aa5a527b5674.titleReason: The title correctly identifies that the postgres skip hides startup regressions from the eager Init change, which matches the finding.
b92ad9ac7e11fa941244fca411d1aa5a527b5674.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so the fix is not graded.

e84781d00ac6a65ea0e082cb421f0e98e522fcfb.titleReason: The title names the defect: the "80%" geometry is invalid for the downsize path (notably gifsicle) and its failure result is ignored.
e84781d00ac6a65ea0e082cb421f0e98e522fcfb.fixReason: The fix computes positive pixel WxH geometry from the current FastImage dimensions on each iteration, keeps the size threshold, the animation option and the 5-attempt bound, and breaks when dimensions are unreadable or downsize returns false.

b7daffb116be6723cf90ce3925be6016a800d9f3.titleReason: The title names the defect: oversized animated GIF uploads are flattened to a single frame during downsizing.
b7daffb116be6723cf90ce3925be6016a800d9f3.fixReason: It copies the upload to a path ending in the original extension so the optimizer chooses animated processing for GIFs, copies the result back into the original tempfile, and removes the extra file in an ensure block; the gifsicle pixel-geometry requirement is not visible in this item's input.

e042ca6fd4ff05e46acf0270fb778f70a29ff8e3.titleReason: The title names the defect: the same-parent-domain check wrongly matches unrelated sites that share a public suffix such as co.uk.
e042ca6fd4ff05e46acf0270fb778f70a29ff8e3.fixReason: The fix calls PublicSuffix.domain, but no public-suffix dependency exists in the repository, so the code would raise NameError, and the reference says merely referencing PublicSuffix fails.

54482e4a7dae0bd4088b493e45bff693d9c4b20d.titleReason: The title names the off-by-one overcount in totalPages when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, which is the defect in the finding.
54482e4a7dae0bd4088b493e45bff693d9c4b20d.fixReason: The improvedCode uses Math.ceil(user_count / limit), keeps the zero-page return for an empty group, and keeps the property dependencies on limit and user_count, so it meets every obligation.

f678d8facd93311666225d9947a2c6f8b5c5bb44.titleReason: The title names the defect: the upload size check uses a hardcoded 10MB limit instead of the configured site settings.
f678d8facd93311666225d9947a2c6f8b5c5bb44.fixReason: The improvedCode reads the limit from Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb'], rejects files strictly larger than that limit in KB, and shows that limit in the existing error message, so every obligation is met with no new defect.

322c03da602568a543601080b37a0d63aa396365.titleReason: The title names the defect: each embed retrieval synchronously re-imports the whole RSS feed.
322c03da602568a543601080b37a0d63aa396365.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so no improvedCode is graded.

4b96e6348ebc76e29e771125d52628dca0f6fa20.titleReason: The title says the blocked email lookup is case-sensitive and that this lets a differently cased address bypass the blocklist, which is the defect.
4b96e6348ebc76e29e771125d52628dca0f6fa20.fixReason: Lowercasing both the stored column and the input gives an exact case-insensitive match with no wildcards, and the match count updates and block/do_nothing logic stay unchanged.

bdf767c7950b0725ee10951d89c5841c3d864409.titleReason: The title names the defect: when no category is selected, the save callback clears the host's category, which matches the finding.
bdf767c7950b0725ee10951d89c5841c3d864409.fixReason: The fix guesses the server's fallback using `Discourse.Site.currentProp('uncategorized_category_id')`, an API that appears in neither the shown code nor the reference, instead of resolving the category from the persisted `category_id` as the obligation requires.

d3477981424e4b010637b60a8bd9eec8f7269a21.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the route displays unsubscribe success while the notification level stays the same.
d3477981424e4b010637b60a8bd9eec8f7269a21.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so no fix is graded.

46fc882bc2b6c1ddebe2f2b89f02fb84f8486152.titleReason: The title correctly identifies that the mobile message-length color has inverted lightness values for both light and dark themes.
46fc882bc2b6c1ddebe2f2b89f02fb84f8486152.fixReason: The replacement restores $primary at 70% lightness for light themes and uses $secondary at 30% for dark themes while keeping dark-light-choose, satisfying both obligations.

dabb28994e415a83950e31e2308d63f450d422db.titleReason: The title states the defect: the same-domain check misses website hosts that are subdomains of the instance host.
dabb28994e415a83950e31e2308d63f450d422db.fixReason: Ruby's ternary binds looser than ||, so the added reverse check website_host.ends_with?("." + discourse_host) runs correctly; it covers nested subdomains, keeps the parent-host case and the dot boundary, returns only the host for unrelated domains, and uses the existing ends_with? method.

c3c4d7e09857bb540b552df43c41a592ecd36bce.titleReason: The title names the defect: the light-theme color for .group-member-info .name changed from 30% to 50% lightness, which matches the finding.
c3c4d7e09857bb540b552df43c41a592ecd36bce.fixReason: The replacement line restores primary at 30% and secondary at 70% and keeps the same declaration, so every obligation is met with nothing else changed.

b08ab70b7c5f2a0769f08247763ffbe8f2968bf7.titleReason: The title states the defect: add_members raises on duplicate usernames or existing members, and the additions are not atomic.
b08ab70b7c5f2a0769f08247763ffbe8f2968bf7.fixReason: It skips existing and repeated members, but group.save runs outside the transaction with no explicit rollback, so the batch is not rolled back when the final save fails, which the obligations require.

6a768e16a3043c06a069fdbaab313b7296716668.titleReason: The title states that getClientsWithPermission never matches the untyped per-client V2 resources, which is the defect the finding describes.
6a768e16a3043c06a069fdbaab313b7296716668.fixReason: The improvedCode handles only per-client resources and skips the all-clients type resource, so an all-clients grant no longer yields any client IDs, which misses the obligation to include applicable all-clients grants.

dd90d5cc6557739b22469ca264d05bf4df2fa7b7.titleReason: The title names the defect: JPA group filtering still requires legacy group.resource.<id> names, which V2 resources lack, so V2 group permissions fail to match.
dd90d5cc6557739b22469ca264d05bf4df2fa7b7.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

fa21f63b147d169ab60083e5b66ed7be1351bd81.titleReason: The title names the defect: when externalCalendarId is empty, the updateEvent fallback never matches a destination calendar.
fa21f63b147d169ab60083e5b66ed7be1351bd81.fixReason: The replacement keeps a supplied externalCalendarId, falls back to mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId (defined at line 198 and safe when destinationCalendar is empty or null), and matches the obligations.

e1308e1f96063162e01a411858a5d5c7e1b9f08c.titleReason: The title correctly says that record_for_host ignores the port, so host:port entries never match, which is the defect described.
e1308e1f96063162e01a411858a5d5c7e1b9f08c.fixReason: For non-default ports it queries only 'host:port' with no hostname-only fallback, which breaks existing hostname-only entries for such URLs, and it never matches explicitly configured default-port entries like 'example.com:443', violating the host:port matching and hostname-preservation obligations.

64d5197a9c2cd9dee300a72dfad0fb59e4063d89.titleReason: The title states that a single SendGrid cancellation failure aborts cancellation and deletion of the remaining reminders, which matches the finding.
64d5197a9c2cd9dee300a72dfad0fb59e4063d89.fixReason: Per-reminder try/catch keeps the loop going, only successfully cancelled reminders are queued for deletion, the deletions are awaited in a separate try/catch, and errors are logged without blocking the scheduling phase, so every obligation is met using names from the existing code.

b47148839d641a19ce260a901f7ea751ef5347cd.titleReason: The title names the defect: mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration is accessed without a guard and throws when destinationCalendar is empty, which matches the finding.
b47148839d641a19ce260a901f7ea751ef5347cd.fixReason: Optional chaining stops the throw for null, undefined, or empty arrays and makes an absent destination fail the google_calendar check, so the Cal Video fallback is selected, while Meet stays with a Google Calendar destination and unrelated locations are unaffected.

4a4c918fa0e4c5831911407be18fbd21ad001c3e.titleReason: The title names the defect: a placeholder refresh_token overwrites the valid stored token when the provider response omits it.
4a4c918fa0e4c5831911407be18fbd21ad001c3e.fixReason: The replacement adds the placeholder only when both the sharing flag and the sync endpoint are set, which matches the minimum-schema branch, keeps any refresh_token that was supplied, and uses only names already in the file.

2cea3609235dd9b98bff815040b931006a9428c7.titleReason: The title names the inverted slug condition: slug is set when billing is enabled and left out when billing is disabled, which matches the finding.
2cea3609235dd9b98bff815040b931006a9428c7.fixReason: The improvedCode matches the example fix: it restores the negated condition so slug is set only when billing is disabled, keeps requestedSlug when billing is enabled, and leaves the rest of the metadata as it was.

5523c66bbcb94323a715b419b9d7f0f4a54dae57.titleReason: The title names the defect: anonymous embed requests can enqueue unbounded RetrieveTopic jobs, one per distinct URL.
5523c66bbcb94323a715b419b9d7f0f4a54dae57.fixReason: It adds Redis-backed per-IP and global counters that are independent of the embed URL and atomic across workers, still lets anonymous retrieval through within the limits, and leaves the existing-topic branch untouched.

b1cb757f4b795c6bc91120f923cae30ba4251439.titleReason: The title names the defect: a locked-SMS skip is counted as a failure, which leads to the reminder being deleted after retries.
b1cb757f4b795c6bc91120f923cae30ba4251439.fixReason: The replacement keeps a balanced `else` block (closed by the existing line 187) that only logs and no longer increments retryCount, so skipped reminders stay unscheduled while successful updates and catch-block retry counting are unchanged.

f5d27400897327963c53ac121cbf254519f51a5f.titleReason: The title states the defect: Dayjs objects are compared with === (reference equality), so a full-day unavailable override is never detected.
f5d27400897327963c53ac121cbf254519f51a5f.fixReason: Replacing === with isSame compares the offset-adjusted endpoints by timestamp value, so an equal-endpoint override on the matching day returns true and makes the outer function return false, while unequal-endpoint overrides still go through the existing bounds checks.

735f18996929ffabbd5d52fc0697020217d32690.titleReason: The title states the defect: the date-override early return skips the busy-time conflict check.
735f18996929ffabbd5d52fc0697020217d32690.fixReason: The replacement runs the existing busy-interval logic for override days, which rejects overlapping slots, allows slots that only touch a busy interval at an endpoint, and skips the working-hours check while leaving the currentSeats and non-override paths unchanged.

6ff2d1b1e3adb62797714bdfd2bd8242acc13e2e.titleReason: The title says the guest blacklist check can be bypassed through email case or plus-address aliases, which is exactly the defect in the finding.
6ff2d1b1e3adb62797714bdfd2bd8242acc13e2e.fixReason: The inline toBaseEmail lowercases each guest and strips any plus alias before comparing it to the lowercased blacklist, while keeping the attendee-exclusion check, the original submitted emails, empty-blacklist behavior and the untouched closing `);`, so it fixes the bypass without breaking anything.

b8c4dbf8d97c8d9b641c5bd1ddff68c56c5fe515.titleReason: The title names the defect: recurring cancellation deletes through the organizer's credentials instead of the current reference's resolved credential, which matches the finding.
b8c4dbf8d97c8d9b641c5bd1ddff68c56c5fe515.fixReason: The replacement matches the example fix: it uses the resolved calendarCredential (including one loaded from the DB), selects each occurrence's reference by credentialId, deletes with that reference's uid and externalCalendarId, and leaves the push, closing blocks, and Promise.all error handling intact.

60b8da39005fc2806c62e67647a0cb9e38f4b68b.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: createEvent always targets the first host's destination calendar instead of the one for the invoking credential.
60b8da39005fc2806c62e67647a0cb9e38f4b68b.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so no local fix is graded.

baa5d180946a11b6a53baae8590bb695d3ee5400.titleReason: The title states the defect: same-day overrides are checked one at a time, so one override's exclusion rejects a slot that another override allows.
baa5d180946a11b6a53baae8590bb695d3ee5400.fixReason: The check `slotEndTime.isAfter(start) && !slotStartTime.isAfter(end)` only tests overlap, not containment, so it accepts slots that start before an override or run past its end (including a slot starting exactly at its end), which violates the obligation that some interval contain the entire slot.

a81b8e4e9d7ae74701002409663fbe97d1b06d24.titleReason: The title correctly says the Google Meet patch call is sent with an undefined calendarId when no destination calendar matches, which is the defect.
a81b8e4e9d7ae74701002409663fbe97d1b06d24.fixReason: The fix resolves selectedCalendar to 'primary' at declaration, so the insert and the later patch both use the same resolved ID, and a matching credential-specific destination is still used when one exists.

6843e38196a2b453c1a3f9114eded24bd64e7b22.titleReason: The title states the defect: override start and end times wrap at midnight after the timezone shift, which produces wrong slots or no slots.
6843e38196a2b453c1a3f9114eded24bd64e7b22.fixReason: It uses the direct .tz(timeZone).diff(startOfInviteeDay) conversion, which the reference says is not equivalent, and it drops the organizer-to-invitee offset conversion, breaking the obligation to preserve that conversion.

0ce3443d32d84aaf2d9e1b701cfaef5ad71dee4e.titleReason: The title names the defect: a day with multiple working-hours ranges causes valid slots to be rejected.
0ce3443d32d84aaf2d9e1b701cfaef5ad71dee4e.fixReason: It checks only when the slot's weekday has working-hours entries, so a slot on a day with no working hours is still accepted when working hours are supplied, missing the obligation to reject slots outside all applicable intervals (the example fix rejects these).

71b10c60543e950a4c2106a61cc1f0394c536712.titleReason: The title names the defect: a malformed webhook body raises an unhandled ZodError that produces a 500 instead of a 400.
71b10c60543e950a4c2106a61cc1f0394c536712.fixReason: The safeParse change returns 400 for schema failures, but it misses the obligation to return 400 for undecryptable keys or invalid JSON after decryption, so the later symmetricDecrypt/JSON.parse can still throw and produce a 500.

394b886e64d68e7945304e5576f7a903e7e8efc1.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring bulk delete repeats once for every calendar reference.
394b886e64d68e7945304e5576f7a903e7e8efc1.fixReason: Gating on the first reference still loops over every organizer credential and takes each occurrence's first calendar reference regardless of credential, so it neither scopes deletions to the resolved credential nor deletes co-host events, and it skips the bulk delete entirely if the first reference has no credentialId.

8eaf1509ed03d5ae761bea75edb2e6903087d595.titleReason: The title states the defect: a Twilio cancel failure causes the workflowReminder DB delete to be skipped.
8eaf1509ed03d5ae761bea75edb2e6903087d595.fixReason: The improvedCode replaces lines 177-186 but drops the function declaration and the opening `try {`, so the remaining `} catch (error) {...} };` on lines 187-190 is orphaned and the code would not compile.

38b4f8b293f0916b59094a546109a80f417b6704.titleReason: The title names both defects the finding describes: the slot end bound is never checked, and a day with several entries wrongly rejects slots.
38b4f8b293f0916b59094a546109a80f417b6704.fixReason: The `workingHoursForDay.length > 0` guard lets any slot on a day with no working-hour entry pass even when working hours are supplied, so it misses the obligation to reject slots outside every applicable interval (the reference guards on `workingHours.length` instead).

bb0b03276b91ce7ba702bb9bddc7e939deb29835.titleReason: The title names the defect: the override check accepts slots that are not fully inside the override, such as partially overlapping ones.
bb0b03276b91ce7ba702bb9bddc7e939deb29835.fixReason: The single `if` rejects slots that start before the converted override start or end after the converted override end, allows equality at both boundaries, keeps `return true`, and leaves its closing brace to existing line 125.

b22edafcbc6a76971b483bc2facc767cd0394f7c.titleReason: The title names the defect: the async forEach callback leaves the calendar and video deletions unawaited.
b22edafcbc6a76971b483bc2facc767cd0394f7c.fixReason: Wrapping the map in await Promise.all waits for every deletion before the email and webhook steps, passes rejections to the handler, and keeps the UID checks, type dispatch, optional calendar handling and deletion arguments unchanged.

11d6e012fa4a4d51eb62f45053386e1dda072254.titleReason: The title says the add-guests schema allows duplicate emails, which is the defect the finding describes.
11d6e012fa4a4d51eb62f45053386e1dda072254.fixReason: The refine rejects repeated emails, so duplicates can no longer become multiple attendee rows; it keeps email-format and numeric bookingId validation and still accepts distinct emails, though it also rejects emails that differ only by case or whitespace, which the reference treats as acceptable.

04427d860415c80a6cc7140242d1a4823ed444a0.titleReason: The title says that concurrent same-key BuildIndex calls run in parallel and overwrite each other, which is the defect the finding describes.
04427d860415c80a6cc7140242d1a4823ed444a0.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

f688a3dbff80929cefc446b87c810138bdea74ae.titleReason: The title states the defect: the Duplicate ability is enabled when the Grafana prom rule is skipToken/undefined.
f688a3dbff80929cefc446b87c810138bdea74ae.fixReason: Adding `!rule` to MaybeSupported makes Duplicate NotSupported when there is no rule, keeps the loading and plugin-provided guards, and still requires Grafana create permission, which meets every obligation.

c7b8e3d3cf7447ff5e1e5d06f93a8b3321157670.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the shared cleanup ticker interval was cut from 10 minutes to 1 minute, which raises database load.
c7b8e3d3cf7447ff5e1e5d06f93a8b3321157670.fixReason: The replacement puts the ticker back at 10 minutes, keeps the immediate cleanUpTmpFiles call and the for-loop opening that leads into the existing select, and the added defer ticker.Stop() is valid and harmless.

be1d952887e8945a73e48b8caa6e1c5fa3a2edcf.titleReason: The title correctly states that join() breaks out of the loop when the deadline expires and leaves the remaining flusher processes unterminated.
be1d952887e8945a73e48b8caa6e1c5fa3a2edcf.fixReason: It keeps the `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` guard, which per the reference does not match the SpawnProcess workers created by self.mp_context, so those processes still never get terminated.

df69926f46e364d6b09dcf46a5ea266dc67b6342.titleReason: The title names the defect: unbounded work queues that can exhaust memory under load.
df69926f46e364d6b09dcf46a5ea266dc67b6342.fixReason: The fix bounds each queue with maxsize=10000, so put() blocks to apply backpressure without dropping messages, and it keeps consistent hashing, FIFO order, and offset registration before enqueue.

8252852de3c6a1ef3281ff9d0101000d34a15235.titleReason: The title correctly states that the query key leaves out the organization, which makes the cache shared across orgs, and that is the defect described.
8252852de3c6a1ef3281ff9d0101000d34a15235.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

b1f491ba4541c2067d0dc2485ba1bd811e70fb13.titleReason: The title names the unit mismatch: error timestamps in seconds are compared with replay event timestamps in milliseconds.
b1f491ba4541c2067d0dc2485ba1bd811e70fb13.fixReason: Multiplying the error timestamp by 1000 puts both values in the same unit without losing fractional precision, keeps the bounds check and the strict comparison, and leaves stored timestamps and the error message format unchanged.

7b39d741114769f097f2d5e9f3f662a9e6eb1572.titleReason: The title names the defect: the redirect-chase limit was cut from 10000 to 1000, which breaks deep segment trees.
7b39d741114769f097f2d5e9f3f662a9e6eb1572.fixReason: The answer restores the 10000 loop bound, keeps the break on missing or self redirects and the redirect_depth assignment, leaves the traversal limit separate from the 1000-member eviction cap, and adds only a harmless comment.

fef0c6ac19bcb13ee171954e419e8b1594bebc20.titleReason: The title repeats the finding's incorrect claim that filtered offsets are never tracked and get reprocessed, when the existing handler already completes BrokerValue offsets; the real defect is that FilteredPayload is sent to the decoder and handled through the exception path.
fef0c6ac19bcb13ee171954e419e8b1594bebc20.fixReason: It checks message.payload for FilteredPayload before decoding and completes the broker offset without enqueueing work or logging, while leaving decoding, grouping, queue submission and the None-result handling unchanged.

b23d3e7c4fd6b79306424f7584390dcf551a25dd.titleReason: The title names both parts of the defect: the method is missing its trailing ? and, as a result, website_name escapes the restriction applied to website.
b23d3e7c4fd6b79306424f7584390dcf551a25dd.fixReason: The replacement defines the recognized include_website_name? hook, omits the attribute when the website is blank or when scope.restrict_user_fields?(object) is true, and otherwise includes it, which covers every obligation.

2b7e218a706be4c9ce649c21ccc4690d17aae439.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: fallback locales are preloaded only in the web set_locale path and not in jobs or mailers.
2b7e218a706be4c9ce649c21ccc4690d17aae439.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

9019e367636e7077190982229efba989c0908872.titleReason: The title names the defect: calling scrub on a nil i.content raises NoMethodError for RSS items that only have a description.
9019e367636e7077190982229efba989c0908872.fixReason: The fix falls back to i.description when content is nil, uses `next` to skip bodyless items without stopping the loop, and keeps the scrub and CGI.unescapeHTML steps on the body.

4276b9e96f31a3a7fc73bd8e807dc459fb584bc3.titleReason: The title names the defect: the flex .contents leaves the header-extra-info flex item unable to shrink, which breaks the title ellipsis.
4276b9e96f31a3a7fc73bd8e807dc459fb584bc3.fixReason: The `> *` selector also gives `.title` and `.panel` min-width:0, so a long topic title makes the logo and navigation panel shrink proportionally below their content, breaking the existing logo and panel sizing constraints.

2626cec51f3205f84cefbb51bb227c0a54af3401.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the public group members page shows only the first 50 members and offers no pagination.
2626cec51f3205f84cefbb51bb227c0a54af3401.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

6f0c03294bcb287d0b19a4c8dea7933757d03b49.titleReason: The title names the defect: unsubscribe raises NoMethodError when the user has no TopicUser record.
6f0c03294bcb287d0b19a4c8dea7933757d03b49.fixReason: find_or_initialize_by returns a record tied to the current user and topic, `.to_i` handles a nil level so the existing branch mutes new records, the existing save! persists the change, and existing records keep their regular/muted transitions.

4320ac6833a2f351181726022db600a48f4c463a.titleReason: The title states the defect: the test asserts no commit happens, yet both offsets become committable, so it asserts the opposite of the real behavior.
4320ac6833a2f351181726022db600a48f4c463a.fixReason: The replacement waits up to about 3s for an actual commit, then asserts both processing calls happened and that the committed offset is 102, failing if no commit is observed, which meets every obligation (there is only a negligible race if a tick lands between the two near-simultaneous completions).

41cec719bfad93309fc4d359169cfddfc6bb9da3.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the migration crashes with a NoMethodError when the expected setting rows are missing.
41cec719bfad93309fc4d359169cfddfc6bb9da3.fixReason: The empty-result guards work, but the code then falls back to a hardcoded category id 1 instead of the application's default (a -1 sentinel), so hosts could be attached to an unrelated or nonexistent category.

516d5cb6c6124588007c24f2dc68da714906def7.titleReason: The title states the defect: the offset is marked complete even when result_processor raises, so failed messages are dropped.
516d5cb6c6124588007c24f2dc68da714906def7.fixReason: The flag is only set in the generic Exception handler, so on the queue.ShutDown break path (and on any other BaseException) the finally block still calls complete_offset, violating the obligation to leave interrupted work outstanding.

7652fc1d11f8f1e120597b46fe7938d964551917.titleReason: The title says the shared login predicate wrongly filters linked organization IdPs out of the federated identity list, which is the defect.
7652fc1d11f8f1e120597b46fe7938d964551917.fixReason: It removes the BROKER_PUBLIC clause from getLoginPredicate() and adds an unused getLoginCachePredicate(), but the Infinispan invalidation callers still call getLoginPredicate(), so cache invalidation on BROKER_PUBLIC changes breaks.

da53ce618426b85e50bbf5c7061d289b44474029.titleReason: The title names both defects: V2 cleanup is skipped, and the listener throws when both features are enabled.
da53ce618426b85e50bbf5c7061d289b44474029.fixReason: Excluding V2 avoids the exception, but it leaves no cleanup at all under V2, so a deleted client's V2 authorization resource is never removed, and when both features are on the legacy V1 cleanup is dropped too.

860d97e6608942b1904c66636c0c5bc2d6a1f8b5.titleReason: The title names the defect: offset commits stall at gaps in Kafka offsets, though the reference notes that 'permanently' overstates it.
860d97e6608942b1904c66636c0c5bc2d6a1f8b5.fixReason: Iterating sorted delivered offsets above last_committed and breaking only on an outstanding offset crosses absent offsets, stops at pending ones, keeps the watermark and lock untouched, and returns offsets without adding one; dropping the now-unused `start` is harmless.

433f64f59057db63c4dfa12f81c6fa40ec7ca5e1.titleReason: The title names the NPE in hasPermission that occurs when the all-clients resource-type resource is missing, which is the defect the finding describes.
433f64f59057db63c4dfa12f81c6fa40ec7ca5e1.fixReason: It returns false on a null fallback resource before querying policies, keeps the empty-policies denial and the evaluation of existing resources, and leaves the outer brace outside the anchor intact.

9394060606380f8092b77c26cb88b14f787944ca.titleReason: The title names the defect: overlapping common prefix and suffix make the substring bounds invalid and throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
9394060606380f8092b77c26cb88b14f787944ca.fixReason: Capping the suffix at length minus start for both strings matches the example fix, keeps start <= length-end (empty strings included), keeps the differing content, and leaves the diagnostic message unchanged.

6af607ff05d21b59de6e29a66c74ae924209fe94.titleReason: The title says canView() ignores a global MANAGE grant on the all-clients resource, which is the defect the finding describes.
6af607ff05d21b59de6e29a66c74ae924209fe94.fixReason: The replacement adds the all-clients MANAGE check, keeps the existing default-role and VIEW checks, and uses only the global hasPermission(scope) call already used elsewhere in the file, so a grant on one client is not treated as global.

966c9189b8f25880471e34af34eccaddc2ff0401.titleReason: The title names the defect: the canViewGlobal fast path was dropped, so permissions are evaluated per subgroup.
966c9189b8f25880471e34af34eccaddc2ff0401.fixReason: The code computes canViewGlobal once and short-circuits the per-subgroup canView check, falls back to per-group filtering when global view is denied, and keeps parent authorization, search, filter-before-pagination and mapping unchanged.

a198e6207f8220e7e94de04f1c57c2b0141bb367.titleReason: The title states the defect: Delete skips the legacy delete when Storage returns NotFound.
a198e6207f8220e7e94de04f1c57c2b0141bb367.fixReason: On NotFound the code falls through to the unchanged line 106, which records a successful storage operation, so it misses the obligation not to treat NotFound as a successful deletion.

2edcae48fd1d1c1687df2d473ba2c09cb4273fb3.titleReason: The title names the defect: after ImageMagick overwrites the file in place, the downsizing loop works from a stale Tempfile view of the original file.
2edcae48fd1d1c1687df2d473ba2c09cb4273fb3.fixReason: The loop now checks the file's current on-disk size with File.size(path), and reopening the Tempfile afterwards points the handle at the rewritten file at position zero, so Upload.create_for gets the current content and size while the five-attempt bound, eligibility checks, 80% reduction, animation option and cleanup are unchanged.

89d6f4a297db88a4b985529136605e0b39cff5ce.titleReason: The title names the defect: the cache entry stays in place after the device-limit rejection, so the device gets through on its next request.

a39a3a452a5e6d22bcdae7e3bb5658238dda5f61.titleReason: The title says the legacy update gets the original objInfo instead of the object committed to unified storage, which is the defect the finding describes.
a39a3a452a5e6d22bcdae7e3bb5658238dda5f61.fixReason: The replacement wraps objInfo and res in the existing updateWrapper, so legacy stores the committed object, the upstream preconditions are kept, and all other arguments and the errObjectSt variable stay the same.

dc598ead540c9b3d495427c3171fd479c1747c9a.titleReason: The title states the defect accurately: the refresh handler persists the Zod safeParse result wrapper instead of the parsed credential.
dc598ead540c9b3d495427c3171fd479c1747c9a.fixReason: Adding `.data` persists the validated credential object to the same record, keeps validation before persistence, and leaves the closing delimiter and the rest of the refresh flow intact.

6579a7fc87eda812d2f054c7dec229198c334a92.fixReason: The replacement blocks redirects (`redirect: false`), allows only http/https on ports 80/443 alongside the caller's existing embeddable-host check, rejects private and loopback IPs, and relies on open-uri raising on non-2xx responses so those bodies are never imported, while still passing the body to Readability with the unchanged options on lines 49-50.

1ff436db00bfe385a0ff2b1aed820a5955d1b0b1.titleReason: The title says the cleanup uses the literal alias "alias" instead of the real IDP aliases, which is the defect.
1ff436db00bfe385a0ff2b1aed820a5955d1b0b1.fixReason: The cleanup is now registered with each loop alias "idp-alias-" + i and with "idp-alias-20", the method reference is bound immediately so the local variable is fine, and setup, organization associations and assertions are unchanged.

7ef2432f25a3fd649e6fc0a00d1ade83dbc1ca3d.titleReason: The title states the defect: only the literal `count()` is rewritten, so aliased forms and forms with whitespace inside the parentheses are missed.

2f904c72c8add5765650ac24ec1703af976e796d.titleReason: The title names the defect: every paginated request loads an unbounded set of error_ids from nodestore.

d9625d7167d8e1407cdbba0f77b53a984f8ca8e8.titleReason: The title states the defect: the JPA filter expects the legacy group resource name, so V2 group results break.

4d9f3fb568be63774cf458295a410c0490121d23.titleReason: The title names the defect: collective team destination calendars are dropped when evt.destinationCalendar is null.

6dce371ebbf7fecd9ea062fdf7884c990aa476eb.titleReason: The title names the defect: the fallback searches the destination calendars using the falsy externalCalendarId.

a65589647c97ba7fbf2564c0fb40c9cc47dd51c0.fixReason: Deleting lines 178-186 lets line 187 close the success branch, so locked skips no longer count as retries while successful scheduling and catch-block retry counting stay the same, as the reference requires.

1118304b1d3ffd36fef25f2d010d79406b6bd235.titleReason: The title names the inverted slug condition and says it leaves slug unset when billing is disabled and sets it when billing is enabled, which matches the finding.
1118304b1d3ffd36fef25f2d010d79406b6bd235.fixReason: The replacement sets slug only when billing is disabled, keeps requestedSlug for billing-enabled orgs, and leaves the rest of the metadata unchanged, so every obligation is met.

1c9578ba5b24183e05b43c5a84f0cacd320fe6a7.titleReason: The title names the defect: mainHostDestinationCalendar is dereferenced without a guard after destructuring a possibly empty array.
1c9578ba5b24183e05b43c5a84f0cacd320fe6a7.fixReason: Optional chaining stops the throw for null, undefined, or empty collections, makes an absent destination fall back to Cal Video for Meet, and leaves Google Calendar destinations and other locations unchanged.

6eef6d050d0245ab98e407c6753bca05c8b38ce1.titleReason: The title correctly says that non-calendar (video) results lose their credentialId in referencesToCreate, which is the defect described.
6eef6d050d0245ab98e407c6753bca05c8b38ce1.fixReason: Using result.credentialId unconditionally keeps the credential for both video and calendar references, and externalCalendarId stays limited to calendar results, so every obligation is met with no new issues.

75703cd854bf67c1440724203b6210c5cb322649.titleReason: The title states the defect: createEvent targets the first host's destination calendar instead of the one that matches the invoking credential.
75703cd854bf67c1440724203b6210c5cb322649.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so no improvedCode is graded.

4bdbffbc789373a4a47af508a71add66126ec892.titleReason: The title names both defects: the wrong end-time computation and the rejection of days that have multiple working-hour entries.
4bdbffbc789373a4a47af508a71add66126ec892.fixReason: It computes the end as `slotEndTime.hour()*60+minute()`, which wraps overnight ends back to early clock minutes (e.g. a 23:30–00:30 slot gets end=30 and passes), violating the first obligation.

e8cf5bfbe599fbcf56323686716a125a6811176e.titleReason: The title names the defect: a weekday with several working-hours ranges causes slots to be rejected.
e8cf5bfbe599fbcf56323686716a125a6811176e.fixReason: The 'end' value is still computed from slotStartTime instead of the actual slot end, so it misses the obligation to check containment against the real slot end and accepts slots that run past an interval's end.

5796f848d6dbb4489c7b60e387358d78db0108b8.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: timezone-shifted overrides wrapping around midnight.
5796f848d6dbb4489c7b60e387358d78db0108b8.fixReason: The fix uses the finding's direct .tz(timeZone).diff(startOfInviteeDay) approach, which the reference notes is not equivalent, and it drops the organizer-to-invitee offset conversion (offset is no longer used), so it misses that obligation.

46b63ee669fe6ab0ad41b5575cfff2a4d09f86e4.titleReason: The title names the defect: the token refresh runs unconditionally and bypasses the shared helper, which matches the finding's core problem.
46b63ee669fe6ab0ad41b5575cfff2a4d09f86e4.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no fix to grade.

8f628a0820164c84c2e582c165b6099c4e1c525f.fixReason: It uses the outer `calendar` built from the resolved `calendarCredential` (including the DB lookup), selects each occurrence's references by `credentialId`, deletes with their `uid` and `externalCalendarId`, and keeps the existing push, brace closures and `Promise.all`/try-catch valid.

a15773536edaab9b94d2b6642f0de264e6da582b.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the duplicate and blacklist checks in the addGuests filter are case-sensitive.

45cdd7d6d6d751f4daffa70446cf582c78cb222b.titleReason: The title correctly says the schema accepts duplicate guest emails, which is the defect.

835abcdd2dfc58bf271a8c44d140db248a5b4a91.titleReason: The title names the defect: the shared cleanup ticker now fires every minute, which multiplies DB/IO load, and it does not describe the fix.

dfd041db9aaf3fd9225fef8f3e756b779e249627.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: once the timeout deadline elapses, join() stops terminating the remaining processes.
dfd041db9aaf3fd9225fef8f3e756b779e249627.fixReason: The fix keeps the `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` guard, which does not match the SpawnProcess workers created by self.mp_context, so the remaining spawned processes are still never terminated.

fd9570b7ae026f48d328410f4ba799119e7a78e9.titleReason: The title states the defect correctly: commit_function runs on a background thread and races with poll() and with partition revocation.

91850d234a7a736c9e979854d72b1e0bd3f82652.titleReason: The title names the defect: error timestamps and replay event timestamps are compared in different units.
91850d234a7a736c9e979854d72b1e0bd3f82652.fixReason: Multiplying the error timestamp by 1000 converts seconds to milliseconds while keeping fractional precision, and the bounds check, strict comparison, stored values and message formatting are all left unchanged.

fe9a706565d209587abb203669f4ee6c4e941fa6.titleReason: The title repeats the finding's claim that filtered messages are never offset-tracked, which the reference says is wrong; the real defect is that FilteredPayload is sent to the decoder and handled through the exception path.

8217a94dd80355e2b96ba1438833dd9cf1293fb4.titleReason: The title states the defect: remove_member does not clear the removed user's primary group.

78cb990df2b0cb0ac8cbf572a766493aef498d45.titleReason: The title names the defect: the test asserts that no offset is committed after a processing failure, which contradicts the real commit behavior.

6e68db5b8c2b6f1ab52d31c2d7c035da1dc68a0c.titleReason: The title names the defect: after in-place downsizing, the Tempfile keeps pointing at the original inode, so its size and content are stale.

bca3dd2f05b73e428aa3206dbea7ce5a1165b0eb.titleReason: The title names the defect: MetricAlertDetectorHandler leaves the abstract methods it inherits from StatefulDetectorHandler unimplemented, which is why the class cannot be instantiated.
bca3dd2f05b73e428aa3206dbea7ce5a1165b0eb.fixReason: fixStatus is "needs-wider-change", not "local", so no improvedCode is graded.

9afa3987252d11bf0a2e48892a8dbb3c06446faf.titleReason: The title correctly says the table visualization is rendered with empty columns and data, which is the defect.
9afa3987252d11bf0a2e48892a8dbb3c06446faf.fixReason: It passes the field strings directly as columns, which the reference says is invalid, it drops aliases, and it passes result.meta without safe defaults for the required fields and units maps.

aba954ed4fb7081b4a738658ff18efcb94ec59fe.titleReason: The title names the defect: the unsubscribe action dereferences a nil TopicUser and raises NoMethodError.
aba954ed4fb7081b4a738658ff18efcb94ec59fe.fixReason: When find_by returns nil, the code falls back to a new TopicUser tied to the current user and topic, the nil-safe to_i comparison sends it to the muted branch, the existing save! persists it, and existing records keep their current transitions.

c1f4c7e5d45e4823dfaa853fd694dfdfc9931bad.titleReason: The title says the offset is marked complete in finally even when processing raised, which is the defect.
c1f4c7e5d45e4823dfaa853fd694dfdfc9931bad.fixReason: Moving complete_offset into an else clause completes the offset only on success, leaves failed or ShutDown work outstanding, keeps exception logging and the break, and leaves the trailing finally to run the metrics gauge every time.

fa448e554fd6ba7a484e0c5999ff52390006c524.titleReason: The title names the real defect, a Kafka offset gap blocking commit progress; 'forever' overstates it per the reference, but that wording comes from the finding itself.
fa448e554fd6ba7a484e0c5999ff52390006c524.fixReason: Iterating sorted submitted offsets from start and stopping only at outstanding ones crosses absent offsets, stops before pending ones, and keeps the watermark, locking and return convention, just like the reference fix.

a6a0482a76b69df507bef2176e2539c69a590e19.titleReason: The title states the defect: the shared getLoginPredicate wrongly filters organization IDPs out of the federated (linked) provider list.
a6a0482a76b69df507bef2176e2539c69a590e19.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

0f9f4828fc91b3f98ddde07272301b245eaaa77d.titleReason: The title says the deletion cleanup listener mishandles the V2 feature, which is the defect: the guard is keyed on the V1 flag and V2 is handled wrongly.
0f9f4828fc91b3f98ddde07272301b245eaaa77d.fixReason: The fix turns off all cleanup when V2 is enabled, so a deleted client's V2 authorization resource is never removed, and when V1 and V2 are both on the legacy role, client, and group cleanup is also skipped; it hides the exception without doing the required cleanup.

6a1206b16d107cf2651abd8c54d4638c2142400f.titleReason: The title states the defect: the migration crashes when the category settings rows are missing from site_settings.
6a1206b16d107cf2651abd8c54d4638c2142400f.fixReason: The fix stops both nil dereferences, but when the uncategorized_category_id setting is absent it hardcodes 0 instead of using the application's default, which misses that obligation.

9c472d61f548e749fa71d1f95c74ce961cfddd90.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: Delete skips legacy cleanup when Storage returns NotFound.
9c472d61f548e749fa71d1f95c74ce961cfddd90.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so no local fix is expected to be graded.

fd62809070e94162d3cd8ed439aa0627c1270e2a.titleReason: The title names the defect: server-side request forgery caused by the unvalidated `open(url)` fetch in import_remote.
fd62809070e94162d3cd8ed439aa0627c1270e2a.fixReason: `open(url, redirect: false)` makes open-uri raise on redirects and on non-2xx responses, the new checks limit the scheme to HTTP(S) on ports 80/443, the existing caller already enforces the host match, and successful bodies still reach Readability with the unchanged options.

d5a0c155b4ddbeb0fcab50b1d72cdc58772f2cc7.titleReason: The title says the legacy update gets the stale original objInfo instead of the object already committed to unified storage, which is the defect.
d5a0c155b4ddbeb0fcab50b1d72cdc58772f2cc7.fixReason: The code wraps objInfo and res in the existing updateWrapper so legacy stores the committed object, keeps the upstream preconditions, and leaves the other arguments and the errObjectSt variable unchanged.

40a66bacfbbd76d4cb210a12d05a4b30d7b691c3.titleReason: The title names the defect: the device is cached before CreateOrUpdateDevice can fail, which leaves a stale cache entry that lets the device bypass the limit check.
40a66bacfbbd76d4cb210a12d05a4b30d7b691c3.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so no improvedCode is graded.

ffacb11c102827ea42a39936346a17985b3ba090.fixReason: Clamping end to min(vlen, slen) - start keeps both substring bounds valid (start <= len - end) for empty and overlapping inputs, keeps the differing content (e.g. 'a' vs '' for "aaa"/"aa"), and leaves the diagnostic message unchanged.

8c782aa7dfada54ff14b1e90dc826d175c888c33.titleReason: The title says the parse-result wrapper object, not the parsed credentials, is stored as the credential key, which is the defect.
8c782aa7dfada54ff14b1e90dc826d175c888c33.fixReason: It persists `parsedKey.data` after checking `success`, keeps validation before the update on the same credential record, and leaves the closing delimiter and refresh flow intact; a failed parse is thrown into the existing catch.

d7b437786ef6d0b7797ceec35ceb4e127bc56a64.titleReason: The title names the defect: a backup-code login skips the password check when a totpCode is also supplied.
d7b437786ef6d0b7797ceec35ceb4e127bc56a64.fixReason: Rejecting a request that has both totpCode and backupCode would close the bypass, but improvedCode drops cited line 157 (`} else if (user.twoFactorEnabled) {`), so the branch is never closed, the code does not compile, and the TOTP-only validation path is lost.

085f88a3fc5685dad42424a4ce3897235e052a57.titleReason: The title names the defect: the embed URL is not escaped, which allows HTML and attribute injection into the imported post.

d2f751e78765e06b1f66981791830a1aac84900d.titleReason: The title names the defect: count-aggregate matching misses aliased forms and forms with extra whitespace.
d2f751e78765e06b1f66981791830a1aac84900d.fixReason: The replacement matches `count()` case-insensitively, ignores whitespace inside the parentheses and around the expression, keeps an explicit alias with its original casing, falls back to `count` when there is no alias, and leaves all other columns unchanged and in order.

4fc68c17209f4bbccff5d8d764dcaadd1b3ec54c.titleReason: The title states the defect: create does not persist alias_level, which update does.

2793857cd662ec4885a7801e4737f5c73273d9c9.titleReason: The title says the specs never reach the conditions they claim to test, which is the defect described.

736814cd62276b4bd10688a69562c20e80e739fb.titleReason: The title states the defect: an existing per-client resource causes the all-clients grant to be ignored.
736814cd62276b4bd10688a69562c20e80e739fb.fixReason: With the replacement, a granted per-client scope falls through to the existing evaluation and succeeds, a missing or non-granting per-client resource falls back to the all-clients resource, absence of either is still denied, and the same-realm and resource-server checks are untouched (the unguarded null all-clients resource is unchanged from the original code).

c13c33d3323b1dd8127f0b627bb373095b12e8df.titleReason: The title says the unsubscribe confirmation overstates what happens, which is the defect: it promises all topic notifications stop when users are only set to regular.

bbcf37a1de0c8d7d8964554408642359520045b6.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the auto-downsize branch rasterizes or corrupts SVG uploads.

6ea8e2a14c3c3f79dabfcee4e1ce8af7ad93a3c4.titleReason: The title names the defect: success is decided from statusText instead of real HTTP success, although it mentions response.ok, it still describes the faulty check.

8edf84ee7c264d5685c2ec51d299a687ce3e1402.titleReason: The title names the defect: Zod computed keys in the refresh token schema strip the expiry fields.

d35318dfd6995782fd4d52b33c5e72b8363e9e10.titleReason: The title names the defect, dark text on a dark background in the dark-theme notification badge; calling the background 'darkened' is a slight misstatement, since it was lightened to a still-dark gray, but the problem is clear.

7ec9b6eb89c89cb5c245f6258bf6c98ab0e60ef2.fixReason: Adding the slotStartTime.isBefore(offset-adjusted start) condition rejects early-starting slots, lets a slot starting exactly at the override start through, and keeps the offset adjustment and return-true semantics; the extra end-time clauses are now redundant but harmless.

ecf831ad6cf068c4824f2ade177ee9c4968962fe.titleReason: The title names the defect: a plain Error for a missing credential surfaces as a 500 instead of a client error.

e9750818da6482648c76d5ec0afdbe9b4b508b9a.fixReason: The fix escapes each pipe-separated domain on its own, ends the match with an absolute `\z` anchor, stays case-insensitive with multiple alternatives, and leaves the whitelist/blacklist flow unchanged; the extra local-part prefix only matters for already-malformed addresses.

17e67993230fc1075462fcddf66a92652437f48a.titleReason: The title states the defect: metadata is looked up by map key, not by the app's slug, which is the mismatch the finding describes.
17e67993230fc1075462fcddf66a92652437f48a.fixReason: Replacing the cited lines with a lookup that matches `metadata.slug` against `app.slug` handles apps whose directory name differs from their slug, keeps the 404 guard, leaves the closing brace outside the anchor so it is not duplicated, and keeps the metadata slug and type for the credential code that follows.

0b07def722ad7759f0611094dc4edd592deec2ec.titleReason: The title says the queue_depth gauge has no worker_id tag, so different queues overwrite each other, which is the defect described.

08cfdb0f608721e50388add7d3a9123b188d7e19.titleReason: The title names the defect: getBaseConditions returns SQL fragments without enclosing parentheses, which causes operator-precedence problems when they are composed.
08cfdb0f608721e50388add7d3a9123b188d7e19.fixReason: Wrapping the single-condition branches in parentheses makes an appended AND apply to every OR branch, while the already-grouped both-present branch and the atomic `1=0` deny-all are correctly kept as they were and parameterization is preserved.

872193ee7683088dd28c6bdecf1a3fc2f7425628.titleReason: The title states the defect: the kill guard never matches spawned flusher processes, so an unhealthy process is left alive.
