ca7f623f521db32da56581fc21b61c7196201521.titleReason: The title names the defect: the downsize loop passes percentage geometry ("80%") to OptimizedImage.downsize, which is what makes the call invalid.
ca7f623f521db32da56581fc21b61c7196201521.fixReason: It computes geometry from current dimensions and stops when the file no longer shrinks, but `(dimension * 0.8).to_i` can produce 0 (e.g. a 1-pixel side), so it does not guarantee the valid positive pixel geometry the reference requires.

2462e0a97ce6a64c50fbd9ff7d9f68da9cdd9c05.titleReason: The title names the defect: a single embed request synchronously re-imports the entire feed.
2462e0a97ce6a64c50fbd9ff7d9f68da9cdd9c05.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so the fix is not graded.

42db81c148eab65aad783e7b274b171a0cfef90d.titleReason: The title names the case-sensitive email comparison in should_block? that lets an address with different capitalization bypass the block list.
42db81c148eab65aad783e7b274b171a0cfef90d.fixReason: Lowercasing both the stored column and the input gives an exact match that ignores case, including for existing mixed-case rows, uses no wildcards, and leaves the match statistics and block/do_nothing logic unchanged.

21ff76fb927dda1f4540fafa132ccb6a7fe1f635.titleReason: The title says the same-domain check misses websites on subdomains of the instance host, which is the defect described.
21ff76fb927dda1f4540fafa132ccb6a7fe1f635.fixReason: The replacement checks both suffix directions with a dot boundary, so it covers nested subdomains and keeps the parent-host case, returns only the host for unrelated domains, and uses valid Ruby `end_with?`.

5615aa2ab63d83ef866de3e879470a551129f206.titleReason: The title names the defect, wrong lightness values in the group member name color, and does not describe the fix.
5615aa2ab63d83ef866de3e879470a551129f206.fixReason: The replacement restores primary at 30% lightness and secondary at 70% lightness, matches the expected declaration, and leaves the indentation and surrounding styling unchanged.

8a0009f56c284d676c40f6345b22883ca0cf506c.titleReason: The title names the defect: when categoryId is null, the save callback ignores the category the server returned.
8a0009f56c284d676c40f6345b22883ca0cf506c.fixReason: The fix resolves the category from the persisted host.category_id, which save sets from the response and which includes the uncategorized fallback, so selected categories still display correctly, and the rest of the callback, including resetting editToggled and the error handling, is unchanged.

6158277c2a3a58dd4bcd751c81a85b64642e7afe.titleReason: The title states the defect: the same-parent-domain check wrongly matches unrelated sites that share a public suffix.
6158277c2a3a58dd4bcd751c81a85b64642e7afe.fixReason: Raising the label-count threshold to >3 drops valid three-label sibling matches like www.example.com vs forum.example.com, and it still mismatches public-suffix hosts with more labels (e.g. a.forum.co.uk vs b.evil.co.uk is fine but x.foo.github.io-style or deeper suffixes remain), which the reference calls an incomplete approach.

0710274ebe3a8ec8905ddf643638a4678a506ac1.titleReason: The title states the defect: record_for_host drops the port when matching, so port-qualified saved entries never match.
0710274ebe3a8ec8905ddf643638a4678a506ac1.fixReason: The fix also matches `host:port` when the URI has a port, so it matches entries on the same port, does not match a different port, and keeps hostname-only matching and the early returns for malformed or hostless input.

d56956bac3106c2dec42cc22d9a4e7fdbd771850.titleReason: The title names the defect: unseen embed URLs trigger unbounded RetrieveTopic job fanout.
d56956bac3106c2dec42cc22d9a4e7fdbd771850.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so no improvedCode is graded.

226f9ac69015162e7564ef06429f68de0ef649a3.titleReason: The title states the defect: the unsubscribe route only loads the topic and never changes the notification preference.
226f9ac69015162e7564ef06429f68de0ef649a3.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context, not local, so there is no fix to grade.

914726258046a06ee2f97b4c989cb7eaa9a692a2.titleReason: The title names both defects: duplicate-membership failures and partial state left behind because there is no transaction.
914726258046a06ee2f97b4c989cb7eaa9a692a2.fixReason: group.save runs outside the transaction and a false save never triggers a rollback, so a failed final save leaves the earlier additions committed, which misses the rollback obligation.

ff5afb61679751d31d11db06fcd1546ce4961ce4.titleReason: The title names the defect: totalPages overcounts when user_count is an exact multiple of limit.
ff5afb61679751d31d11db06fcd1546ce4961ce4.fixReason: Math.ceil(user_count / limit) gives the correct page count for positive counts and still returns 0 for an empty group when limit is positive, and the property keeps its dependency on limit and user_count, so removing the explicit zero guard is safe.

9cc73500a5e3c4c32400fc595cb51eadbb1c3d66.titleReason: The title states the defect: protocol-relative URLs get treated as local paths on the article host, and it does not describe the fix.
9cc73500a5e3c4c32400fc595cb51eadbb1c3d66.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

6ac510f14eb3b80d8c40939969dda8b9064bfd3e.titleReason: The title says the light-theme `.name` color uses 50% lightness instead of 30%, which is the regression the finding describes.
6ac510f14eb3b80d8c40939969dda8b9064bfd3e.fixReason: The replacement restores primary scaled by 30% for the light theme and uses secondary scaled by 70% for the dark theme, and changes nothing else on the cited line.

fc01737ef38f717d0df014e091db840602731928.titleReason: The title names the defect: the dark/light theme lightness arguments are inverted and do not match the desktop rule.
fc01737ef38f717d0df014e091db840602731928.fixReason: The improved line uses $primary at 70% for the light theme and $secondary at 30% for the dark theme, keeps dark-light-choose, and is valid SCSS, so it meets both obligations.

df56ef177c276f73719974fa3a1ed4a57479e1cb.titleReason: The title names the defect: the method queries the wrong resource type and returns resource names where client IDs are expected.
df56ef177c276f73719974fa3a1ed4a57479e1cb.fixReason: The fix adds client.getClientId() instead of the internal client.getId() that the caller resolves with getClientById(), and it depends on a realm field and on hasPermission(client, scope) semantics that are not shown in the provided code.

01ef717c94f6773bedd4b27ede0e99566c1623c1.titleReason: The title states the defect: the no-arg canManage() accepts VIEW permission and so grants management rights.
01ef717c94f6773bedd4b27ede0e99566c1623c1.fixReason: The replacement drops VIEW so VIEW-only grants are rejected, still accepts all-groups MANAGE, and keeps the MANAGE_USERS role bypass, all using names already present in the file.

73874d7b00e27732d70264d30adbe1abbd868f0e.titleReason: The title correctly states the defect: the global canView() grant overrides a per-client VIEW denial.
73874d7b00e27732d70264d30adbe1abbd868f0e.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so no local fix is graded.

64a75d006061e27af014fdfc0fa56ebe3d559685.titleReason: The title names the defect: when externalCalendarId is falsy, the selectedCalendar fallback in updateEvent never matches, so it does not fall back to a valid destination calendar.
64a75d006061e27af014fdfc0fa56ebe3d559685.fixReason: The improvedCode keeps an explicit externalCalendarId, otherwise uses the already-extracted mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId, and handles an empty or null destinationCalendar safely through optional chaining on the [] fallback.

6b7333140e5f2d1f4937c5b7e1acae9de0493e07.titleReason: The title names the defect: the V2 group IDs returned here cannot be matched by the JPA filtering, which still expects legacy resource names.
6b7333140e5f2d1f4937c5b7e1acae9de0493e07.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

ab0a058dd2176ab5a432aaad54c2b3774a3af0d0.titleReason: The title names the defect: mainHostDestinationCalendar's integration is dereferenced without a null guard.
ab0a058dd2176ab5a432aaad54c2b3774a3af0d0.fixReason: Optional chaining stops the TypeError when the destination list is null or empty, and undefined !== 'google_calendar' picks Cal Video while Google Calendar destinations and other locations behave as before.

1d404f2dcadced147c17cb128b1e3ff77fc3b6f8.titleReason: The title states the defect: wrapping the whole cancel loop in one try/catch makes it abort on the first SendGrid failure.
1d404f2dcadced147c17cb128b1e3ff77fc3b6f8.fixReason: The improvedCode deletes each reminder even when its SendGrid cancellation failed, which breaks the obligation to keep reminders whose cancellation failed, so emails that are still scheduled lose their tracking row and can still be sent.

cc86682beb8e5da6c8971d1df603511d554a3e0e.titleReason: The title names the defect: team destination calendars are dropped when evt.destinationCalendar is null.
cc86682beb8e5da6c8971d1df603511d554a3e0e.fixReason: The initialize-then-push logic is correct, but improvedCode adds a closing brace while the original brace on line 1079 lies outside the cited range, so the result has an extra '}' and will not compile.

18e6d162558caf9c388411c6daa425e1a169a816.titleReason: The title names the defect: a locked SMS send is counted as a retry, so the reminder gets dropped.
18e6d162558caf9c388411c6daa425e1a169a816.fixReason: Deleting lines 178-186 leaves the closing brace on line 187 to close the success branch, so a locked skip no longer increments retryCount while successful updates and catch-block retry counting stay intact.

1568211493bce5ab5a9b59996e06f289dc4af481.titleReason: The title names the inverted slug condition and its effect of bypassing the requestedSlug flow, which is the defect described in the finding.
1568211493bce5ab5a9b59996e06f289dc4af481.fixReason: The improved code sets slug directly only when billing is disabled, stores requestedSlug only when billing is enabled, and leaves the remaining metadata intact, matching every obligation.

f4e9e8f721c356a2be4172cdf6a0a3569d2e9ba3.titleReason: The title names the defect: case variants and plus-address aliases bypass the guest email blacklist.
f4e9e8f721c356a2be4172cdf6a0a3569d2e9ba3.fixReason: The improvedCode ends with the filter's closing `);`, but line 78 already holds that `);` outside the cited range, so the result has a duplicate `);` and will not compile.

2b7ac6ee36a9ebd6a7b212184d7ce3943a76f238.titleReason: The title correctly states that credentialId is dropped for non-calendar (video) results, which is the defect.
2b7ac6ee36a9ebd6a7b212184d7ce3943a76f238.fixReason: Using result.credentialId unconditionally keeps the credential id for both video and calendar references, and externalCalendarId stays limited to calendar results, so every obligation is met.

3e856a402f3e8663e43cc24140b0c02d9e2f968c.titleReason: The title states the defect: valid slots are wrongly rejected when a day has several date overrides.
3e856a402f3e8663e43cc24140b0c02d9e2f968c.fixReason: The replacement redeclares `let dateOverrideExist` in the scope where line 103 already declares it, which is a syntax error; it also tests overlap rather than full containment and does not exclude zero-length overrides.

77313fbd47d8d5df3d2ece7cffc067852a27f585.titleReason: The title is an instruction about what to do ("Do not inject...") rather than a statement of the defect, and it never mentions that the placeholder overwrites the valid stored Office365 refresh token.
77313fbd47d8d5df3d2ece7cffc067852a27f585.fixReason: Gating the placeholder on both APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT stops it in the non-sharing branch, keeps any parsed refresh_token, retains the sync-branch placeholder, and uses only names already in the file.

2d1dae9d9ae8b6cba83f6d894a2516bcb8e70a25.titleReason: The title names both defects, the wrong end time and the rejection of valid split schedules, without describing the fix.
2d1dae9d9ae8b6cba83f6d894a2516bcb8e70a25.fixReason: With no `workingHours.length > 0` guard, an empty or omitted workingHours array makes `!some(...)` true and rejects every slot, breaking busy-only checks; the `slotEndTime.hour()*60+minute()` end calculation also wraps overnight ends back to early clock minutes.

b1de050b8c3f2f8a8515ebd18f72ddfafead9fe1.titleReason: The title says the defect directly: createEvent uses the first destination calendar rather than the one matching the invoking credential.
b1de050b8c3f2f8a8515ebd18f72ddfafead9fe1.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

5453a7c266035f458f09dad1c5ef0cff515ab6af.titleReason: The title names the defect: Dayjs objects are compared with === (reference equality) in the date override check.
5453a7c266035f458f09dad1c5ef0cff515ab6af.fixReason: Replacing === with isSame compares the override endpoints by timestamp, so equal endpoints return true and trigger the unavailable result, while unequal overrides still reach the existing bounds checks.

23ca475e28ebb2cddfa85a6e609b1b7ad9b099e9.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring branch ignores the resolved credential and deletes the wrong calendar references.
23ca475e28ebb2cddfa85a6e609b1b7ad9b099e9.fixReason: The fix uses the resolved calendarCredential (including one loaded from the database), picks each occurrence's reference by credentialId, deletes with that reference's uid and externalCalendarId, and leaves the awaiting and error handling intact; the extra _calendar type filter is redundant but harmless.

5eb4ca2b8e1dfd7b1a7e023743d9a2957b516266.titleReason: The title names the defect: the token is refreshed on every client creation and credential sync is bypassed, which matches the finding.
5eb4ca2b8e1dfd7b1a7e023743d9a2957b516266.fixReason: fixStatus is 'needs-wider-change' rather than 'local', so there is no fix to grade.

b32d96c52086cc59e0ca93ceeba00fb8022c102c.titleReason: The title names the defect: the retryCount update in the catch block is unprotected, so a failure there aborts the SMS batch.
b32d96c52086cc59e0ca93ceeba00fb8022c102c.fixReason: The replacement still increments retryCount, wraps that update in its own try/catch so a failure no longer escapes the loop, and leaves the original error log on line 198 in place, so every obligation is met.

e2a39008b438dfea895e84116c046382b1469fa9.titleReason: The title names the defect: the catch block increments retryCount from a stale value, which is the lost-update problem the finding describes.
e2a39008b438dfea895e84116c046382b1469fa9.fixReason: The atomic increment is correct, but improvedCode also contains the closing `});` and the console.log line, which sit outside the cited range (lines 197-198), so both would appear twice and break the syntax.

b9fc157519f631d535ecc3146340264543c94fa5.titleReason: The title names the defect: recurring deletions run again for every calendar reference, so the same events are deleted repeatedly.
b9fc157519f631d535ecc3146340264543c94fa5.fixReason: The fix limits each recurring deletion to the current reference's `credentialId` and uses the `calendar` already resolved from `calendarCredential`, both in scope at lines 424 and 443, and it keeps the recurrence guard, the `promises`/`Promise.all` error handling, and the single-booking `else` branch.

8f26faf0a34f7867b6ad3cbb563199a395bbd68c.titleReason: The title names the defect: the patch call gets an undefined calendarId when there is no matching destination calendar.
8f26faf0a34f7867b6ad3cbb563199a395bbd68c.fixReason: The fix resolves selectedCalendar to "primary" when no match exists, and the insert and the later patch both use that one variable, while a credential-specific match is still preferred.

59a21bf79dd7a71c555db321b7064878c7b49c99.titleReason: The title states the defect: when the Twilio cancel fails, the DB delete is skipped.
59a21bf79dd7a71c555db321b7064878c7b49c99.fixReason: The Twilio cancel now has its own try/catch that logs the error, so the awaited prisma delete always runs. The delete still runs without calling Twilio when referenceId is null, and the outer catch still logs DB errors.

3f3088d3cca9f6f34c777abbd3f3447d2fb54268.titleReason: The title names the defect: deleteCacheMutation fails to invalidate viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars after cache deletion.
3f3088d3cca9f6f34c777abbd3f3447d2fb54268.fixReason: The fix adds an onSettled invalidation of connectedCalendars that runs regardless of the parent callback, keeps both toasts and the optional onSuccess call, and the utils reference resolves because the callback runs after line 52 has initialized it.

53f944b675d6e1aa5ca987bc49994d1e56c67096.titleReason: The title states the defect: the app store object eagerly imports every app module when it is loaded.
53f944b675d6e1aa5ca987bc49994d1e56c67096.fixReason: Lazy getters keep all 28 keys and paths, defer each import until that property is accessed, and still return a promise for existing `await appStore[key]` consumers, matching the reference obligations.

cbe7ddcbf929cc2dc2371c2d838c50fd0d0fe8e0.titleReason: The title names the defect: the webhook body schema parse throws an unhandled ZodError, which crashes the handler.
cbe7ddcbf929cc2dc2371c2d838c50fd0d0fe8e0.fixReason: The safeParse change returns 400 for an invalid body, but it misses the obligation to return 400 when the keys cannot be decrypted or the decrypted content is invalid JSON.

9e3fd1bb1d806b815a2b4f22a663f6a96ca11c9d.titleReason: The title names the defect: split-day schedules are rejected because the check vetoes a slot when any interval for that weekday excludes it.
9e3fd1bb1d806b815a2b4f22a663f6a96ca11c9d.fixReason: It computes the end as `slotEndTime.hour()*60+minute`, which wraps to a small value for slots that cross midnight (e.g. 23:30–00:30 gives end=30), so slots outside working hours are accepted and the containment check does not use the actual slot end as required.

94a3cab160d25afce913b1bd4929c02bae51d9c2.titleReason: The title names the defect: times wrap at midnight when overrides are converted between timezones.
94a3cab160d25afce913b1bd4929c02bae51d9c2.fixReason: The fix diffs UTC-shaped wall-time values against `startOfInviteeDay` (an invitee-timezone instant) rather than a UTC-shaped invitee calendar-day midnight, so the invitee offset is applied a second time and every override is shifted by that offset, violating the obligation not to double-apply the offset.

8f0a81218fca343b120cebebe7036aa0b8edc35d.titleReason: The title states the defect itself: the server schema accepts duplicate guest emails.
8f0a81218fca343b120cebebe7036aa0b8edc35d.fixReason: The refine rejects requests with repeated emails, keeps the email and numeric bookingId checks, and still accepts arrays of distinct valid emails, which the reference explicitly allows.

f45e11d93a3adbad862cb05f49834dfa03f74741.titleReason: The title names the defect: BuildIndex lets builds for the same key run concurrently, which matches the finding.
f45e11d93a3adbad862cb05f49834dfa03f74741.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so no local fix is graded.

894f2391384f7ae5c846d1bbfad5aa4e15e0a7c1.titleReason: The title names the defect: the shared cleanup ticker now fires every minute, which multiplies DB/IO load.
894f2391384f7ae5c846d1bbfad5aa4e15e0a7c1.fixReason: The replacement sets the ticker back to ten minutes and keeps the startup temp-file cleanup and the loop structure, so it meets every obligation.

27aa3e447c1869830bad7a615d8e64e3665999fd.titleReason: The title states the defect: the Grafana Prom abilities hook enables Duplicate when the rule is undefined, which matches the finding.
27aa3e447c1869830bad7a615d8e64e3665999fd.fixReason: Adding `!rule ||` to MaybeSupported makes Duplicate unsupported when the rule is undefined, keeps the loading and plugin-provided restrictions, and still requires Grafana create permission, so it matches the example fix with no new defect.

baa6f5143807697577040f0062effda15d341208.titleReason: The title names the defect: close and terminate shut down the queue pool that the factory shares across strategies.
baa6f5143807697577040f0062effda15d341208.fixReason: Removing the shutdown calls keeps the shared pool usable, but `join(timeout=5.0)` can return while the commit thread is still running, so the stale commit callback may keep firing and the obligation to stop the thread before teardown returns is not met.

0bc8586dcd23cc2a7e3a08ff4076cbf9ddc20835.titleReason: The title names the defect: commit_function is called from a background thread and races with the processor's main thread.
0bc8586dcd23cc2a7e3a08ff4076cbf9ddc20835.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so no improvedCode is graded.

8c75411b17893042de2aa5f9aef770793e716a26.titleReason: The title names the defect: hung processes are leaked when the join() deadline expires.
8c75411b17893042de2aa5f9aef770793e716a26.fixReason: The fix keeps the `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` guard, and SpawnProcess workers from self.mp_context are not subclasses of multiprocessing.Process, so they are still never terminated, which misses the obligation to terminate the spawned processes.

1ebc875cbf3539679291e5c2c545526577a70310.titleReason: The title correctly says the override bounds check accepts slots that only partly overlap the override or sit on its boundary, which is the containment defect.
1ebc875cbf3539679291e5c2c545526577a70310.fixReason: The containment logic is correct, but improvedCode adds its own closing brace while existing line 125 still supplies one, leaving an extra '}' that breaks compilation and violates the obligation to leave that brace outside the replacement.

bb0e761718c4eefd6a5d53ccabc1ca15838f287b.titleReason: The title names the defect: unbounded work queues can exhaust memory under bursts, which is the finding's problem, not its fix.
bb0e761718c4eefd6a5d53ccabc1ca15838f287b.fixReason: The queues are bounded at maxsize 1000 and put() blocks, which applies backpressure without dropping messages, while hashing, FIFO order and add_offset-before-put are unchanged; the new local variable sits at the correct indentation inside __init__.

d56037227314cbfc1e3502d1db75d7056d69ff1f.titleReason: The title states the defect: error timestamps in seconds are compared against event timestamps in milliseconds.
d56037227314cbfc1e3502d1db75d7056d69ff1f.fixReason: Multiplying the error timestamp by 1000 puts both values in milliseconds and keeps fractional precision, while the bounds check and strict comparison stay as they were and stored values and message formatting are untouched.

c3dd1bf2ec07e1159986ed135ca2f773306409fc.titleReason: The title claims filtered messages are never tracked or committed, but the reference says a BrokerValue-wrapped FilteredPayload still has its offset completed by the exception handler; the real defect is that filtered payloads are sent to the decoder and routed through exception handling.
c3dd1bf2ec07e1159986ed135ca2f773306409fc.fixReason: The fix checks `isinstance(message.value, FilteredPayload)`, but filtered messages arrive as `BrokerValue(FilteredPayload(), ...)`, so the branch never fires and they still reach the decoder; even if it fired, it reads `.partition` and `.offset` from a FilteredPayload, which has neither.

cdfc14b3cbf6f3cfae65a39758faf3d6b59d86db.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the attribute-keys query key leaves out the organization identity.
cdfc14b3cbf6f3cfae65a39758faf3d6b59d86db.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

7642d0923e0604b4256da7cd8518faf94a0afef5.titleReason: The title says the redirect traversal limit was cut to 1000 and that this breaks deep segment trees, which is the defect in the finding.
7642d0923e0604b4256da7cd8518faf94a0afef5.fixReason: The improved code puts the loop bound back to 10000 and leaves the break condition and redirect_depth assignment unchanged, so the traversal limit stays separate from the 1000-member eviction cap.

fc849c20458a666c644cf86883ddbd09ce7031cf.titleReason: The title names both parts of the defect: the missing trailing ? on the inclusion hook, and website_name leaking for restricted users.
fc849c20458a666c644cf86883ddbd09ce7031cf.fixReason: The replacement defines the recognized include_website_name? hook, omits website_name when the website is blank or scope.restrict_user_fields?(object) is true, and keeps it for a present website on unrestricted profiles, so it meets all four obligations using APIs the finding supplies.

9f02622dcf0c46f30de3e757fa45ca18008d52b0.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: fallback locale catalogs are preloaded only in the web request path and not in jobs or mailers.
9f02622dcf0c46f30de3e757fa45ca18008d52b0.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, so there is no local fix to grade.

b56dcb3b8bed11d1c3368b3335a33839c6a522ab.titleReason: The title names the defect: the default SUM aggregation in ZUNIONSTORE corrupts the timestamp scores used for eviction.
b56dcb3b8bed11d1c3368b3335a33839c6a522ab.fixReason: The cited range ends at line 54 and line 55's `end` stays in the file, so the replacement's trailing `end` produces a duplicate `end` and a Lua syntax error, even though `AGGREGATE MAX` is added correctly.

964ac4ce0b3308be298da1cd52f3f175cbe51ee4.titleReason: The title names the NoMethodError PollFeed raises when an RSS item has no content, which is the defect the finding describes.

53924f2da801b7bb3fe6596d72ab3c9e2e83f13e.fixReason: The fix still passes "80%" to the gifsicle animated path, which needs pixel geometry, so the animation is not reliably reduced; it also deletes the extra temp file only on success, with no ensure-based cleanup if downsize raises.

d34592182b6977d905c055dc5b3adba4a4d86269.titleReason: The title says the upload size check hardcodes 10MB instead of using the configured max size site settings, which is exactly the defect.
d34592182b6977d905c055dc5b3adba4a4d86269.fixReason: The improved code looks up Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb'] for the given type, rejects files strictly larger than that limit in KB, and shows that configured limit in the existing error message, so every obligation is met.

ba3e6e93211f4f1c7208024ca20b2941f3b9872e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the same-domain check fails to match websites that are subdomains of the instance host.
ba3e6e93211f4f1c7208024ca20b2941f3b9872e.fixReason: The replacement keeps the dot-boundary parent check, adds a dot-boundary subdomain check (nested subdomains are handled by ends_with?), and returns only the host for unrelated domains, so every obligation is met with no new defect.

1768fd8357409abeb299dd715266ba2e4c77ba9b.titleReason: The title states the defect: the same-parent-domain check matches unrelated sites that share a public suffix.
1768fd8357409abeb299dd715266ba2e4c77ba9b.fixReason: The fix calls PublicSuffix, which does not exist in the repository according to the reference, so without adding the dependency the inline rescue yields nil and valid sibling hosts such as www.example.com and forum.example.com lose path display.

4525cbfe0b78a9addc0e3e83e945c436e518fe7e.titleReason: The title names the defect: unauthenticated requests can enqueue an unbounded number of RetrieveTopic jobs.
4525cbfe0b78a9addc0e3e83e945c436e518fe7e.fixReason: The fix uses an atomic per-IP Redis INCR counter with a one-minute expiry, which caps enqueueing independently of the embed URL across workers, still allows anonymous retrieval within the limit, and leaves existing-topic rendering unchanged.

06608c2e415bd0318009103427ee466d8b165e50.titleReason: The title says the light and dark lightness arguments are swapped in the custom-message-length color, which is the inversion the finding describes.
06608c2e415bd0318009103427ee466d8b165e50.fixReason: The replacement keeps dark-light-choose and uses $primary at 70% for light themes and $secondary at 30% for dark themes, so both obligations are met with no new issues.

a8d158811632d65080525d09bc396eb546e454fe.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: protocol-relative URLs get wrongly rewritten onto the embed host.
a8d158811632d65080525d09bc396eb546e454fe.fixReason: It only skips protocol-relative hrefs, so the img src branch at lines 70-72 is still broken and path-relative references are still not resolved against the article URL.

fcd5dc56d072b3baa813fdc74eeecadb29efde68.titleReason: The title names the mismatch: V2 group IDs are passed to a JPA filter that still requires legacy group.resource.<id> resource names, which is the defect described.
fcd5dc56d072b3baa813fdc74eeecadb29efde68.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

0cdd20db49db55203fcc0920493a91beaca1c2d5.titleReason: The title names the actual defect: add_members raises on duplicate or existing memberships and is not transactional.
0cdd20db49db55203fcc0920493a91beaca1c2d5.fixReason: It skips existing members and repeat users by checking user IDs, wraps the batch in a transaction that rolls back when save fails or an addition raises, keeps the automatic-group rejection and the skipping of unknown usernames, and keeps both responses; the extra strip and uniq on usernames is harmless.

81ec3bc564872de0d37fef04e64584f50d935b25.titleReason: The title says the updateEvent fallback fails to match a destination calendar when externalCalendarId is falsy, which is the defect described.
81ec3bc564872de0d37fef04e64584f50d935b25.fixReason: The fix keeps a supplied externalCalendarId and otherwise falls back to the in-scope mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId, and that value is safely undefined when destinationCalendar is empty or null, so every obligation is met.

0b5f0647699412969cca0f273db186dc158c4741.titleReason: The title states the defect: record_for_host ignores the port, so entries saved with a port never match.
0b5f0647699412969cca0f273db186dc158c4741.fixReason: It adds the host:port candidate only when the port differs from the scheme default, so a validly saved entry like `example.com:443` or `example.com:80` still never matches its URL; this misses the obligation to match configured host:port entries.

164e40d2185cbad07b2649dbb51649ca98a5b6ab.titleReason: The title says that one SendGrid cancellation failure stops the remaining reminders from being cancelled, which is the defect described in the finding.
164e40d2185cbad07b2649dbb51649ca98a5b6ab.fixReason: Each cancellation now runs in its own try/catch, deletions are queued only after a successful cancel and awaited in a separate try/catch, failures are logged without blocking the scheduling phase, reminders whose cancel failed are kept, and all names used exist in the file.

0fcd7d2f3a925061dbdda868f0ed195e30f97410.titleReason: The title names the defect: a placeholder refresh_token overwrites the valid stored token when the response omits one.
0fcd7d2f3a925061dbdda868f0ed195e30f97410.fixReason: The replacement adds the placeholder only when both sharing-branch conditions hold and refresh_token is missing, so it keeps a supplied token and keeps the sharing/sync placeholder behavior.

616186c014957886068c87ea4d557dc570b12a0e.titleReason: The title names the defect: a locked-send skip is treated as a failed attempt, which leads to the reminder being deleted.
616186c014957886068c87ea4d557dc570b12a0e.fixReason: The else branch now only logs and does not increment retryCount, and line 187's brace still closes it, so skipped reminders stay unscheduled while the success update and the catch-block retry counting are unchanged.

2aa91e9dae338c281bb51a2cec36c20a7dcd9f8b.titleReason: The title names the defect: the type-based search in getClientsWithPermission never matches the untyped per-client resources.
2aa91e9dae338c281bb51a2cec36c20a7dcd9f8b.fixReason: Iterating realm clients and calling the existing hasPermission(client, scope) helper adds internal client IDs (getId) for clients the admin is granted, which covers per-client and all-clients grants without returning type names, and it leaves the realm and resource-server guards in place.

f0729e691749a59c6be83fcbe8c11fbe0a1af1c6.titleReason: The title states the defect: the team authorization check uses && and so denies admins who are not owners.
f0729e691749a59c6be83fcbe8c11fbe0a1af1c6.fixReason: Swapping && for || authorizes either an admin or an owner, and the organizer/attendee checks and the FORBIDDEN rejection on lines 50-56 are left unchanged.

6579acca36aa4cf1049abf493d5b67b010fbaabc.titleReason: The title names the defect: the catch block uses a stale retryCount value, which loses updates when failures run concurrently.
6579acca36aa4cf1049abf493d5b67b010fbaabc.fixReason: The replacement uses Prisma's atomic `{ increment: 1 }`, still targets reminder.id with an awaited update, keeps the catch block, and leaves the closing `});` and the logging outside the range, so nothing is duplicated.

c281ceaa127295cbc83953d96f7aecbf7b77a22c.titleReason: The title states the defect: a date override reports the slot as available without checking busy times.
c281ceaa127295cbc83953d96f7aecbf7b77a22c.fixReason: The replacement runs the existing busy-interval overlap logic only for override slots, so it rejects overlaps and allows endpoint-touching slots without applying working hours, and it uses only names in scope while leaving the currentSeats and non-override paths unchanged.

142e2e424b0a8cdc5b4e97697bc32123774c632c.titleReason: The title says the slug condition is inverted, so the slug is set only when billing is enabled, which bypasses the payment flow, and that matches the defect.
142e2e424b0a8cdc5b4e97697bc32123774c632c.fixReason: The improved code inverts the slug condition so the slug is set only when billing is disabled, keeps requestedSlug for the billing-enabled case, and leaves the remaining metadata untouched.

2a79e6d0eaf867ea219799c18c6a9e3082a9139b.titleReason: The title names both defects: the end bound is ignored, and slots are wrongly rejected when a day has several working-hour entries.
2a79e6d0eaf867ea219799c18c6a9e3082a9139b.fixReason: The guard checks `workingHoursForDay.length > 0` instead of `workingHours.length > 0`, so when working hours are supplied but none cover the slot's day, the slot is accepted rather than rejected, missing the obligation to reject slots outside every applicable interval.

773dd0ef0125b29e3de6dcdca1d628f4acf35cd8.titleReason: The title states the defect: the blacklist check misses case variants and plus-address aliases of blocked emails.
773dd0ef0125b29e3de6dcdca1d628f4acf35cd8.fixReason: Lowercasing, stripping the plus suffix and comparing guests against the lowercased blacklist excludes case and alias variants, while keeping the attendee check, raw guest emails, empty-blacklist behavior and the closing `);` on line 78 intact.

10ccd258031a249aa39b4d4a7c99440c98ac6791.titleReason: The title names the defect: slots on days with split working-hour ranges are rejected, and the slot end is ignored.
10ccd258031a249aa39b4d4a7c99440c98ac6791.fixReason: It correctly uses `some` over intervals and the real slot end, but it only checks when the weekday has matching intervals, so with non-empty workingHours a slot on a day with no applicable interval is still accepted, missing the obligation to reject slots outside all applicable intervals whenever working hours are supplied.

0cef2de4fb1bf97dc08b269c349706ce66cbcb3c.titleReason: The title names the defect: recurring cancellation deletes only each occurrence's first calendar reference through the organizer's credentials instead of using the matching credential.
0cef2de4fb1bf97dc08b269c349706ce66cbcb3c.fixReason: It uses the resolved `calendarCredential` (including one loaded from the database), picks each occurrence's reference by `credentialId` (plus a reasonable `externalCalendarId` match), deletes with that reference's `uid` and `externalCalendarId`, and leaves the existing push and `Promise.all` error handling intact.

c725d53fba90a0fa44db3aa60b8ddb48edd89a1b.titleReason: The title names the defect: after the timezone shift, override times wrap around at midnight.
c725d53fba90a0fa44db3aa60b8ddb48edd89a1b.fixReason: It swaps the existing organizer-to-invitee offset conversion for a direct .tz(timeZone).diff(startOfInviteeDay), which the reference says is not equivalent because override dates hold organizer wall time in UTC-shaped values, so it breaks the obligation to preserve the conversion.

ebd5552da7fb3e21190361f882838a580fb42d84.titleReason: The title names the defect: the override check accepts slots that only partly fall inside the override instead of requiring full containment.
ebd5552da7fb3e21190361f882838a580fb42d84.fixReason: The replacement rejects slots that start before or end after the converted override bounds, allows equality at both ends, keeps the return-true rejection semantics, and leaves the closing brace on line 125 intact.

2342cd4a6cbeabef5e4451c09cb64a329a97ce29.titleReason: The title says the addGuests schema allows duplicate guest emails, which is the defect described.
2342cd4a6cbeabef5e4451c09cb64a329a97ce29.fixReason: The refine rejects any request with repeated emails (compared case-insensitively after trimming), keeps email-format and numeric bookingId validation, and still accepts requests with distinct valid emails, which matches the allowed refinement approach.

2e3c0d4fd49189dbbd75a8cea8cf5529234f9ded.titleReason: The title names the defect accurately: a Twilio cancel failure causes the database delete of the workflow reminder to be skipped.
2e3c0d4fd49189dbbd75a8cea8cf5529234f9ded.fixReason: Wrapping the Twilio cancel in its own try/catch means the prisma delete is always attempted and awaited, Twilio is called only when referenceId is present, a null referenceId leads straight to the delete, and the outer catch still logs and contains DB errors.

4cdf27f9bb98fc566756bd95b96c58fa0001152e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the async calls inside forEach that delete calendar and video events are never awaited.
4cdf27f9bb98fc566756bd95b96c58fa0001152e.fixReason: Replacing forEach with await Promise.all(map(async ...)) awaits every deletion before the emails and webhooks go out and passes failures up to the handler, while keeping the UID checks, the type dispatch, the optional calendar call and the deletion arguments unchanged.

55bd7b62cd0ec2e2a81b587a7274c8cfd495fc10.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring bulk delete runs on every reference iteration and uses every organizer credential, which causes repeated deletions.
55bd7b62cd0ec2e2a81b587a7274c8cfd495fc10.fixReason: The fix scopes each occurrence's lookup to the current reference's `credentialId`, deletes through that reference's own resolved `calendar` using the matched `uid` and `externalCalendarId`, still returns the `promises` array to the existing `Promise.all` and try/catch, and leaves the recurrence guard and single-booking path unchanged.

b0ca7def422e445ef6849d334defc446fa41a33e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the Duplicate ability is enabled when the Grafana prom rule is undefined (skipToken), which matches the finding.
b0ca7def422e445ef6849d334defc446fa41a33e.fixReason: Adding `!rule ||` to MaybeSupported makes Duplicate unsupported when rule is undefined, keeps the loading and plugin-provided restrictions, still requires create permission, and uses only names that exist in the shown code.

f6d3f1f6750a91091b8b20f7b4ff3809a2ddf1e7.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: once the deadline has elapsed, join() stops terminating the remaining processes.
f6d3f1f6750a91091b8b20f7b4ff3809a2ddf1e7.fixReason: The fix still guards termination with isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process), which does not match the SpawnProcess workers created by self.mp_context, so those spawned processes are still never terminated.

c35f7eea1d24c057b9e0e2d5d42b85f1b34e1c69.titleReason: The title states that the 1000-span eviction can drop the segment root span, which is the defect the finding describes.
c35f7eea1d24c057b9e0e2d5d42b85f1b34e1c69.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

1fd940f496e87d3aa914a4d63a6a732ff220ad31.titleReason: The title states the problem: the query key leaves out the organization, so cached attribute keys are shared across organizations.
1fd940f496e87d3aa914a4d63a6a732ff220ad31.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

a3b182ecebfb98e40e8117e90c2594d100885424.titleReason: The title says the missing '?' lets website_name skip the restricted-user check, which is the defect the finding describes.
a3b182ecebfb98e40e8117e90c2594d100885424.fixReason: The replacement defines the recognized include_website_name? hook and returns website.present? && !scope.restrict_user_fields?(object), which meets every obligation.

9a1d514f0ca543caba65442f92bf2a58bf434991.titleReason: The title repeats the finding's claim that filtered offsets are never tracked or committed, but the reference says that claim is wrong; the real defect is that FilteredPayload is sent to the decoder and handled through the exception path.
9a1d514f0ca543caba65442f92bf2a58bf434991.fixReason: The fix checks message.payload for FilteredPayload before calling the decoder and completes its broker offset without enqueueing or logging, while keeping decoding, grouping, submission and the None-result handling unchanged for ordinary payloads.

08d3537042ab27f26d98300978a516d4b3845cac.titleReason: The title names the defect: unbounded queues provide no backpressure and can exhaust memory.
08d3537042ab27f26d98300978a516d4b3845cac.fixReason: Bounding each queue to 1000 makes the existing blocking put() apply backpressure without dropping messages, and it keeps group hashing, FIFO order, and offset registration before enqueue unchanged.

54eaa88c906d450724f2dac36864a76b76b42b07.titleReason: The title names the defect: Arroyo's commit callback is invoked from a background thread rather than the processor's own thread.
54eaa88c906d450724f2dac36864a76b76b42b07.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

04d15ad7955fa73daa2d19a5f6d821e3b0855a2e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the test asserts no commit even though the failed offsets do get committed once the commit loop ticks.
04d15ad7955fa73daa2d19a5f6d821e3b0855a2e.fixReason: The loop now waits for an actual commit, the final assertion fails if no commit appears within the wait window, and it still checks both processing attempts and that the committed offset is 102, matching the reference's example approach.

2be4ce376ea44243cf98c7b542afc88169d3c544.titleReason: The title names the defect: flex children of .contents cannot shrink below their content width, which breaks the topic-title ellipsis in the header.

95160838b647e2a0bd9711d461e97c0d86f98c37.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: an SSRF in import_remote, where open(url) fetches a user-controlled embed_url.

a58f3e0bb727a9ebea959386a2ae22eea0ee2cdf.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the public members page shows only the first 50 members and has no way to paginate.
a58f3e0bb727a9ebea959386a2ae22eea0ee2cdf.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context, not local, so no fix is graded.

3fa626920782a79b1142ba94240b013743de2c4e.titleReason: The title names the nil dereference that happens in unsubscribe when the user has no TopicUser record, which is the defect described.
3fa626920782a79b1142ba94240b013743de2c4e.fixReason: find_or_initialize_by returns a record tied to the current user and topic, defaulting its level to regular keeps the comparison from failing, and the existing branch and save! then persist the mute while existing records keep their transitions.

5ac50b66eaa3c7f736501c70b15fcac975aa0023.titleReason: The title names the defect: the feature-flagged table visualization renders empty columns and data instead of the real results.
5ac50b66eaa3c7f736501c70b15fcac975aa0023.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

dc7c5db84e411bf16dd478d027929e1727c12b4e.titleReason: The title says the offset is marked complete even when result_processor raises, which leads to data loss, and that is the defect described.
dc7c5db84e411bf16dd478d027929e1727c12b4e.fixReason: Moving complete_offset into an else clause means it runs only on success, leaves failed or ShutDown work outstanding, and keeps the exception logging, the ShutDown break, and the finally block that holds the metrics gauge, matching the reference fix.

1195bdd7a13048cd2996abf39b89962e1866c65b.titleReason: The title names both parts of the defect: the cleanup listener ignores the V2 feature flag, and it can throw when V2 is enabled.
1195bdd7a13048cd2996abf39b89962e1866c65b.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

b7d709a16b8ed939c2676dfd83fecf4b1b06aae2.titleReason: The title names the defect: the migration crashes with a NoMethodError when the setting query returns no rows.
b7d709a16b8ed939c2676dfd83fecf4b1b06aae2.fixReason: The empty-result guards prevent the crash, but when the uncategorized setting is absent the code assigns an arbitrary lowest-id category instead of the application's default; it also relies on `Object#then`, which does not exist in the Ruby versions of this 2015-era migration.

5c2550e22cf937b888256ca879a5ad1fd444b8cb.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the shared login predicate now filters out already-linked organization IDPs in IdentityProviderBean.
5c2550e22cf937b888256ca879a5ad1fd444b8cb.fixReason: The fix adds getLoginCachePredicate() but doesn't update the Infinispan invalidation code, which still calls getLoginPredicate(), so it loses cache invalidation on BROKER_PUBLIC changes, a change the reference says needs work outside the cited lines.

455cffba36398ee141720a0252f37064cbd4010c.titleReason: The title names the defect: count() detection misses aliased and whitespace variants, so those queries skip upsampling.
455cffba36398ee141720a0252f37064cbd4010c.fixReason: The case-insensitive regex on the stripped column accepts whitespace inside the parentheses and an optional `as alias`, keeps the alias's case (defaulting to `count`), and leaves every other column unchanged and in order, which meets all the obligations.

c6327165a706f84317c0cb8093a3403ed96bb987.titleReason: The title states the defect: the common prefix and common suffix overlap, so the HTML diff throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
c6327165a706f84317c0cb8093a3403ed96bb987.fixReason: The improvedCode matches the reference fix: limiting end to each length minus start keeps start <= length-end for both strings, so the bounds stay valid, the differing content is kept, and the illegal-HTML diagnostic is unchanged.

d822c2f66027661ccbb12fd5a06bc39cb1dbe66d.titleReason: The title names the defect: the canViewGlobal fast path is gone, so permissions are evaluated once per subgroup.
d822c2f66027661ccbb12fd5a06bc39cb1dbe66d.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

bc1163d40468d90ccafd4e0e644d5fdc6265c033.titleReason: The title names offset gaps blocking commits, but it calls the stall permanent, which the reference says is wrong because committing the earlier prefix lets a later scan move past the gap.
bc1163d40468d90ccafd4e0e644d5fdc6265c033.fixReason: Iterating sorted submitted offsets above last_committed and breaking only on an outstanding one skips absent offsets, stops at earlier pending ones, and keeps the watermark, locking and return convention; dropping the now-unused `start` breaks nothing.

45c7705e77b19aa07b3439bb690723fde3c8e1a6.titleReason: The title names the defect: a null dereference in hasPermission when the all-clients type resource is missing.
