ca5646a533b5d5ad2497a2954bd75cfb1a14b6c4.titleReason: The title states the defect correctly: video booking references lose credentialId because the value is set to undefined.
ca5646a533b5d5ad2497a2954bd75cfb1a14b6c4.fixReason: Using result.credentialId for every result keeps the credential for both video and calendar references and leaves externalCalendarId limited to calendar references, which meets all obligations without adding new problems.

fcce6e7ffba381f2dd432f6d5a1ff853d14e6bed.titleReason: The title names the defect: separate same-day overrides are each checked on their own, so a slot that fits one override can still be rejected because of another.
fcce6e7ffba381f2dd432f6d5a1ff853d14e6bed.fixReason: The improvedCode marks a slot as available when it merely overlaps an override (slotEnd after overrideStart and slotStart not after overrideEnd), so it accepts slots that only partly overlap an interval or start exactly at overrideEnd, which breaks the requirements that an interval contain the whole slot and that slots outside all intervals be rejected.

a24e5af1480c52b7cdca266ec75cb24fe24c047b.titleReason: The title names the defect: recurring cancellation deletes through the wrong credential and leaves co-host calendar events in place.
a24e5af1480c52b7cdca266ec75cb24fe24c047b.fixReason: It uses the resolved `calendarCredential` (including one loaded from the database), picks each occurrence's reference by matching `credentialId`, and deletes with that reference's uid and externalCalendarId; the extra `_calendar` type filter is harmless, and the existing push and Promise.all error handling are kept.

cdb555ae09bec474174c7ba4b8355a795fb02054.titleReason: The title names the defect: case variants or plus-address aliases bypass the guest blacklist check.
cdb555ae09bec474174c7ba4b8355a795fb02054.fixReason: Guests are compared by lowercased base address with the plus suffix stripped, so case variants and plus aliases are excluded; existing-attendee exclusion, the submitted emails, empty-blacklist behavior and the closing `);` on line 78 are all preserved.

72d32cb728cf30a6f10461ceddf61f5c298a03cc.titleReason: The title names the defect, an unconditional token refresh on every client creation that bypasses refreshOAuthTokens and credential sync, which matches the finding's description of the problem.
72d32cb728cf30a6f10461ceddf61f5c298a03cc.fixReason: fixStatus is 'needs-wider-change', not 'local', so no fix is graded.

e9a305fc3695b7ab06b6cccdafaf1c92f5c629bc.titleReason: The title names the defect: override start and end times wrap around at midnight after the timezone shift, which matches the finding.
e9a305fc3695b7ab06b6cccdafaf1c92f5c629bc.fixReason: The fix drops the existing organizer-to-invitee offset conversion and uses a direct .tz(timeZone).diff, which the reference says is not equivalent because override dates hold organizer wall time in UTC-shaped values, so it breaks the offset-preservation obligation.

b7e4200dc960127c2ceb6fd4c43a94e653e0de31.titleReason: The title names both defects: the end bound is not actually checked, and slots are wrongly rejected when a day has several working-hour entries.
b7e4200dc960127c2ceb6fd4c43a94e653e0de31.fixReason: The end bound and split-schedule containment are fixed, but when workingHours is supplied and has no entry for the slot's day the slot is accepted, which breaks the obligation to reject slots outside every applicable interval whenever working hours are supplied.

7c29bc3078c84cad20f201cb9d4b9915bf685e42.titleReason: The title names the defect: the conference patch call gets an undefined calendarId when no destination calendar matches the credential.
7c29bc3078c84cad20f201cb9d4b9915bf685e42.fixReason: Resolving selectedCalendar to 'primary' at its declaration keeps the credential-matched externalId when one exists and gives the same ID to both the insert call and the later patch call, which fixes the defect without breaking anything.

74dadb647e14d55da55290a99ad639fc5b23d648.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: a weekday with several working-hours ranges causes valid slots to be rejected.
74dadb647e14d55da55290a99ad639fc5b23d648.fixReason: The fix correctly accepts a slot contained in any same-day range and uses the real slot end, but when working hours are supplied and none apply to the slot's weekday it still lets the slot through, violating the obligation to reject slots outside all applicable intervals.

c6369344a0c1a83d6d9b46f67f3c7b789e416c8a.titleReason: The title says a Twilio cancel failure causes the reminder's DB delete to be skipped, which is exactly the defect.
c6369344a0c1a83d6d9b46f67f3c7b789e416c8a.fixReason: Wrapping cancelSMS in its own try/catch means the DB delete is still attempted and awaited when Twilio rejects; Twilio is still called only when referenceId is set, a null referenceId goes straight to the delete, and the outer catch still logs and contains DB errors.

22b05a979cdfbe4944091d484c5462d1704fe253.titleReason: The title names the defect: an unprotected retryCount update in the catch block that can abort the whole cron batch.
22b05a979cdfbe4944091d484c5462d1704fe253.fixReason: The update is still attempted, and wrapping it in its own try/catch contains failures so the loop continues; the original error is still logged, though the untouched line 198 now logs it a second time, which is only cosmetic.

3019adf35a4403e92ab41c57cbb2f4495fa49cc6.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: close/terminate on a strategy shuts down the queue pool that the factory shares with other strategies.
3019adf35a4403e92ab41c57cbb2f4495fa49cc6.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so no improvedCode is graded.

2a9ef067b73a08662109360ada156d7c1d72d155.titleReason: The title names the defect: the Duplicate ability is reported as enabled when the Grafana prom rule is undefined/skipToken.
2a9ef067b73a08662109360ada156d7c1d72d155.fixReason: Adding !rule to the MaybeSupported guard makes Duplicate NotSupported when rule is undefined, keeps the loading and plugin-provided restrictions, and still requires Grafana create permission for eligible rules, matching the example fix.

71d34959a91080fd2188af11e00de681281e550e.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring cancel block deletes every event again for each calendar reference, which causes the duplicate deletions the finding describes.
71d34959a91080fd2188af11e00de681281e550e.fixReason: Each reference's recurring deletion is limited to its resolved `calendarCredential`, matched by `credentialId` and run only once per credential, using names in scope (`reference`, `credentialId`, `bookingCalendarReference`); the matching refs' uid/externalCalendarId are used, and the guard, the try/catch over `promises` and the single-booking path are kept.

dbc3e0fe25e49183fbd2790cff500688edc39696.titleReason: The title says the deadline causes join() to break out of the loop and leave the remaining processes unterminated, which is the defect.
dbc3e0fe25e49183fbd2790cff500688edc39696.fixReason: The fix keeps the `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` guard, which does not match the SpawnProcess workers created by `self.mp_context`, so those workers are still never terminated.

71b86fd6135c905c70a4af01be12dfca537b16bd.titleReason: The title states that the addGuests schema accepts duplicate guest emails, which is the defect described.
71b86fd6135c905c70a4af01be12dfca537b16bd.fixReason: The refine rejects requests with repeated emails (case-insensitively), keeps both the email-format and numeric bookingId validation, and still accepts distinct valid emails, which meets every obligation.

c3193c0f91fb4e32e8f3f700e3dd98c1963545e0.titleReason: The title names the defect: Arroyo's commit callback is invoked from a background thread and races with the main consumer thread.
c3193c0f91fb4e32e8f3f700e3dd98c1963545e0.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

4dcc376ff488bcf8108623d15050593fe765e0ac.titleReason: The title names the defect: the work queues are unbounded and apply no backpressure under load, which matches the finding.
4dcc376ff488bcf8108623d15050593fe765e0ac.fixReason: Each queue now gets a finite maxsize, so put() blocks when a queue is full; this applies backpressure without dropping messages, keeps hashing-based assignment and FIFO order, and still registers the offset before enqueueing.

b809ccecca93f6843d8b6d5ba4812125d44fd88b.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the zpopmin eviction can remove the segment's root span.
b809ccecca93f6843d8b6d5ba4812125d44fd88b.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

b923be08e81bf16afc3dc060e69db00f3a5d3f6b.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the query key omits the organization identity, so cached attribute keys are shared across organizations.
b923be08e81bf16afc3dc060e69db00f3a5d3f6b.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

a353e5eb48bf6376adda703df0662674da235ae4.titleReason: The title says filtered offsets are never tracked or committed, but the reference shows that BrokerValue-wrapped filtered payloads are still completed by the exception handler; the real defect is that they are sent through the decoder and handled as failures.
a353e5eb48bf6376adda703df0662674da235ae4.fixReason: It checks message.payload for FilteredPayload before calling the decoder and adds and completes the offset without enqueueing work or logging an error, while leaving ordinary decoding, grouping, submission and the None-result path unchanged.

b7b912b06e30082988299abefd7258d5a010457b.titleReason: The title names the defect: ZUNIONSTORE uses the default SUM aggregate, which corrupts the timestamp scores of spans.
b7b912b06e30082988299abefd7258d5a010457b.fixReason: Both zunionstore calls now use AGGREGATE MAX, and the code keeps membership, span_count, the merge conditions, and the unlink cleanup unchanged, with the closing end correctly left outside the cited range.

cf78a8617a4ffe9e089c2352d930d148cfed62ba.titleReason: The title names both parts of the defect: the missing `?` on the hook, and website_name leaking for restricted users.
cf78a8617a4ffe9e089c2352d930d148cfed62ba.fixReason: The replacement defines the recognized include_website_name? hook, omits website_name when the website is blank or the user is restricted, and allows it otherwise, which meets every obligation.

00cb70f12bb1131f8f37638b173266e0696b6bfd.titleReason: The title names the defect: the public members page shows only the first 50 members and offers no pagination.
00cb70f12bb1131f8f37638b173266e0696b6bfd.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

795960e99ec47a178a504c34c3f032d35db8259b.titleReason: The title names the defect: making .contents a flex container leaves the header-extra-info outer element unable to shrink, so long titles break the layout.
795960e99ec47a178a504c34c3f032d35db8259b.fixReason: Applying min-width:0 to every direct child also lets the .title logo and the .panel shrink below their content width, so a long title can squeeze or wrap them, which breaks the obligation to preserve the existing logo and panel sizing.

c814103cb33f0276cf5f74844a8780c77ab0c962.titleReason: The title states the defect: the error-handling test asserts no commit, yet the offsets do get committed after the failure.
c814103cb33f0276cf5f74844a8780c77ab0c962.fixReason: It polls for up to 3s so the 1s commit loop can run, fails via assertion if no commit is ever observed, still checks that both processing calls happened, and asserts the committed offset is 102; the only residual risk is a small race where a commit containing only 101 is seen first.

f27a34feb5e121a73e7e577837935fdbd11d8ec0.titleReason: The title names the defect: the feed import crashes because `scrub` is called on nil `content` for RSS items that have no content.
f27a34feb5e121a73e7e577837935fdbd11d8ec0.fixReason: The code falls back to `i.description` when content is nil, uses `next` inside the `each` block to skip bodyless items without aborting the rest, and still applies `scrub` and `CGI.unescapeHTML`, so it meets every obligation.

065c72b29656b6042482078142fc891bb63517ec.titleReason: The title states the defect: downsizing the open Tempfile in place leaves a stale file descriptor and size, which matches the finding.
065c72b29656b6042482078142fc891bb63517ec.fixReason: After each downsize, Tempfile#open reopens the handle at the start of the current file, so the loop's size checks and Upload.create_for both see the current content, and the five-attempt bound, eligibility checks, 80% reduction, animation option and cleanup are all unchanged.

5eead419aa95b813a7017a993ec690e910a71084.titleReason: The title names the defect: the delete-time permission cleanup listener either skips V2 configurations or breaks when V2 is used.
5eead419aa95b813a7017a993ec690e910a71084.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

32030f6ad05cce4ce78b8530a68f27cecb4d13bf.titleReason: The title names the NoMethodError raised by the unsubscribe action when no TopicUser record exists, which is the defect in the finding.
32030f6ad05cce4ce78b8530a68f27cecb4d13bf.fixReason: find_or_initialize_by returns a record tied to the current user and topic, `.to_i` turns a nil level into 0 so a new record takes the muted branch and is saved by the existing save!, and existing records behave as before.

09a55398c87ddd78be2034dc3fac5bac4b0864a0.titleReason: The title states the defect: the offset is marked complete even when result_processor raises, which drops failed messages.
09a55398c87ddd78be2034dc3fac5bac4b0864a0.fixReason: Completion moves to the else branch, so it runs only on success, while logging and the ShutDown break are preserved and the following metrics.gauge lines stay in the finally block after the harmless `pass`.

d9bce96a0784c6f9e8be7c05443978f8fbd1303e.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the migration crashes with a NoMethodError when the queried settings rows are missing.
d9bce96a0784c6f9e8be7c05443978f8fbd1303e.fixReason: It guards both queries, but when the uncategorized setting is absent it assigns an arbitrary lowest-id category instead of the application's default, and it relies on `Object#then`, which the 2015-era Ruby this migration targets may lack.

050f31075d87463c106ab2b2b150382912f14850.titleReason: The title names the defect: overlapping prefix and suffix stripping that throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
050f31075d87463c106ab2b2b150382912f14850.fixReason: Bounding the suffix loop by `start + end < length` for both strings keeps `length - end >= start`, so the substrings stay valid (including empty and overlapping cases), the differing content is kept, and the diagnostic is unchanged, matching the example fix.

3ba40ba881b47fbd0f43d02451a191b9faf4abc6.titleReason: The title names the defect: Grafana rules in the new list view are missing the Pause/Resume action.
3ba40ba881b47fbd0f43d02451a191b9faf4abc6.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

7ef6804875305accdbaccad4c50d993524d8546a.titleReason: The title names the defect: SSRF from an unvalidated server-side open(url) fetch of a user-controlled embed URL in import_remote.
7ef6804875305accdbaccad4c50d993524d8546a.fixReason: The fix blocks redirects and checks scheme and port, but it never restricts the request to SiteSetting.embeddable_host as the reference requires, and it relies on IPAddr#private? and #link_local?, which only exist in Ruby 2.5+ and would raise NoMethodError on this era's Ruby, breaking every import.

2968f8d9d1bc8f9bfb568fcb0f61e777dc590e81.titleReason: The title names the NPE in hasPermission that happens when the Clients type resource is missing on the fallback path, which matches the defect.
2968f8d9d1bc8f9bfb568fcb0f61e777dc590e81.fixReason: The code returns false when the fallback resource is null before findByResource runs, keeps denial when the fallback has no policies, leaves evaluation of existing resources unchanged, and leaves the outer closing brace outside the cited lines as required.

289e1eed6dd8cd464b62ff1b5e04eb1eadb9b6c9.titleReason: The title states that getSubGroups lost its canViewGlobal fast path and now evaluates permissions per subgroup, which is the defect the finding describes.
289e1eed6dd8cd464b62ff1b5e04eb1eadb9b6c9.fixReason: The replacement computes canViewGlobal once before filtering, short-circuits the per-subgroup canView check when global view is granted, and keeps per-group filtering otherwise, while preserving requireView, the search params, filtering before pagination and the representation mapping.

dc2125795ecf52babc00c196d671ff3d239ab216.titleReason: The title states the defect: the upsampling transform misses aliased count() forms and forms with whitespace inside the parentheses.
dc2125795ecf52babc00c196d671ff3d239ab216.fixReason: The case-insensitive regex fullmatch accepts surrounding whitespace, whitespace inside the parentheses and optional aliases, keeps the alias's case or falls back to the default `count` alias, and leaves every other column unchanged and in order.

a3baec3d55b45293ce04a033d75bcd5bf358d944.titleReason: The title names the defect: in the list view the Silence action does nothing because the drawer only renders when a ruler rule is present.
a3baec3d55b45293ce04a033d75bcd5bf358d944.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

4602932ac17a45712c03deeae38764d3ba221c20.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect, commits stalling at gaps in Kafka offsets, though calling it 'permanent' overstates it, since the reference shows the stall clears after the earlier prefix is committed.
4602932ac17a45712c03deeae38764d3ba221c20.fixReason: Iterating the sorted delivered offsets above last_committed and breaking at the first outstanding one skips absent offsets and stops before pending ones, while keeping the watermark check, the lock and the existing return convention, so it matches the example fix.

59c4111114f61d47af44ab66e3d1d1be3f0e5e69.titleReason: The title states the defect: Delete skips the legacy delete when storage returns NotFound.
59c4111114f61d47af44ab66e3d1d1be3f0e5e69.fixReason: When storage returns NotFound, the code falls through to line 106, which unconditionally records the storage operation as a success, so it breaks the obligation not to treat NotFound as a successful deletion.

33b08e39428434e16dc5e35ed5b640ef09f6246d.titleReason: The title says the all-clients grant is ignored when a per-client resource exists, which is the defect described.
33b08e39428434e16dc5e35ed5b640ef09f6246d.fixReason: The replacement accepts a per-client grant through hasGrantedPermission, then always falls back to the all-clients resource, which the existing code below evaluates; it denies when that resource is absent or has no policies, and leaves the same-realm and resource-server checks untouched.

3ddaaa4ad1d296a1a8f327d86757a948d70889bc.titleReason: The title says the mode-3 legacy update reuses the original objInfo instead of the object committed to unified storage, which is the defect the finding describes.
3ddaaa4ad1d296a1a8f327d86757a948d70889bc.fixReason: The replacement wraps objInfo and res in updateWrapper using the field names given in the reference, which supplies the committed object and keeps the preconditions, the other update arguments, and the errObjectSt variable used for duration recording.

2e16b41c31e58d324bafd854cb9478a96e2b6b7b.titleReason: The title says that canExchangeTo throws UnsupportedOperationException in V2 instead of returning a boolean, which is the defect.
2e16b41c31e58d324bafd854cb9478a96e2b6b7b.fixReason: The replacement keeps the same signature and returns false, giving a fail-closed boolean decision instead of throwing, which meets every obligation.

064c74040d79c9e60e012d7fee7e40dc7b28d602.titleReason: The title states the defect: the forbidden assertion for removeDefaultClientScope can be satisfied by the earlier getDefaultClientScopes read rather than by the removal call.
064c74040d79c9e60e012d7fee7e40dc7b28d602.fixReason: The replacement gets the scope ID through the privileged realm client outside the try block, calls only the removal through the restricted client before any permission is granted, fails on success or on a non-Forbidden exception, keeps the later authorized removal intact, and avoids a clientScopeRep name clash by using a distinct variable name.

eb19b1c3a3d92534b4ebc723863d0dcf84500204.titleReason: The title says the safeParse wrapper object is stored in place of the credential key, which is the defect the finding describes.
eb19b1c3a3d92534b4ebc723863d0dcf84500204.fixReason: Adding .data persists the parsed credential rather than the wrapper, keeps validation before the write, and leaves the same update call and its outside closing delimiter intact.

2549ba429b4d88eb9cd7274edde55b032db3f5a8.titleReason: The title names the defect: backup-code login skips the password check when a dummy totpCode is sent.
2549ba429b4d88eb9cd7274edde55b032db3f5a8.fixReason: The fix always checks the password with the existing `verifyPassword` before touching backup codes, rejecting missing passwords or non-CAL providers (which could not log in by backup code without a totpCode before), and it leaves the normal backup-code login, code consumption and the TOTP path unchanged.

dcc65d1b333f5f6eeb6f3719c6308e0258c21464.titleReason: The title names the defect: stale member-fetch responses overwrite newer pagination state.
dcc65d1b333f5f6eeb6f3719c6308e0258c21464.fixReason: The fix compares offsets instead of using a per-request token, so it cannot tell apart overlapping requests for the same offset (for example, refreshes after membership changes), and an older response can still be applied when the offset returns to the same value, which misses an obligation.

2ea165b7b932a351ffc40a883b5b52d66e8259c2.titleReason: The title says that group creation ignores the alias_level param, so the selected alias level is not saved, which matches the finding's defect.
2ea165b7b932a351ffc40a883b5b52d66e8259c2.fixReason: The improved code assigns alias_level with the same to_i/present? conversion as update, keeps the default when the param is absent or blank, and leaves name trimming, visibility handling and save behavior unchanged.

47f6191bc6429d612666fc73391e9ae6f4187ba7.titleReason: The title states the defect: the URL and username specs never get past the polling-enabled guard, so they do not test what they claim.
47f6191bc6429d612666fc73391e9ae6f4187ba7.fixReason: Both examples now enable polling, set the other required setting to a nonblank value using the existing `url`/`embed_by_username` lets, and keep the never-called assertion, so each example fails if its own guard is removed.

698e4e3bbf77a173782f92511c785b3195a40981.titleReason: The title names the defect: stale rejectedEmails entries keep blocking an address after the server no longer rejects it.
698e4e3bbf77a173782f92511c785b3195a40981.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

0791159f57b4feddebc1788619a088088ee26384.titleReason: The title names the defect: the dark-theme badge background is lightened while the text still uses $secondary, which is the low-contrast mismatch the finding describes.
0791159f57b4feddebc1788619a088088ee26384.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so no improvedCode is graded.

39498982b3ef7c39d242f1c56aa144b8e0eb68e8.titleReason: The title names the defect: SVG uploads are corrupted because they go through the automatic raster downsizing path.
39498982b3ef7c39d242f1c56aa144b8e0eb68e8.fixReason: Adding `&& filename !~ /\.svg\z/i` keeps SVGs out of the downsizing branch case-insensitively, leaves eligibility and the loop unchanged for other formats, and leaves SVG bytes intact for Upload.create_for.

5904d5d3af91d87ca81995bc807b0c93d686ab3b.titleReason: The title correctly says the unsubscribe confirmation wrongly claims that all topic notifications stop.
5904d5d3af91d87ca81995bc807b0c93d686ab3b.fixReason: Narrowing the claim to new-post notifications follows the finding's suggested wording, holds for both regular and muted outcomes, and keeps the key and the {{title}} interpolation.

107ce0ff0f0c4c828a647b6cbf1576daf48599eb.titleReason: The title says the raw guests are passed to sendAddGuestsEmails instead of the filtered uniqueGuests, which is the defect in the finding.
107ce0ff0f0c4c828a647b6cbf1576daf48599eb.fixReason: Passing uniqueGuests means only filtered new guests count as new, and evt still carries the full attendee list, so both obligations are met; this assumes uniqueGuests is in scope earlier in the handler, as the finding says.

d25c8a9c7ed563f7d937a204bac119ca4d8511bf.titleReason: The title names the defect: remove_member skips the GroupUser callbacks, so the user_count counter cache goes stale.
d25c8a9c7ed563f7d937a204bac119ca4d8511bf.fixReason: It destroys only that group's matching GroupUser record via destroy_all, so callbacks fire and the counter cache is decremented, while the automatic-group guard and response handling stay unchanged.

f6862cbfae97a89ef42d75d9c4f7180d8252da91.titleReason: The title says the override check misses slots that start before the override window, and that is the defect.
f6862cbfae97a89ef42d75d9c4f7180d8252da91.fixReason: The fix adds a strict isBefore check of slotStartTime against the offset-adjusted override start, so a slot starting exactly at the start still passes, and it keeps the existing offset adjustment and the return-true semantics; the remaining end-time clauses are redundant but harmless.

a1c62890dc3105a8981803d03b9c82e16d1a33fa.titleReason: The title says the success check relies on statusText, which fails on HTTP/2 where valid responses are then rejected; that is the defect described.
a1c62890dc3105a8981803d03b9c82e16d1a33fa.fixReason: Using `!response.ok` accepts every 2xx response whatever its statusText, and failed responses still throw an HttpError, now with the real status code and a fallback message; nothing else breaks.

fb8681330895701c889d887c4c110fb847ff1d2c.titleReason: The title names the defect: the toString() computed keys strip the expiry fields, which leads to NaN.
fb8681330895701c889d887c4c110fb847ff1d2c.fixReason: It requires a string access_token, validates expires_in and expiry_date as optional numbers so providers without expiry fields still parse, and keeps refresh_token and other fields through passthrough; the extra optional ext_expires_in breaks nothing.

c19ad9a8f820a68fb913147b0b7d005d1abd5287.titleReason: The title names the defect: getBaseConditions returns fragments without parentheses, so OR/AND precedence breaks when callers append an AND predicate.
c19ad9a8f820a68fb913147b0b7d005d1abd5287.fixReason: Wrapping the auth-only and filter-only returns in parentheses makes an appended AND apply to every OR branch, the both-present branch already composes safely with AND, and parameterized SQL plus the atomic 1=0 deny-all behavior are preserved.

889233972b380ad73fc45cda1d0f8e2401cf0020.titleReason: The title names the defect: the connection is built with the stale access token instead of the refreshed one.
889233972b380ad73fc45cda1d0f8e2401cf0020.fixReason: The replacement keeps the awaited persistence, the existing refresh_token, the client config and the redirect URI, and it uses the refreshed access_token and instance_url, so it meets every obligation.

f56c1a712d5df15e92804f0f99ce6379e172bb91.titleReason: The title names the defect: metadata is looked up by map key instead of by slug value, so valid apps get a 404.
f56c1a712d5df15e92804f0f99ce6379e172bb91.fixReason: Finding the metadata entry whose slug equals app.slug supports apps whose directory name differs from their slug, keeps the 404 guard without duplicating its closing brace, and casts to the metadata union type so the slug and type stay available downstream.

e52730e1d1d9fdcbb6b0defb83209037980625fd.titleReason: The title names the defect: every paginated request fetches the replay's error_ids from nodestore with no bound.
e52730e1d1d9fdcbb6b0defb83209037980625fd.fixReason: Slicing error_ids to 100 before the opt-out check and before fetch_error_details bounds the nodestore load, keeps the empty and opt-out behavior unchanged, and still passes error context to enabled requests.

1b8a6ef60ef4d9a4fea1c6690e6b2b6381486686.titleReason: The title states the defect: the kill guard skips spawned flusher processes, so the old process stays alive when a replacement starts.
1b8a6ef60ef4d9a4fea1c6690e6b2b6381486686.fixReason: Changing the guard to multiprocessing.context.SpawnProcess makes spawn-context workers get killed before replacement, still skips threading.Thread workers, and keeps the closed-process handling and the replacement call with the same index and shards.

7fd86a2fe9f6688cd5db7b6576058a275f2d56ab.titleReason: The title states the defect: successful cleanup batches are logged at ERROR level.
7fd86a2fe9f6688cd5db7b6576058a275f2d56ab.fixReason: The replacement fixes only the age-based flow, while the obligations also require changing the count-based cleanup (lines 554/557) and orphaned-tag cleanup (lines 576/579), which still emit error-level logs on successful batches.

eac12b6ffbdc9e90fae240bc8641455ef68d3937.titleReason: The title names the defect: the async legacy Create uses the request context, which is cancelled when the handler returns.
eac12b6ffbdc9e90fae240bc8641455ef68d3937.fixReason: Only the Create block is fixed, so the Delete, Update and DeleteCollection paths named in the finding still inherit request cancellation, which misses the obligation to cover all four async legacy write paths.

aeddbc30d757863cd5a07feed5802c61af902b9f.titleReason: The title states the defect: the Delete action is missing from Grafana rule list items because AlertRuleMenu requires rulerRule, which matches the finding.
aeddbc30d757863cd5a07feed5802c61af902b9f.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so no improvedCode is graded.

81cdb4b344ae6ff780356cf9a974263ff54bf53b.titleReason: The title names the defect: the validation-failure log writes the full attacker-controlled raw report into application logs.
81cdb4b344ae6ff780356cf9a974263ff54bf53b.fixReason: The fix removes raw_report but still logs serializer.errors, which can echo invalid input values, and it adds report_type, a truncated but arbitrary caller-supplied value, so it misses the obligation to avoid logging arbitrary input through replacement metadata or validation-error messages.

92c1f8ae5af3f15b61857882ccb94d23d054df7b.titleReason: The title names the defect: the domain restriction regex is unanchored and leaves metacharacters unescaped, which is what the finding describes.
92c1f8ae5af3f15b61857882ccb94d23d054df7b.fixReason: It anchors and escapes the domains correctly, but the added `\A[^@\s]+` requirement means emails with whitespace or extra '@' in the local part (e.g. ' a@evil.com' or 'a@good.com@evil.com') no longer match, opening a new blacklist bypass the original and reference fix do not have.

387dd9db5dac0499136276c40f80a3205ac51755.titleReason: The title names the defect: the body renderer's result is discarded whenever it is falsy, when only undefined should trigger the fallback; it covers only the body path, but it is faithful to what the finding describes.
387dd9db5dac0499136276c40f80a3205ac51755.fixReason: The change fixes the body condition but leaves the header renderer at line 32 still testing truthiness, so it misses the obligation to honor every non-undefined header-renderer result.

210ba8b22e5bb243ff06c5224eab150177ddb9a1.titleReason: The title states the defect: the commit thread is stopped before workers drain, so the final offsets are lost.
210ba8b22e5bb243ff06c5224eab150177ddb9a1.fixReason: Calling queue_pool.shutdown() first does not drain queued work, because per the reference the pool sets worker stop flags before draining (outside the cited lines), so queued work can still be abandoned; the final commit also runs even if the commit thread join timed out, which is not serialized with that thread.

706db6a7a4d7b3be8a1f6c8a8c72efdda8d6e85a.titleReason: The title names the defect: the buffer keys changed from set to sorted set without versioning, which causes WRONGTYPE errors.
706db6a7a4d7b3be8a1f6c8a8c72efdda8d6e85a.fixReason: The fixStatus is needs-wider-change, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

a0f67d8763585acb57938d6d814b76ad9ffcd026.titleReason: The title says the handler bypasses the calendar-cache feature flag when querying cache status, which is the defect described.
a0f67d8763585acb57938d6d814b76ad9ffcd026.fixReason: fixStatus is insufficient-context, not local, so there is no fix to grade.

3898ca6b0378f5b41e8f1e9e598c197aad492656.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the feature-disabled guard in UpdateCompatibilityCheck has no test coverage.
3898ca6b0378f5b41e8f1e9e598c197aad492656.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

c4f0bd1a13c4e59296de883f930b75d872e53802.titleReason: The title states that the test only checks that queue_pool is cleared and does not verify that work drained, which is the defect.
c4f0bd1a13c4e59296de883f930b75d872e53802.fixReason: The fix keeps the pool and checks the queue is empty, but it never checks that worker threads stopped, so it misses an obligation, and the total_items check alone may not catch outstanding work.

cbc93d10e4ad81e62af986ab9fca7e9de88cd102.titleReason: The title names the defect: the downsize loop passes "80%" percentage geometry where pixel WxH geometry is expected.
cbc93d10e4ad81e62af986ab9fca7e9de88cd102.fixReason: The improvedCode drops the cited comment and the `if` line (63-64), which leaves an unmatched `end` and breaks the code; it also ignores the downsize return value, so it keeps retrying after a downsizing failure.

046c770644c57d47a15c4d368761d6fcfd6d2a74.titleReason: The title names the defect accurately: skipping the test on postgres hides startup regressions from the eager Init change.
046c770644c57d47a15c4d368761d6fcfd6d2a74.fixReason: The answer's fixStatus is no-code-fix, not local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

c021a35f65ffbea5e8df3996f54b6ca7300d0f03.titleReason: The title correctly identifies the defect: the test that sets max_segment_id to None never actually runs the None guard.
c021a35f65ffbea5e8df3996f54b6ca7300d0f03.fixReason: fixStatus is needs-wider-change rather than local, so there is no improvedCode to grade.

28222c01bf110e061391745dba24575e3ced861e.titleReason: The title names the defect: making .small-action a flex container breaks the right-floated button alignment, though its mechanism of an 'ineffective' float differs slightly from the reference, where the buttons float inside a content-sized description.
28222c01bf110e061391745dba24575e3ced861e.fixReason: fixStatus is 'needs-wider-change', not 'local', so there is no improvedCode to grade.

cf325d4d9aa96119f76252ec1b742605b40b6b5f.titleReason: The title states the defect: slots on weekdays with no working-hours entry are wrongly treated as available.
cf325d4d9aa96119f76252ec1b742605b40b6b5f.fixReason: The replacement sits inside the `find` callback, which never runs when `workingHours` is empty, so a host whose schedule has no intervals is still not rejected; handling that case without breaking the busy-only call needs a change to the enclosing condition.

410b6097c17146d28b8b68272cf9ad284cbc3bb5.titleReason: The title states the defect: animated GIF uploads lose their animation when downsized through a tempfile path with no extension.
410b6097c17146d28b8b68272cf9ad284cbc3bb5.fixReason: It still sends the percentage geometry "80%" into animated processing, which per the reference needs pixel dimensions, and it ignores downsize's result, so the animation is never actually reduced.
